bb02638d.title: National Program Manager (Code Club)
bb02638d.description:
**National Programme Manager (Code Club)**
**Location:** 
 Delhi/NCR, India
   

  

**Salary:** 
 INR 32 lakhs to 42 lakhs p.a. full time equivalent, dependent on experience
   

  

**Basis:** 
 Permanent; full\-time, part\-time or flexible
   

  

**Eligibility:** 
 You must be eligible to work in India
   

  

**The role**
 We are looking to appoint an experienced leader to grow the reach and impact of Code Club across India.
   

  

 Code Club is the world's largest movement of free computing clubs where young people aged 9\-16 years old develop the skills and confidence to create with digital technologies. Code Clubs are run by teachers, educators, and volunteers from all walks of life and take place in schools and community settings, like libraries and maker spaces.
   

  

 We already support a network of 2500 Code Clubs in schools and communities all over India and we are building new partnerships that will see Code Clubs being set up as part of the networks of Atal Tinkering Labs in Odisha, Kerala, and beyond.
   

  

 As National Programme Manager you will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies for growing and sustaining the network of Code Clubs in India, including through creating strategic partnerships with a wide range of organisations.
   

  

 You will also play a critical role in ensuring that Code Club makes a real impact on young people, including through recruiting and training mentors, gathering feedback and data, and identifying and sharing good practices.
   

  

 You will also lead the delivery of Coolest Projects in India, providing a platform for young people from Code Clubs to share the projects they build so that they can learn from and inspire each other.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced leader with a deep understanding of the Indian education system, both schools and non\-formal settings. You should have a proven track record of leading large scale national educational or volunteer\-driven programs, as well as developing and managing strategic partnerships. You don't need to be an expert in computer science or coding, but you do need to bring a passion for our mission and a willingness to learn.
   

  

 We work hard to make sure that the Foundation is a place where everyone is supported to do the best work of their careers. We have a flexible and collaborative approach to all aspects of our work. If you're the right person for the job, we'll make it work for you, and you can be confident that you'll be joining an exceptional team of people who care about our mission and each other
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement strategies to grow the network of Code Clubs in India, supporting the sustainability of existing clubs and the successful launch of new ones
* Identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships to increase the reach and impact of Code Clubs
* Improve the quality of the learning experience at Code Clubs in India including through designing and organising high quality mentor training
* Develop and implement strategies to recruit and support volunteer mentors, working with industry and other partners.
* Ensure that Code Club particularly benefits young people who experience educational disadvantage and those who come from backgrounds that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech sector.
* Lead the delivery of Coolest Projects online and face to face showcases in India.
* Use monitoring and evaluation plans and data insight to ensure outcomes for young people and mentors are met and identify areas for improvement
* Ensure all Code Clubs and partners understand and follow our safeguarding policies and practices
* Build and lead a high\-performing team, providing the clarity, support, and resources they need to do great work
* Work with fundraising advisors to develop and deliver proposals and pitches and develop and sustain relationships with funding partners
* Manage budgets effectively
* Represent the Raspberry Pi Foundation to external audiences, including writing blog posts and magazine articles, attending outreach events, and leading workshops as and when required


**Experience And Personal Attributes**
 We recognise that everyone has the potential for growth, and we welcome applications from candidates who can demonstrate that they have some, but not all, of the experience and personal attributes listed here.
   

  

* Proven experience in leading and scaling large\-scale educational or volunteer\-driven programs in India
* Demonstrated success in building and managing strategic partnerships with educational institutions, nonprofits, and industry to drive program growth and impact
* Experience in designing and delivering high quality training and non\-formal learning experiences
* Bachelor's degree or higher in the STEM field (preferable)
* A deep understanding of the Indian education system, with experience of working with schools, teachers, and youth\-serving community organizations
* Experience of managing a team, with a collaborative and supportive approach to leadership and the ability to plan and manage resource allocation effectively across multiple projects and priorities.
* Good data and analytical skills, and the ability to use data effectively to improve what we do. Ideally you will have experience of working with Salesforce, but if not we can support you with training.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to inspire and engage diverse audiences
* Flexibility, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues and external partners.
* A strong alignment with the Foundation's mission and values, particularly around educational equity and access
* The ability to extensively travel within India


**About Us**
 The Raspberry Pi Foundation is an independent charity with a global mission to enable all young people to realise their full potential through the power of computing and digital technologies. We operate through Raspberry Pi Foundation Educational Services incorporated in India, to provide educational services.
   

  

 We empower schools to teach computer science and AI literacy through free curricula, classroom resources, purpose built software tools, and professional development for teachers. We inspire young people to become tech creators through the world's largest networks of coding clubs. We undertake original research that informs our work and which we use to advance the field of computer science education more broadly.
   

  

 All of our resources and learning experiences are available for anyone to use at no cost. We are particularly focused on creating opportunities for young people who experience educational disadvantage and those who come from backgrounds traditionally underrepresented in technology industries.
   

  

 Over the past decade, we have supported hundreds of thousands of educators and tens of millions of students. We have teams in six countries (India, Ireland, Kenya, South Africa, the UK and US) and partnerships with mission\-aligned non\-profit organisations in over 60 countries.
   

  

 We are at the forefront of the global educational movement to expand access to computer science education and AI literacy. You can learn more about our work in our latest Annual Report.
   

  

**Benefits**
 In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a wide range of benefits for all of our colleagues, including:
   

  

* Competitive leave allowance. From day one, you'll benefit from 17 days of earned leave, 13 days of sick leave, and 16 national/regional leaves; 2nd and 4th Saturdays off
* Generous Employee Provident Fund (EPF). The EPF is a retirement savings scheme where both employees and employers contribute 12%
* Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance. We provide Private Healthcare via a Group Medical Insurance provided by NivaBupa. Each colleague has a sum assured amount of ₹10,000,00
* Flexible working. We have clear policies to provide flexibility over when and where you work, helping you balance work responsibilities with the rest of your life
* Support for parents and carers. We provide generous family leave and flexibility for parents and carers.
* Group Term Life Insurance. We provide life assurance and income protection schemes to provide peace of mind for you and your family.
* Investing in learning and development. We invest in your growth and development, including through access to learning resources and training, with dedicated time for all employees.


**Timetable for applications**
 Closing date: 24 August 2026
   

  

 Phone screen: Week commencing 10 August 2026
   

  

 First interview: Week commencing 24 August 2026
   

  

 Second interview: Week commencing 7 September 2026
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 All of our workplaces are inclusive spaces where we want people to feel respected, valued, and able to do their best work. We are committed to building teams that bring together people with a broad range of backgrounds, skills, and perspectives. That starts with our recruitment process.
   

  

 Here's what you can expect:
   

  

* As part of your application, you will be asked to respond to a small number of questions that we will use to screen your eligibility for the role. You will also be asked to provide your cv and a short cover letter.
* Eligible applications will be reviewed by our recruitment team and the hiring manager.
* A small number of candidates will be invited to a phone call with the hiring manager. The purpose of this call is to check our understanding of your application and to answer any questions you have.
* We normally have two interviews, at least one of which will take place in\-person. Interviews will be with the hiring manager and at least one other colleague.
* You will usually be asked to undertake a work\-based assessment in advance of your interviews. This will be an opportunity for you to show how you would perform some part of the role. You will be given advance notice and clear instructions.
* If you have any questions about or feel that you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, including adjustments for neurodiversity, please contact our People and Culture team at recruitment@raspberrypi.org


 We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people, and we expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Everyone appointed to a role at the Foundation will be required to undergo a background check to confirm that you are a suitable person to work with children. Further background checks will be made at regular intervals thereafter.

a9c532d9.title: Technical Program Manager
a9c532d9.description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

**SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER**
* THE ROLE:


 As a SoC Program Manager, you will lead end\-to\-end execution across complex System\-on\-Chip (SoC/ASIC) development programs from architecture through tapeout and post\-silicon phases. You will drive program milestones, manage cross\-functional dependencies across IP teams (CPU/GPU/NOC/DDR/SoC subsystems), and ensure alignment across RTL, PD, DFT, firmware, validation, and platform teams. You will be responsible for planning, tracking, reporting, and risk management across all phases of SoC execution, including architecture, design convergence, validation, tapeout, and silicon enablement, while ensuring predictable delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

**The Person**
 You bring strong execution discipline, structured program management, and cross\-functional leadership. You partner seamlessly with architects, IP owners, RTL, PD, DFT, firmware, validation, and external vendors to drive convergence, resolve dependencies, and maintain schedule integrity. You understand system\-level architecture, SoC integration challenges, milestones (e.g., architecture, RTL feature completion, physical design readiness, validation readiness, engineering change order (ECO) phase, tapeout) and the full lifecycle of complex SoC programs, with the ability to drive alignment across geographically distributed teams. You ensure execution is on\-time, within cost, and manage scope changes. As a Program Manager you will drive AMD product solution deliverables and alignment with customers’ platforms to ensure highest level customer satisfaction throughout their product lifecycle. You proactively involve team members in planning, decision\-making and execution efforts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Program Planning \& Execution
* Define, structure, and drive end\-to\-end SoC program plans in alignment with architecture, design, and tapeout milestones.
* Ensure requirements are clearly defined and integrated into design, validation, and silicon execution plans.
* Create and maintain detailed schedules covering:
* Architecture definition and high\-level design readiness
* IP integration and subsystem convergence
* Design milestones (architecture, RTL feature completion, physical design readiness, validation readiness, engineering change order (ECO) phase, tapeout)
* Track progress across IP teams (CPU, NOC, DDR, SoC subsystems, etc.) and ensure timely milestone completion.
* Drive disciplined execution through structured action tracking, meeting cadences, and program reviews.
* Drive milestone checklist compliance and readiness reviews for key program exits.
* Manage resource planning, onboarding, and execution tracking across internal teams and external vendors (ODC/CW engagement).
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, firmware, validation, and system engineering teams to resolve cross\-domain dependencies.
* Drive convergence forums (IP\-SOC, subsystem syncs, CFT reviews) to ensure alignment across all stakeholders.
* Track and manage detailed schedules and deliverable lists covering:
* Cross\-IP dependency tracking (interfaces, fuse mapping, metal stack, etc.)
* Validation readiness (pre\-silicon and post\-silicon)
* Silicon bring\-up and platform readiness
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Identify program risks early (schedule slips, dependency gaps, design readiness, vendor execution issues).
* Drive mitigation plans with clear ownership; escalate proactively to leadership when required.
* Track cross\-IP blockers and ensure timely resolution through structured follow\-up and governance.
* Manage backlog of open items, track closure rates, and ensure high\-priority issues are driven to closure.
* Reporting \& Governance
* Collect, analyze, and publish program status and execution metrics (milestone health, dependency closure, risk status).
* Maintain dashboards and trackers using Jira, Confluence, Excel, PowerBI, and internal tools.
* Provide concise, executive\-level weekly / monthly updates highlighting risks, progress, and key asks.
* Run structured governance cadences including CFT forums, leadership reviews, and cross\-team syncs.
* Process \& Methodology Improvement
* Drive improvements in program execution frameworks, action tracking, and cross\-team coordination.
* Introduce structured templates for meeting notes, tracking, and reporting to improve clarity and efficiency.
* Streamline workflows to reduce noise, eliminate duplication, and improve execution predictability.
* Implement automation for reporting, tracking, and data consolidation using tools like MS Project, Jira, and scripting.
* Leverage AI for improving execution efficiency across tracking, reporting, and workflows

* Focus on using AI to automate existing processes and improve execution efficiency
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools
* Experience using AI with Excel, PowerPoint, and Jira is a plus

* Strong familiarity with SoC / IP execution flows:
* Architecture to tapeout lifecycle (standard RTL and netlist\-based milestones)
* IP integration and dependency management
* Pre\-silicon and post\-silicon execution flows
* System\-level bring\-up and platform readiness
* Detail\-oriented, self\-driven with a strong sense of pride and ownership.
* Proficiency in project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, PowerBI, Excel, MS Project, AI tools).
* Strong organizational, problem\-solving, interpersonal, presentation, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build relationships and work effectively as a self\-starter and as part of a team.
* Prior experience driving large multi\-site or multi\-vendor engagements is desirable.
* People management experience is desirable.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to handle all levels of interaction, including executive level.

d312024e.title: Architect
d312024e.description:
Position Overview

The Principal Architect is the Design and Technical Head of Ark Spaces, responsible for leading the firm's architectural vision, design excellence, technical compliance, and project delivery across Residential, Commercial, Industrial, and Hospitality projects. The role ensures every project reflects Ark Spaces' philosophy of delivering premium, functional, and buildable spaces while maintaining profitability, quality, and client satisfaction. The Principal Architect also mentors the design team, establishes design standards, and works closely with the Studio Director, Execution Team, and Managing Director to deliver turnkey projects successfully.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Design Leadership

* Lead the conceptualization and development of architectural designs.
* Ensure every project aligns with Ark Spaces' design philosophy and quality standards.
* Approve all architectural concepts before client presentation.
* Guide innovative, sustainable, and practical design solutions.
* Develop signature design standards for the firm.

2\. Project Design Management

* Review site conditions and feasibility before design commencement.
* Lead schematic design, design development, and construction documentation.
* Coordinate with Interior Designers, Structural Engineers, MEP Consultants, and Landscape Consultants.
* Ensure seamless integration between architecture, interiors, and execution.

3\. Technical Excellence

* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, NBC, CMDA/DTCP requirements, and safety codes.
* Review architectural drawings, construction details, and BOQs.
* Standardize construction details and material specifications.
* Resolve technical issues during execution.

4\. Client Management

* Attend high\-value client meetings.
* Present design concepts and architectural solutions.
* Provide professional design consultation.
* Handle complex client concerns and design revisions.

5\. Design Quality Control

* Review all 2D drawings, 3D renders, working drawings, and GFC drawings before issue.
* Ensure construction drawings are accurate and coordinated.
* Conduct periodic design audits.
* Approve material palettes and architectural finishes.

6\. Team Leadership

* Mentor Architects, Interior Designers, Draftsmen, and 3D Visualizers.
* Conduct weekly design reviews.
* Improve team capabilities through training.
* Allocate projects based on team strengths.

7\. Site Coordination

* Conduct milestone site visits.
* Ensure execution follows approved drawings.
* Resolve on\-site architectural challenges.
* Approve design modifications during execution.

8\. Business Development Support

* Participate in premium client pitches.
* Support proposal development.
* Assist in marketing through thought leadership, seminars, and presentations.
* Represent Ark Spaces at industry events.

9\. Process Development

* Establish architectural SOPs and design checklists.
* Standardize drawing templates and documentation.
* Develop material and detail libraries.
* Improve workflows for faster project delivery.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Design Approval Rate (First Submission)
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Drawing Accuracy
* Design Delivery Timelines
* Construction Error Reduction
* BOQ Accuracy
* Team Productivity
* Project Profitability
* Design Innovation
* Repeat Client Percentage

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch/M.Arch)
* Registered Architect (Council of Architecture preferred)
* 3\-5 years of architectural design experience
* Experience in residential, commercial, hospitality, and industrial projects
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies and turnkey execution

Technical Skills

* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Revit (preferred)
* Lumion / D5 Render / Enscape
* Adobe Photoshop
* Microsoft Office
* Building Codes \& Regulations
* Material \& Specification Knowledge
* BOQ Preparation
* Project Coordination

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

0aa6f71c.title: Cloud Engineer
0aa6f71c.description:
**About The Company**
 HCLTech is a leading global technology company renowned for its innovative solutions and comprehensive IT services. With a strong presence across various industries, HCLTech specializes in digital transformation, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and enterprise modernization. The company is committed to delivering value\-driven solutions that enable organizations to enhance their operational efficiency, accelerate growth, and stay ahead in a competitive landscape. HCLTech’s collaborative approach and deep industry expertise have established it as a trusted partner for Fortune 2000 clients worldwide, helping them navigate complex technological challenges and harness emerging opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HCLTech is seeking a highly skilled Google Cloud Solutions Engineer / Architect to join its dynamic team across India. This role is pivotal in driving solution design and engineering efforts aimed at accelerating the adoption of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at the enterprise level. The successful candidate will lead technical engagements, develop innovative cloud solutions, and collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and clients to deliver impactful outcomes. The role involves working on large\-scale projects including cloud migration, modernization, data engineering, and AI\-driven automation across diverse industries such as banking, retail, healthcare, and telecommunications. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions effectively and secure customer wins.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should hold a B.E. / B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. A minimum of 5 to 7 years of overall IT experience is required, with at least 2\-3 years dedicated to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Proven expertise in GCP services such as Compute, Storage, and Networking is essential. Candidates should have high proficiency in Data Engineering tools like BigQuery and Looker, along with a basic understanding of AI/ML platforms such as Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise / LLMs. Experience working with GSI partners, managing sales and revenue targets, and a solid understanding of industry\-specific use cases in domains like BFSI, RCPG, Telecom, Healthcare, or Manufacturing are highly desirable. Certifications such as Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, or Machine Learning Engineer are preferred.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Pre\-Sales \& Go\-To\-Market (GTM): Collaborate with global sales teams and Google Cloud Architects to respond effectively to RFIs and RFPs, ensuring alignment with customer requirements. Develop ROI models and hyperscale funding strategies that optimize total cost of ownership (TCO). Design industry\-specific use cases focusing on cloud adoption and modernization to support IT managed services.
   

  

 Cloud Architecture \& Solutions Engineering: Lead technical workshops and craft reference architectures for data center migration and modernization initiatives to Google Cloud. Design and implement Google Cloud native applications, enterprise\-grade data engineering stacks utilizing BigQuery, Looker, and Vertex AI. Innovate and develop Gemini Enterprise Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions tailored to enterprise needs, enhancing IT managed services, cloud operations, and engineering processes.
   

  

 Partner Collaboration: Work closely with GSI partners to build joint solutions, scale go\-to\-market strategies, and expand cloud service offerings. Demonstrate a high\-level understanding of industry\-specific value stream use cases, enabling tailored solutions for clients across BFSI, RCPG, Telecom, Healthcare, and other sectors.
   

  

**Benefits**
 HCLTech offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salary structures, health insurance, and wellness programs. Employees have access to continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and career development initiatives to foster professional growth. The company promotes a collaborative and inclusive work environment, emphasizing innovation, diversity, and work\-life balance. Additionally, employees benefit from flexible work arrangements, recognition programs, and various employee engagement activities designed to support their overall well\-being and job satisfaction.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone is valued, respected, and provided with equal opportunities for growth and development. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our commitment is to ensure a fair and equitable hiring process and a supportive work environment for all team members.

ff8cff24.description:

Job Summary
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:**  

SAPUI5 / Fiori — custom app development, Fiori Elements, Flexible Programming Model, and Fiori Launchpad configuration.
  
ABAP on HANA — CDS views, AMDPs, BOPF, RAP, and OData (SEGW and RAP\-based services).
  
HANA\-optimized ABAP — code pushdown, performance tuning, ATC checks, and S/4HANA simplification list awareness.
  
SAP Gateway and OData service development \& troubleshooting.
  
Strong understanding of at least one S/4HANA functional area (FI/CO, MM, SD, or PP) from a developer's perspective.
  
  

**Good to have skills:**  

Knowledge of Fiori security, authorizations, and SAP UI Theme Designer.
  
SAP certifications in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori, or BTP.
  
Experience with SAP Build (Build Apps, Build Process Automation, Build Code).
  
Exposure to ABAP Cloud / Steampunk (ABAP Environment on BTP).
  
Familiarity with Agile / Scrum delivery methodology.
  
Experience working in a global offshore\-onshore delivery model
  
  

**JD:**  

We are looking for an experienced Senior SAP Fiori and ABAP on HANA Developer at E3\.1 Role to join our offshore delivery team. The ideal candidate will bring hands\-on expertise across the full S/4HANA development stack — custom Fiori applications, ABAP on HANA, BTP extensions, and integrations — with a proven track record of end\-to\-end S/4HANA implementations. The role demands strong technical depth, ownership, and the ability to collaborate effectively with onshore stakeholders in a global delivery model.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

SAP experience with a strong hands\-on development background.
  
Minimum 2–4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA implementations (greenfield or brownfield), with at least one on a recent S/4HANA release.
  
Design, develop, and deploy custom SAP Fiori applications using SAPUI5, Fiori Elements, and the Fiori Design Guidelines.
  
Build and optimize ABAP on HANA developments including CDS Views, AMDPs, OData services (V2/V4\), BOPF, and the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP).
  
Develop and consume OData services (Gateway/SEGW and RAP\-based) for Fiori and external consumers.
  
Implement side\-by\-side and in\-app extensions on SAP BTP using CAP, BTP Workflow, Build Apps, and BTP Destination/Connectivity services.
  
Perform performance tuning of ABAP code, CDS views, and HANA database objects using SQL Monitor, Runtime Analysis, and Code Inspector / ATC.
  
Adhere to clean core principles and SAP's recommended extensibility approach (key user, developer, and side\-by\-side extensibility).
  
Participate in requirements analysis, technical design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, and production deployments.
  
Collaborate with onshore functional and technical teams, business analysts, and solution architects across geographies.

d137a234.description:
**Solution Architect**
**Location:** 
 Hybrid (Surat, Gujarat)
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹20,00,000 \- ₹25,00,000 per annum
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled and experienced
 **Solution Architect** 
 to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will design end\-to\-end scalable technology solutions, align technical strategies with business objectives, and guide engineering teams in implementing robust system architectures. This position requires a strong combination of technical expertise, solution design capabilities, and stakeholder collaboration skills to drive successful project execution across enterprise and product\-based environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architecture Design: Define and design scalable, secure, and high\-performing system architectures that meet business requirements.
* Technical Strategy Alignment: Collaborate with stakeholders to align technical strategies with business objectives and ensure successful project execution.
* Team Guidance: Lead and guide engineering teams in the implementation of architectural standards and best practices.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend technology stacks that are future\-ready and aligned with industry trends.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation and standards.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and understanding of architectural decisions.


**Required Skills \& ExperienceCore Technical Skills**
* Experience: 8\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2\+ years in an Architecture role.
* Architecture Expertise: Strong experience in Solution Architecture, System Design, and Enterprise Architecture.
* System Understanding: Strong understanding of system architecture, solution design, and enterprise application integration.
* Cloud Platforms: Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure cloud architecture.
* Caching Technologies: Experience with caching technologies such as Redis.
* Queue Systems: Experience with queue systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, or Service Bus.
* Microservices Knowledge: Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Database Familiarity: Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and modern backend/application frameworks.
* Optimization Principles: Understanding scalability, security, reliability, and performance optimization principles.


 Functional Strengths
   

  

* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze business problems and design practical, scalable technical solutions.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Security Knowledge: Strong understanding of security architecture, authentication, authorization, and OWASP best practices.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in Agile and cross\-functional development environments.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and architecture initiatives simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as TOGAF, AWS, Azure, or Solution Architecture.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work in a hybrid environment.
* A collaborative and innovative work culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.


 If you are passionate about technology and have a proven track record in solution architecture, we encourage you to apply and join our team in shaping the future of technology solutions.
   

  

 Skills: owasp,redis,azure,rest apis,rabbitmq,aws,solution architecture

****Career Area:****
 Technology, Digital and Data
   

  

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****About Caterpillar****
 Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off\-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel\-electric locomotives.
   

  

 For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced\-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.
   

  

**Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

**What does it mean to live the Caterpillar Experience?**
 It means you play a part in building a better world. You contribute to a winning culture—a spirit of accountability—that has driven change on every continent for more than 90 years. To work with us is a commitment to improve sustainability, invent for the digital age and innovate in order to bring solutions to millions of people. Sure, you work for Caterpillar. But more importantly, you work for the good of your career, your family, your community, and your world.
   

  

****Job Summary****
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Solutions Architect \- AI \& Procurement** 
 to join
 **NextGen Operations** 
 \-
 **Global Finance Services Division**
 The IS Specialist – Procurement \& AI Architecture provides technical leadership for the design, governance, and delivery of scalable digital solutions across Caterpillar’s Guided Buy and Coupa ecosystem. This role serves as the
 **end\-to\-end** 
**solution architect** 
 , accountable for alignment across upstream and downstream applications, integrations, data, and business processes within the Source\-to\-Pay landscape.
   

  

 As Caterpillar advances AI\-enabled and agentic capabilities, this role also functions as an
 **AI Architect** 
 , partnering with agile delivery teams to design, review, and govern AI\-driven solutions \- including agents, automation, and decision\-support capabilities—while ensuring compliance with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and Caterpillar Responsible AI principles.
   

  

 The preference for this role is to be based out of
 **Bangalore\-Shared Services, Whitefield, KA\-India**
****What You Will Do****
**Solution \& Enterprise Architecture**
* Serve as the end\-to\-end solution architect for Guided Buy and Coupa platforms, ensuring cohesive design across requisitioning, sourcing, purchasing, invoicing, supplier enablement, and downstream financial systems.
* Design and govern integrations between Coupa/Guided Buy and upstream/downstream systems such as ERP, finance, supplier systems, middleware, data platforms, and reporting tools.
* Define scalable, secure, and reusable architectural patterns for APIs, event\-based integrations, data flows, and platform extensions.
* Ensure architectural alignment with enterprise standards, IT controls, security, and SOX compliance requirements.


**AI \& Agentic Architecture**
* Act as AI Architect for procurement and purchasing platforms, designing how AI capabilities are embedded into Guided Buy and Coupa to improve user experience, compliance, efficiency, and insights.
* Provide architectural guidance for building AI agents, copilots, and automation solutions, including prompt strategy, orchestration patterns, data grounding, and decision boundaries.
* Establish and enforce AI governance practices, including design reviews, risk assessments, Responsible AI alignment, and lifecycle management of AI agents and models.
* Perform code and solution reviews for AI\-enabled components to ensure quality, maintainability, security, and architectural consistency.


**Agile Delivery \& Technical Leadership**
* Partner with Product Owners, Project managers, and development teams within an agile environment to translate business needs into clear, actionable technical designs and backlogs.
* Guide teams through design decisions, trade\-off analysis, and implementation best practices across sprints and releases.
* Support solution planning for enhancements, upgrades, and modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy capabilities.
* Own end‑to‑end troubleshooting and technical support for Guided Buy, Coupa, and the broader integrated solution landscape, partnering across teams to resolve complex cross‑system issues.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on architecture principles, integration patterns, and AI solution design.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Governance**
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to procurement, finance, audit, security, IT, and external partners.
* Lead or participate in architecture review boards, design governance forums, and change impact assessments.
* Clearly communicate complex architectural concepts and risks to both technical and business audiences.


****What You Will Have****
* Technology Advising: Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.
* Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of basic activities and deliverables of application design; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
* System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
* Systems Software Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
* Core Technical \& Functional Skills:
* Enterprise \& Solution Architecture: Proven ability to design and govern complex, integrated application ecosystems following SDLC process across cloud and on\-prem environments.
* Procurement Platforms: Hands\-on experience with Guided Buy, Coupa, or similar Source\-to\-Pay / P2P platforms.
* Integrations: Strong knowledge of APIs, middleware, ETL, event\-driven architectures, and ERP integrations.
* AI \& Automation: Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, LLMs, AI agents, and automation patterns applied to enterprise workflows.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working within agile product teams, supporting backlog refinement, sprint execution, and continuous improvement.
* This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week schedule in the office.


****What Will Set You Apart:****
* Experience designing or governing AI agents, copilots, or AI\-enabled enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of Responsible AI principles, model governance, risk management, and ethical AI practices.
* Coupa administration, configuration, or large\-scale deployment experience.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data environments, and reporting tools used in enterprise ecosystems.
* Proven ability to lead architecture discussions and influence decisions in a complex, global, matrixed organization.


****Skills Desired:****
**Problem Solving** 
 : Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
   

  

**Level Expert:**
* Gains agreement on the problem\-solving process, risk assessment, decision points, and criteria.
* Trains others in the process of eliciting alternatives and assessing their impact.
* Orchestrates the resolution of high\-impact and cross\-functional problems.
* Successfully organizes problem solvers and stakeholders for high\-impact problems.
* Predicts and explains long\-term trends and implications for alternatives.
* Monitors industry for best practices and new techniques in problem\-solving.


**Technology Advising:** 
 Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Collaborates with an extended professional technology network to help clients effectively identify, plan for and accomplish technology objectives.
* Supervises others in advising a range of clients across a myriad of products, technologies, services and solutions in a relevant technology domain.
* Identifies and evaluates emerging technologies and advises clients regarding their potential business impacts.
* Effectively consults with and conveys technology concepts, business impacts and other advice to senior client levels.
* Trains others in developing technology business, channel management and client coaching.
* Leverages formal certifications in mastery of multiple areas of technology in demonstrating credibility for client consulting.


**Application Design, Architecture** 
 : Knowledge of basic activities and deliverables of application design; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
   

  

**Level Expert:**
* Consults to others on the technical design of high\-impact, multi\-technology complex applications.
* Contributes to the establishment and implementation of best practices for application design.
* Leads in evaluating and selecting emerging application design tools and techniques.
* Mentors juniors to create multiple application designs on multiple technology platforms.
* Directs the development of technical standards and platforms for application design.
* Provides application architecture consulting and educational support to associates and business line areas.


**Requirements Analysis** 
 : Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non\-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
   

  

**Level Expert:**
* Creates leadership positions in identifying and implementing new tools and techniques.
* Shares expertise and his/her broad experience in using modeling tools for multiple requirements.
* Implements best practices for functional and information analysis and maintains the requirements definition.
* Provides insight into developing diverse and multiple requirements analyses.
* Monitors industry and vendor products in terms of improvements and enhancements.
* Establishes and communicates on advance technical standards for each stage of requirements analysis.


**System and Technology Integration** 
 : Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
   

  

**Level Expert:**
* Consults with others on system and/or technology integration efforts.
* Monitors system and technology integration trends and directions.
* Plays a leadership role in defining systems integration processes and practices.
* Designs complex interfaces, integration strategies and plans.
* Holds an industry wide conference on system integration and migration issues, problems and considerations.
* Demonstrates extensive experience with system and technology integration.


**System Testing:** 
 Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
   

  

**Level Expert:**
* Champions the employment of technology to maximize system test throughput and coverage.
* Builds testing and software QA methodologies and practices for the organization.
* Advocates appropriate levels of quality by resolution of important defects.
* Leads the team in testing activities and provides technical guidance on multiple testing projects.
* Directs the identification, investigation, reporting and follow\-up with design teams for all issues raised during the testing process.
* Solicits and evaluates feedback from business process owners during pilot and parallel testing.


**Systems Software Infrastructure:** 
 Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Designs and implements software infrastructure and core technologies.
* Develops software architecture and data management policies and procedures.
* Resolves issues regarding the implementation of heterogeneous open systems.
* Evaluates the management of software configuration facilities and practices.
* Coaches on the essential elements of software architecture, platforms and products.
* Facilitates internal and external cooperative and distributed alignment and processing of systems software infrastructure.


**Technical Troubleshooting:** 
 Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future.
* Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness.
* Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi\-vendor environments.
* Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions.
* Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance\-related problems.
* Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients.


****What You Will Get:****
* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.
* Relocation assistance


**Holistic Development**
* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
* Career developments opportunities with global prospects


**Health and Wellness**
* Medical coverage \-Medical, life and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program


**Financial Wellness**
* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance \-Annual incentive Bonus plan.


****Additional Information:****
**Caterpillar** 
 is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers
   

  

 This position requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

 July 17, 2026 \- July 30, 2026
   

  

 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

c8dd6743.title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
c8dd6743.description:
**REPORTING RELATIONSHIP** 




 POSITION REPORTS TO: ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR IT
 



 DEPARTMENT: TECHNOLOGY
 



 POSITION LOCATION: VADODARA (
 **HYBRID)** 




  





**POSITION SUMMARY** 




 The position is offered through Company. This is a hands\-on, breadth\-oriented role for an engineer who wants to run a real production environment, modernize how infrastructure is built and operated, and work closely with security and development to ship and run software safely. As lead infrastructure engineer for Omni’s multi\-tenant Azure estate and Windows server fleet, this role works in close daily partnership with Omni’s Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, who acts as the technical sounding board, security reviewer, and sign\-off authority on significant infrastructure decisions. This role operates under a matrix reporting structure, with a functional reporting line to the CTO, Omni Agent Solutions (USA) and an administrative reporting line to the Associate Director IT (India).
 



  





**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Operate as the lead infrastructure engineer in close daily partnership with Omni’s Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, who provides technical direction, conducts security review, and signs off on significant infrastructure decisions before they reach production.
 



 • Run and modernize Omni’s Azure environment, including compute, networking, identity, Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Microsoft WAF, Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365, and Azure Monitor.
 



 • Own the Windows Server fleet end\-to\-end: provisioning, patching cadence, Group Policy and Active Directory operations, lifecycle planning, and end\-of\-support migrations.
 



 • Own Microsoft 365 license allocation and Azure subscription management across Omni’s multi\-tenant environment, including license assignment and recovery, subscription and tenant governance, cost visibility, and ongoing right\-sizing.
 



 • Modernize the infrastructure\-as\-code practice. Propose tooling and patterns for joint review with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, and incrementally bring infrastructure under code with security guardrails built in from the start.
 



 • Partner with the senior developer and broader development team to extend modern CI/CD patterns from application code into infrastructure deployment, and to design systems that scale securely as the business grows.
 



 • Work closely with Omni’s security team and managed SOC on hardening, vulnerability remediation, identity controls, endpoint protection through SentinelOne, and compliance evidence.
 



 • Cross\-train into the security workstreams the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer manages day\-to\-day, including endpoint detection and response, SASE and ZTNA networking, SIEM, and the managed SOC’s tooling, so the two roles can back each other up across disciplines.
 



 • Manage observability across Datadog and Azure Monitor, including alerting, on\-call signal hygiene, and runbook development.
 



 • Maintain the homegrown line\-of\-business application infrastructure (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, and Microsoft WAF).
 



 • Run day\-to\-day business continuity and disaster recovery operations within Omni’s defined RPO and RTO targets. Maintain DR runbooks and run periodic failover and tabletop exercises.
 



 • Build and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and change records so the environment can be supported by anyone on the team.
 



 • Partner with Omni’s co\-managed MSP as a shared delivery team across day\-to\-day operations and escalations, rather than treating the MSP as an outside vendor.
 



 • Provide escalation support to internal end users for infrastructure\-impacting tickets routed through the helpdesk and the co\-managed MSP.
 



 • Participate in an after\-hours rotation covering monthly maintenance windows and incident response, and co\-lead
 



 post\-incident reviews. Formalizing the rotation is part of the role, in partnership with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer.

2c188d90.description:
**About Workato**
=================



Workato delivers enterprise infrastructure for the agentic era, redefining iPaaS and helping enterprises unify data, applications, processes, and AI into a single, governed platform. A leader in Enterprise MCP and trusted by 50% of the Fortune 500, Workato’s cloud\-native architecture connects every application, data source, and process to power real\-time orchestration at scale. With enterprise\-grade security and continuous innovation at its core, Workato provides the trusted foundation for organizations to automate with confidence and operationalize AI across the business. To learn more, visit www.workato.com


**Why join us?**
================



Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company.



But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.



If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!



Also, feel free to check out why:


* Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
* Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers
**Responsibilities**
====================



We are looking for an experienced **Program Manager** to join our AI Apps BU in the Product Engineering division. It is an engineering governance and oversight function that sits above delivery execution, focused on ensuring architectural integrity, scope alignment, and continuous feedback loops across our largest enterprise programs and early access product releases.



The Program Manager will oversee two parallel program tracks:


* Top 10 accounts — ensuring engineering\-level oversight across large, complex implementation engagements with multiple parallel workstreams.
* Early Access Product Releases — governing the rollout of new product capabilities to early access customers, ensuring adoption milestones are met and structured feedback is routed back to product engineering.

**Program Strategy \& Governance**


* Own the program charter, OKRs, roadmap, and success metrics for all Workato Agentic AI Apps BU initiatives for TECS department delivery and product tracks.
* Establish governance frameworks — RAID logs, steering cadences, escalation paths, and program decision rights — aligned to Workato's delivery standards.
* Maintain a consolidated program view across concurrent workstreams: Packaged Genies cycles and customer deployments
* Lead weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews and executive reporting for Workato leadership for strategic enterprise clients.
* Drive cross\-team dependency management and risk mitigation across TECS and Product \& Engineering
* Coordinate and facilitate design review checkpoints with the Architecture Board, ensuring solutions meet Workato's standards before build begins.
* Surface cross\-account patterns, blockers, and friction points, feeding structured learnings back to engineering leads and architecture groups to improve platform patterns and packaged applications.
* Produce executive\-level dashboards, program status reports, and decision briefs using Workato's delivery metrics framework.
* Maintain program dashboards that track status, risks, and key decisions across the enterprise portfolio.

**Cross\-Functional Planning with TECS**


* Facilitate Program planning, sprint reviews, dependency syncs, and retrospectives across FDE delivery pods.
* Maintain alignment between Workato's product release calendar and FDE delivery timelines to leverage new AI platform capabilities immediately.
* Coordinate, maintain and track a priority list of customer issues and enhancement requests and timelines with the platform team.

**Delivery Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**


* Define and enforce Workato delivery standards — Definition of Ready/Done, quality gates, and release governance for AI\-powered automation.
* Implement program\-level metrics (velocity, cycle time, integration success rate, agent accuracy, CSAT) and drive improvement actions.
* Lead post\-program retrospectives; codify learnings into Workato FDE playbooks, recipe templates, and delivery runbooks.

**Requirements**
================


### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills**


* 10\+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related discipline.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-workstream programs in a product engineering or enterprise software environment.
* Experience working across large enterprise accounts with multiple parallel delivery teams.
* Background in iPaaS, integration platforms, or enterprise automation strongly preferred.
* Experience identifying opportunities to leverage existing products/capabilities within delivery programs, and ensuring fitment evaluation checkpoints are built into the delivery lifecycle — feeding gaps and improvement opportunities back to the engineering team building packaged offerings

**Technical Domain**


* Understands the importance of architecture and engineering governance checkpoints and can ensure they are scheduled, attended, and actioned — without needing deep technical expertise.
* Familiarity with architecture review processes, design governance, and technical milestone frameworks.
* Experience with both packaged software delivery and custom implementation contexts — able to evaluate fitment vs. customization tradeoffs.
* Comfort working across Agile and structured delivery methodologies.

**Stakeholder \& Communication**


* Demonstrated ability to manage director and VP\-level relationships — both internally and with enterprise customers.
* Strong ability to set expectations clearly, communicate program status accurately, and escalate risks effectively.
* Skilled at facilitating alignment across engineering, product, and customer technical stakeholders.
* Experience synthesizing customer and delivery feedback into structured, actionable input for product and engineering teams.

**Mindset**


* Operates effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and often ambiguous environment.
* Brings a product engineering mindset — focused on quality, patterns, and scalable solutions.
* Committed to continuous improvement: uses every program as an opportunity to strengthen Workato's delivery model and product offering.

### **What Success Looks Like**


* The post\-sales processes and KPIs for customer on\-boarding, implementation, quality and CSAT are defined and meet the KPIs.
* Architecture Board reviews are scheduled, completed, and actioned — with no programs bypassing engineering governance checkpoints.
* Engineering learnings from enterprise delivery are feeding back into improved platform patterns and packaged application offerings on a recurring cadence.
* Early access product releases have structured adoption milestones, and customer feedback is systematically routed to product engineering within defined SLAs.
* All top 10 enterprise programs have clear, tracked engineering milestones with architecture review and UAT gates enforced consistently

84eb5b00.title: Program Manager - Malaria Technical Support Unit
84eb5b00.description:
Overview:

WJCF is an Indian non\-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government\-owned, high\-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data\-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health \& Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.

  

As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.

  

Our work is built around four complementary roles: as a Trusted Government Partner, co\-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on\-the\-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.

  

WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector\-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under\-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri – Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM\-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.

  

We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub\-district levels.

  

Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action\-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.

  

WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.

 **Programme Overview:**Malaria, a vector borne disease, which transmits through an infective bite of the Anopheles mosquito, is a major public health challenge, with \~263 million cases and \~597,000 deaths reported worldwide (World Malaria Report 2024\), and 255,000 cases and 86 deaths reported across India in 2024 (NCVBDC Annual Report 2024\). To combat the public health challenges posed by malaria, the National Malaria Control Programme (NMCP) was launched in 1953 built around three key activities \- insecticidal residual spray (IRS) with DDT; monitoring and surveillance of cases; and treatment of patients. While the efforts were successful in bringing down malaria linked morbidity and mortality, subsequent technical, operational, logistical and infrastructural gaps along with rising resistance to drugs and insecticides, led to a resurgence of the disease, marked by focal outbreaks (Operational Manual for Malaria Control in India, 2016\).  

This was followed by various plans and strategies in succession, with the malaria control programme being integrated into the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) in 2002, which is anchored by the National Centre for Vector Borne Disease Control (NCVBDC). The NCVBDC is the central nodal agency for prevention and control of six vector borne diseases (VBDs) i.e. Malaria, Dengue, Lymphatic Filariasis, Visceral Leishmaniasis, Japanese Encephalitis and Chikungunya in India. It is responsible for framing policies, technical guidelines, operational manuals while also providing technical handholding support to states for the effective implementation of various malaria prevention, control and elimination activities. **Project Background:**WJCF is privileged to support NVBDCP's bold vision of accelerated elimination of Malaria through a technical support unit (TSU) embedded in NCVBDC since 2024\. This TSU provides support to the NCVBDC including, inter alia:* Strengthened technical and managerial support to the malaria division of NCVBDC
* Enhanced disease intelligence and analytics for improved programmatic decisions\-making
* Adoption of dynamic innovations, and effective and sustained investments for malaria control and elimination
* Steering partnerships and multi\-sector response

**Position Summary:**


WJCF is seeking a highly motivated individual with excellent strategic programming, people management, problem\-solving, and analytical skills to lead the malaria team’s efforts across multiple grants and workstreams. The Manager will play a key role in overseeing implementation of projects, building a strong team, and securing and managing grants to achieve strategic objectives. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of implementable strategies that have a transformational impact on India’s malaria elimination effort, support the integration of cutting\-edge innovations, and work closely with senior and programmatic leadership across WJCF. They will be reporting to the Deputy Director of Infectious Diseases and working closely with NCVBDC staff.
Responsibilities:

1\. Program Management and Leadership

  

* Lead the design, development and execution of coherent programmatic multiyear strategies aimed at streamlining WJCF’s approach towards malaria programming and fundraising.
* Develop cross\-program collaborations and conceptual linkages with other VBD programs.
* Lead structured program performance reviews and develop an accountability culture within teams.
* Guide the development and updating of a program specific results frameworks, annual operational plans, program risk registers and other process documents to ensure effective program execution.
* Lead program tracking of progress, analyzing data, and making recommendations for improvements based on evidence.
* Lead structured program monitoring processes across teams including Gantt chart management and productive team meetings.
* Lead development and review of key program reports for internal and external stakeholder consumption including donors, government and WJCF leadership.
* Facilitate fundraising and business development efforts through grant writing, proof reading and desk reviews of key documentation.
* Build project implementation capacity and skills within program team ensuring timely execution of activities, compliance to WJCF policies and protocols, and responsiveness to government needs


2\. Relationship Management

  

* Lead development of key relationships between governmental, donor entities, nongovernmental organizations and health service delivery points in collaboration with country leadership.
* Lead engagement with key NCVBDC staff/ division heads to gather input and ensure alignment and buy in across all programmatic activities.
* Lead and build strong relationships with key global team program counterparts ensuring effective representation of WJCF and showcasing lessons.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive stakeholder matrix for the portfolio of programs supported ensuring stakeholder needs are identified, negotiation avenues and mapped and healthy relationships are maintained.
* Guide program team in navigating complex stakeholder relationships and favorably influence decision making in a professional and collaborative manner.
* Build a productive cadence of engagement with internal and external stakeholders and guide program team in replicating this across activities.


3\. Strategic communication

* Regularly update key stakeholders on program progress, challenges, and successes through detailed reports and presentations.
* Lead effective internal and external communication approaches aligned with WJCF’s communication policies and tailored to audiences to achieve transformational impact and influence decision making.


4\. People Management

* Build team resilience, creativity, adaptability, and teamwork in project execution.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, ensuring that each team member understands their roles and responsibilities within the context of the broader organizational goals.
* Provide hands\-on guidance and expertise in technical matters, sharing your deep knowledge to assist the team in overcoming technical challenges and making informed decisions.
* Actively engage with each direct report to understand their individual career aspirations and professional development objectives.
* Continuously monitor progress of direct reportees, provide constructive feedback, and identify opportunities for skill enhancement and career growth.
* Be a role model and team player who demonstrates exceptionally high performance and harnesses the same from a diverse, talented and dynamic team.
* Proactively identify and address programmatic, team management and performance management matters that arise.
* Develop and maintain feedback mechanisms to ensure effective staff and team performance.


5\. Financial Management

* Lead effective execution of program plans in accordance with donor and WJCF reporting requirements.
* Lead collaborative resource allocation decisions and ensure evidence informed prioritization of team activities with a lens of transformational impact.
* Lead program budget planning, tracking, and reporting, oversee budgets and resources for various projects, ensuring that they are used effectively and efficiently to achieve desired outcomes.
* Lead the development and review of financial and donor reports on project budget execution.
* Build collaborative working environment between activity leads, operational teams and finance liaisons.

  

6\. Problem Solving

* Lead teams in proactively managing program related risk and identifying sensitive issues and escalate as needed.
* Lead compliance to WJCF’s approach to problem solving, ensuring effective consultation, use of data and scenario reviews before developing insights and recommendations.
* Lead, demonstrate and drive critical thinking skills, building the team’s capacity to handle difficult or unexpected situations in the workplace.
* Lead risk assessment exercises and build teams to exercise emotional intelligence and self\-awareness.


7\. Technical Expertise

* Lead subject matter development among program team ensuring thorough grasp of key program principles.
* Develop a reading culture and challenge program teams to spotlight their work during internal and external WJCF engagements.
* Lead knowledge management and sharing of best practices at national and global convenings.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s or Degree with 8\+ years of work experience, or a postgraduate degree with 6\+ years of experience in a relevant field (public health, public policy, public administration, management, social sciences, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience in supporting health programmes at the state and national level with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and respective state departments.
* In depth knowledge of malaria is desirable with professional experience in programme design and management in public health sphere.
* Good knowledge and networks within public health ecosystem in the country, including development partners, civil society and advocacy groups.
* Proven track record of working in challenging multi\-stakeholder environments \& ability to build relationships with a range of stakeholders and drive immediate results.
* Entrepreneurial mind\-set, including ability to work independently, self\-motivate, and propose and implement new initiatives.
* Ability to think strategically, handle ambiguity, and problem solve in a fast\-paced, limited\-structure, multicultural environment.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Willingness to travel if required and at short notice, even to remote places.
* Fluency in English and Hindi.

**Last Date to Apply:** 24th August, 2026

e02b1ee2.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
e02b1ee2.description:
**Description**
 The WW FBA team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, SCOT, Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA capacity and inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. There is a clear path for this role to evolve into full product ownership — including end\-to\-end responsibility for a defined FBA capability area — as the team and its scope grow. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, SCOT, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country XBR forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence\-based product and program roadmap.
