804723af.title: Cloud Engineer
804723af.description:
**About the Company** 




  





 OnebyZero is a next\-generation Data and AI consulting company, headquartered in Singapore and driving impact across APAC. As an AWS\-exclusive partner, we help enterprises modernize data, transform with AI, and apply Generative AI in ways that deliver real business results. Our vision is simple while at the same time ambitious: to make AI adoption both impactful and human\-centered. We collaborate with leading enterprises in banking, telecommunications, retail, and other industries to help them unlock tangible value from their data and AI initiatives. By combining deep industry expertise, trusted partnerships, and a relentless focus on outcomes, OnebyZero empowers organizations to go beyond pilots and achieve lasting, scaled impact.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to lead and enhance our cloud infrastructure and deployment processes. In this role, you will work with cross\-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure, primarily on AWS. You will be a key player in automating processes and ensuring smooth operations across development and production environments, while mentoring junior engineers.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Architect, design, and implement scalable infrastructure solutions on AWS using best practices.
* Lead the automation of infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and continuous delivery using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize performance and reliability of cloud\-based environments.
* Implement security best practices and ensure that cloud environments are compliant with internal and external standards.
* Automate repetitive tasks and processes with scripting in Python, Bash, or other tools.
* Manage and optimize resource utilization and cost in AWS environments.
* Oversee the administration and management of Linux environments in production and development.
* Mentor junior team members and provide guidance on DevOps best practices.
* Collaborate with development and operations teams to streamline workflows and improve productivity.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a DevOps Engineer role, or similar positions.
* Extensive experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, VPC, Lambda, RDS, etc.)
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
* Demonstrated expertise in building, managing, and automating CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Advanced scripting skills in Python and Bash for automation and tool development.
* Expertise in Linux system administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.).
* Deep understanding of networking, security practices, and monitoring in cloud environments.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Cloud Platforms: Advanced AWS Cloud expertise (EC2, VPC, S3, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront, etc.)
* IaC Tools: Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation
* CI/CD Tools: GitHub Actions, Jenkins
* Scripting Languages: Python, Bash
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
* Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.)
* Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab
* Monitoring \& Logging: CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
* Security: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), security groups, VPC, and encryption best practices



  





**Preferred Skills:** 




  




* AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer).
* Experience with serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda and API Gateway.
* Expertise with configuration management tools
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture and container orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Experience with cost optimization in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps principles.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to lead and mentor junior DevOps engineers and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

b4f0e75f.description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

This role is responsible for architecting and designing advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that drive business transformation. The individual leverages deep expertise in scalable data platforms, distributed computing, and model development to deliver robust, secure, and high\-performing systems. They provide strategic technical direction, mentor teams, and ensure alignment of technology strategies with organizational objectives.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
1\. Architect end\-to\-end AI/ML solutions using Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit\-learn, ensuring scalability, performance, and security across cloud and on\-premise environments.
  
2\. Design and implement distributed data processing pipelines with Apache Spark and Kafka, optimizing for real\-time analytics and robust data ingestion.
  
3\. Develop and operationalize machine learning models for NLP, deep learning, and time series forecasting using Spark Mllib, XGBoost, and LightGBM, ensuring seamless integration with PostgreSQL and DataBricks platforms.

6\. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define technology strategy, and align AI/ML architectures with evolving business needs and industry standards.
  
7\. Architect and implement RESTful API integrations to enable seamless communication between AI/ML components and external systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient data exchange across diverse enterprise environments.
  
8\. Architect and implement RESTful API integrations to enable seamless communication between AI/ML components and external systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient data exchange across diverse enterprise environments.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

1\. Expert proficiency in AI/ML model development, including classical ML, deep learning, NLP, and time series forecasting.
  
2\. Excellent skills in Python, R, SQL, and Bash for data manipulation, model training, and automation.
  
3\. Advanced expertise in TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, and LightGBM for building and deploying machine learning models.
  
4\. Excellent knowledge of distributed computing and data engineering with Apache Spark, Spark Mllib, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, and DataBricks.
  
5\. Solid understanding of relational databases, especially PostgreSQL and MySQL, for data storage and retrieval in ML workflows.
  
6\. Expert ability to design secure, scalable architectures and implement best practices for AI/ML solution delivery.
  
  

Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Modeling, Vector Databases.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

Skill Matrix – GenAI / ML (E3 Band)
  
  

The requirement is for a GenAI/ML professional with a total experience of 8\+ years (Technical Experience) and 5\+ years of relevant experience. The position is open across Pan India with preferred locations including Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai. Candidates should be willing to attend office physically if required in these locations.
  
The project type is primarily development\-oriented. The role is suitable for both individual contributors and those with team handling experience.
  
  

No shift work is involved in this role, and there will be no customer interview process. The sell rate is not applicable for this requirement.

The mandatory skills required include strong proficiency (Level 5\) in Python and machine learning model development. Candidates must also have expertise in technologies such as Kafka, Spark, and PostgreSQL, along with hands\-on experience in tools and frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and XGBoost.
  
  

In addition to the mandatory skills, the candidate should ideally have good\-to\-have proficiency (Level 4\) in R, Bash scripting, scikit\-learn, LightGBM, Spark MLlib, classical machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and time series forecasting. 0345a11f.title: Solution Architect
0345a11f.description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down \- it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like.
   

  

 OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**The Challenge**
 As a Solution Architect within the Design Partner Program, you will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating strategic customer requirements into scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions across OneTrust’s AI\-Ready Governance Platform. You will operate at the intersection of Product Management, Customer Engineering, Architecture, and Software Development, helping shape the future of Privacy, Consent, Risk, AI Governance, and Compliance solutions.
   

  

 You will work directly with strategic customers, Product Specialists, Engineering leaders, and Product Management teams to understand business objectives, identify architectural patterns, validate technical approaches, and accelerate delivery of customer\-driven innovations. Your role is not simply to solve today's customer problem, but to design solutions that scale across the broader OneTrust platform and customer base.
   

  

 Success in this role means accelerating customer adoption, reducing implementation complexity, improving product quality, influencing architecture strategy, and transforming customer requirements into differentiated platform capabilities that create long\-term competitive advantage.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Define Scalable Solution Architectures: Design and evolve scalable architectures spanning Privacy, Consent \& Preferences, Risk \& Governance, AI Governance, and Compliance solutions. Establish architectural patterns that balance customer flexibility with platform standardization and long\-term maintainability.
* Partner with Strategic Customers: Serve as the trusted technical advisor for Design Partner customers. Lead architecture workshops, solution reviews, integration assessments, and technical discovery sessions to understand complex business requirements and translate them into scalable solution designs.
* Bridge Product Vision and Technical Execution: Collaborate closely with Product Specialists, Product Management, and Engineering teams to validate designs, refine requirements, and ensure technical feasibility. Help transform customer feedback into product capabilities, reference architectures, and roadmap investments.
* Drive Platform and Integration Excellence: Define integration patterns, API strategies, data models, identity architectures, event\-driven workflows, and governance controls that enable customers to seamlessly connect OneTrust with their broader technology ecosystem. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and operationally resilient.
* Accelerate AI\-Powered Solution Innovation: Partner with engineering teams to apply AI\-driven approaches that simplify implementation, improve architecture decisions, accelerate troubleshooting, and enhance operational efficiency. Identify opportunities to leverage AI across customer solutions while maintaining governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Establish Technical Standards \& Best Practices: Drive architecture governance, design reviews, technical standards, and reusable implementation patterns across Customer Engineering and Product Engineering teams. Mentor engineers and architects while helping establish long\-term architectural consistency across the platform.


**You Are**
* A systems thinker who can balance customer requirements, product strategy, and platform scalability.
* Passionate about solving complex enterprise challenges through elegant technical solutions.
* Comfortable engaging with architects, engineers, product leaders, executives, and customer stakeholders.
* Customer\-obsessed and motivated by delivering measurable business outcomes through technology.
* Deeply technical while able to communicate architectural decisions in business terms.
* A collaborative leader who drives alignment across Product, Engineering, and Customer teams.
* Energized by creating reusable solutions that benefit both strategic customers and the broader market.


**Your Experience Includes**
* 8 \-12 years of software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise architecture experience.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale SaaS platforms and cloud\-native architectures.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration frameworks.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers on solution architecture, requirements analysis, and technical strategy.(Recommended enhancement for DPP alignment.)
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, container technologies, Kubernetes, messaging systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available systems for enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product direction through architecture leadership and customer insights.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present to executives, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience with Privacy, Consent, Risk, Governance, Security, Compliance, Data Management, or AI Governance domains preferred.
* Experience mentoring engineers and establishing architecture standards across multiple teams.


 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
   

  

 OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

0844e9c5.title: IN-Sr Technical Consultant - Cloud - AKS, Azure update manager, Azure automation, Patching, AZ-104 / AZ-400
0844e9c5.description:
**Scope**
 The Azure Infra Engineer \- Patching \& Maintenance keeps our Azure platform secure, current, and compliant by owning the end\-to\-end patch and maintenance lifecycle. This mid\-level role runs the weekly patch cycle across compute, containers, and platform services, and proactively tracks every core component against vendor End\-of\-Life / End\-of\-Support timelines, upgrading to supported versions before support lapses. It is a hands\-on operations role with a strong automation focus and close coordination with service owners, security, and DevOps.
   

  

**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Software: Azure Update Manager, Azure Automation, Azure Policy (Guest Configuration), PowerShell, Bash, and Azure CLI; ServiceNow for change management / CAB.
* Application Architecture: Microservices on AKS (Stratosphere), Portal Shell and Portal Collaboration runtimes, the Event Framework (Event Grid / Service Bus), IAM, and API Management (self\-hosted gateway).
* Cloud Architecture: Microsoft Azure \- Windows / Linux VMs, AKS node pools, MongoDB (Atlas), Entra ID / IAM, and APIM, with patch compliance and maintenance across every layer.
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes / Helm, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, vulnerability \& CVE remediation workflows, and EOL/EOS lifecycle tracking; WSUS / SCCM, Ansible / Terraform, and ITIL practices; AZ\-104 / AZ\-400 aligned.


**What You’ll Do**
* Plan and execute the weekly patch cycle for Windows/Linux VMs, AKS node pools, and platform middleware using Azure Update Manager and Azure Automation.
* Publish and maintain a rolling maintenance calendar, coordinating patch windows with service owners to minimise business disruption.
* Track OS, runtime, and dependency versions across IAM, APIM, MongoDB, Stratosphere, Portal Shell/Collaboration, and the Event Framework against vendor EOL/EOS timelines, and plan upgrade paths to supported or LTS versions well ahead of EOL.
* Test patches and upgrades in non\-production and validate rollback procedures before every production rollout.
* Automate patch deployment and compliance reporting using Azure Update Manager, Azure Policy guest configuration, and Automation runbooks; monitor compliance dashboards and remediate non\-compliant resources within SLA.
* Coordinate emergency, out\-of\-band patching for critical CVEs and zero\-day vulnerabilities with the security team.
* Manage AKS cluster and node image upgrades, Helm chart bumps, and container base image refresh cycles; renew TLS certificates, keys, and secrets nearing expiry with the IAM team.
* Maintain patch and maintenance documentation (change records, rollback plans, validation checklists) and report weekly patch compliance and EOL risk status to engineering leadership.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5\-8 years in infrastructure operations, patch management, or SRE roles, with proven ability to plan and execute maintenance windows at minimal service disruption.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Update Manager, Azure Automation, and Azure Policy guest configuration; patching Windows Server and Linux VM fleets at scale.
* Familiarity with AKS node image upgrades and Kubernetes version lifecycle management, plus EOL/EOS lifecycle tracking for OS, databases, and middleware.
* Experience with change management (ServiceNow CAB, scheduled maintenance windows) and vulnerability / CVE remediation workflows.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Azure CLI for patch automation; AZ\-104 or AZ\-400 certification preferred.
* Nice to have: WSUS / SCCM, MongoDB Atlas automated upgrades, Ansible / Terraform, ITIL Foundation, and experience building EOL/EOS dashboards or CMDB integrations.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

 You will be embedded in the product and delivery team, working closely with engineering leads, product managers, and client\-facing teams. You will interface regularly with senior stakeholders — both internal and at client organizations — to ensure programs are defined, tracked, and delivered with precision.
 



  





**What will you do?** 




 This is a hands\-on, technically grounded program management role. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of product and integration programs — from requirements through deployment — while coordinating across engineering, QA, and business teams.
 



  





**Technical Responsibilities (70%)** 



* Own the full program lifecycle: requirements gathering, sprint planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and release coordination
* Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Drive system integrations with enterprise clients — APIs, SSO, MDM, DLP, and other enterprise infrastructure components
* Manage technical onboarding for enterprise deployments, ensuring smooth configuration, data migration, and go\-live execution
* Identify technical bottlenecks, escalate risks proactively, and drive resolution across cross\-functional teams
* Maintain program dashboards, technical documentation, integration runbooks, and delivery trackers
* Collaborate with QA to define test plans, oversee UAT cycles, and ensure quality gates are met before release



  





**Commercial \& Stakeholder Responsibilities (30%)** 



* Act as the single point of contact for assigned enterprise accounts post\-deployment, managing stakeholder communications and escalations
* Coordinate with client CIOs, CISOs, and IT teams to align on timelines, scope changes, and delivery expectations
* Support the business team in scoping new client requirements, estimating delivery effort, and contributing to proposals
* Contribute to client health reviews, ensuring measurable outcomes and long\-term retention



  





**Who should apply?** 



* 2–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager — preferably in a SaaS, enterprise tech, or consulting environment
* Prior experience in a BA or PM role is essential — you must have owned requirements, written specs, and managed delivery timelines
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology environments: APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, security protocols, and enterprise IT workflows
* Proficiency with program management tools (Jira, Confluence, Asana, or equivalents) and documentation practices
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you must be equally comfortable writing a technical specification and presenting a program update to a CXO
* Ability to distil complex technical topics into clear, structured language for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* High ownership mindset — you notice what needs doing and you do it without being told
* MBA or engineering degree from a reputed institution preferred; equivalent demonstrated capability will be considered



  





**What's in it for you?** 




 Market\-rate compensation. In 2–4 years in this role, you will have delivered complex technology programs across India’s largest enterprises, built a credible technical and commercial track record, and developed relationships that most professionals take a decade to form.
 



  





 You will gain deep expertise at the intersection of enterprise technology and program delivery, develop a strong CXO\-level network, and grow into a role with significant scope and influence. For those who perform exceptionally, there will be an opportunity to participate in meaningful wealth creation.
 



  





**A word about the pace** 




 WrkTalk moves fast. Very fast. You may find yourself flying to multiple cities in the same week — sometimes changing more than one airport in a day. This is a
 **high\-intensity, high\-velocity environment** 
 where the learning curve is steep, the exposure is extraordinary, and we expect a lot.
 



 The pace is not for everyone, and we respect that. But if you find
 **energy in ambiguity** 
 , ownership in challenges, and have the grit to push through a door that isn't yet open — this will be one of the most
 **transformative chapters** 
 of your professional life.

9bff2cc3.title: Senior Engagement Manager, Developer Transformation
9bff2cc3.description:
**Description**
 Are you ready to lead the AI\-driven transformation of how enterprise software teams build, ship, and scale? Do you combine deep technical credibility with strategic business acumen to drive measurable developer productivity outcomes at Fortune 500 companies? Can you operate independently in ambiguous environments — setting direction when strategy is unclear and turning undefined opportunities into quantifiable business impact?
   

  

 As a Senior Engagement Manager for Developer Transformation (DevTx), AWS India, you will own end\-to\-end strategy and execution of AI\-native developer transformation programs across India's largest enterprise customers. You will lead complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements where scope, ownership, and success criteria are often undefined — bringing clarity, setting direction, and driving documented business outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering and business stakeholders, connecting developer AI adoption to measurable business value (productivity gains, time\-to\-market acceleration). You will build mechanisms that scale impact beyond individual engagements, shaping how AWS's developer transformation methodology is delivered across the APJ region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the India AI\-DLC engagement pipeline — proactively identify, qualify, and prioritize developer transformation opportunities across ISVs, GSIs, FSI, and Enterprise segments by diving deep into customers' engineering organization structures, technology stacks, and business priorities. Define intake criteria and triage mechanisms that enable scale across the team. Convert undefined customer interest into scoped, investment\-justified engagement proposals with clear success metrics and ROI projections.
* Develop and articulate executive\-level narratives that connect developer transformation to business outcomes — productivity ROI, innovation velocity, and competitive differentiation. Tailor value propositions by industry vertical and customer maturity, and present independently to VP/CxO\-level engineering and business leaders.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with Solutions Architects, Developer Specialist SAs, and field teams to design and execute AI\-native engineering transformation programs — including AI\-DLC workshops, and Kiro and developer tool adoption accelerators. Own engagement architecture and sequencing decisions. Resolve technical ambiguity by making informed trade\-offs.
* Own end\-to\-end engagement lifecycle — from qualification and scoping through delivery, measurement, and post\-engagement follow\-up — for complex enterprise developer transformation programs. Manage a portfolio of 8\-12 concurrent engagements across industries (FSI, manufacturing, technology, telecom), ensuring progress toward documented, measurable outcomes. Track and report pipeline metrics (ARR, opportunity conversion, engagement\-to\-launch ratio) with full accountability for India DevTx program targets.
* Design engagement governance structures — defining scope, success criteria, escalation paths, and exit criteria — in partnership with customer technical and business stakeholders. Evaluate feasibility, long\-term value realization potential, and AWS investment ROI before committing resources. Establish systems that ensure consistent engagement quality and eliminate non\-differentiated work through automation and reusable frameworks.
* Drive alignment across AWS internal teams (account managers, solutions architects, specialist teams) and customer organizations (engineering leadership, platform teams, developer communities). Navigate competing priorities and organizational politics to maintain momentum on transformation initiatives. Serve as the single thread connecting customer business outcomes to AWS technical delivery.
* Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior engineering leaders (VP/Director level) within customer organizations. Be recognized as the go\-to person for developer platform strategy and AI\-driven engineering transformation. Engage occasionally with C\-suite executives on strategic transformation vision and engagement decisions.
* Guide customers in designing their AI\-native software development operating models — from tool adoption (Kiro) through methodology transformation (AI\-DLC framework) to organizational change management. Ensure transformation initiatives deliver verified, quantified business outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Capture and systematize learnings from engagements into reusable assets (playbooks, case studies, enablement content) that multiply team effectiveness. Provide actionable customer feedback to AWS teams that informs DevTx charter and strategy. Contribute to thought leadership through internal blogs, external case studies, and conference presentations.
* Coordinate with APJ and Global DevTx peers on cross\-geography engagement opportunities, shared customer programs, and methodology standardization. Represent India DevTx in regional forums and contribute to scaling successful India engagement patterns across APJ.


 What Makes This Role Unique
   

  

 This is not a traditional Engagement Manager or Professional Services role. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Own programs, not projects — drive multi\-quarter customer transformation journeys, not time\-boxed billable engagements
* Combine strategy with execution — present transformation roadmaps to VPs of Engineering one day, then triage intake queues and unblock engagements the next
* Own business outcomes — be accountable for pipeline metrics, opportunity conversion, and ARR — not just engagement satisfaction scores


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your days will be varied and high\-impact. One morning you might be reviewing a customer's AI\-DLC workshop feedback, refining the follow\-up plan that converts a successful prototype into a production adoption roadmap with clear revenue implications.
   

  

 Later that day, you could be presenting a transformation case to a customer's leadership team — articulating why their 5,000\-developer engineering org needs a structured AI\-native development program and what the expected business outcome looks like in 6 months.
   

  

 Between meetings, you'll triage new engagement requests in the intake queue — qualifying a GSI's ask for Kiro enablement, deprioritizing a low\-signal opportunity, and connecting an account team with the right specialist SA for a complex developer transformation scoping and review.
   

  

 You'll spend time building — creating reusable engagement frameworks, updating pipeline trackers, and authoring the narrative that justifies expanding DevTx's footprint into new customer segments. You'll collaborate with your global peers to exchange learnings, align on methodology standards, and identify customers with cross\-geography presence that need coordinated engagement strategies.
   

  

 This role requires balancing strategic executive engagement with operational program management — you'll shift between leadership conversations and intake triage daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) India team leads the next generation of software development practices across India's largest enterprises. We help engineering teams adopt AI\-native development methodologies and AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) transformations — compressing development timelines from months to days and weeks. Our team works directly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering to accelerate developer productivity at scale.
   

  

 We operate with high ownership, transparency, and autonomy — every team member owns their engagements from intake to outcome. This is a small, high\-impact team where your work directly shapes how major Indian enterprises build software.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of leading large\-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 6\+ years of customer\-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
* Experience leading technical and non\-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle, including design, development, test, build, deployment processes and timelines
* PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
* Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
* Experience with AI/ML\-assisted development tools, developer productivity platforms, or DevOps/platform engineering transformation


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

753795df.title: Associate Customer Program Manager - Injection Molding (IM)
753795df.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**


MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.


**\*\*Work Hours:** **9:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)\*\***


**F****ictiv exists to help product innovators create**


Fictiv is a global manufacturing and supply chain company that enables organizations to scale globally across Fictiv’s four global manufacturing centers in India, Mexico, China, and the U.S. Companies use Fictiv to access high\-quality production, optimize supply chain logistics, and mitigate supply chain risk, ensuring they can move from prototype to full\-scale manufacturing with speed and confidence.


To date, Fictiv has delivered more than **35 million commercial and prototype parts** for industries such as aerospace, robotics, automotive, climate tech, and more, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.


**Job Description**


Are you ready to shake up the world of customer service? Do you thrive on making connections and solving complex manufacturing challenges? If you’re passionate about putting customers first in a dynamic, fast\-paced manufacturing environment, we want YOU on our team.


In your role as **Associate Customer Program Manager – Injection Molding (IM)**, you will work directly with US\-based customers supporting injection molded part programs from prototype through production. You will leverage your injection molding expertise, problem\-solving skills, and customer advocacy to help customers successfully launch and scale their products.


You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including manufacturing operations, quality, tooling engineering, supply chain, and logistics to manage injection molding programs end\-to\-end. Your role will focus on ensuring tooling readiness, production execution, quality expectations, and on\-time delivery while proactively resolving issues that arise during program execution.


You will support multiple customers across a variety of injection molding programs executed through Fictiv’s global manufacturing network.


**Work Hours:** 9:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)


This role follows a hybrid work schedule – 3 nights in office, 2 nights remote.


**What you will be doing**


* **Customer Management**  

Act as the primary advocate for customers running injection molding programs through Fictiv. Build strong relationships with customers to ensure a seamless, high\-quality experience from tooling kickoff through production.
* **Injection Molding Program Execution**  

Support customers with injection molding programs including tooling development, DFM alignment, first article validation, production ramp, and ongoing manufacturing support. Ensure technical and operational alignment across teams.
* **Case Management**  

Manage multiple injection molding orders and programs concurrently across customers and internal operations teams. Prioritize and resolve requests to meet customer expectations for timing, quality, and manufacturability.
* **Technical Communication**  

Gather, interpret, and communicate design intent, DFM feedback, tooling considerations, molding parameters, and quality requirements to ensure orders are executed successfully.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

Work closely with sales, tooling engineers, manufacturing partners, and quality teams to resolve issues, address manufacturability concerns, and drive successful program outcomes.
* **Program Management**  

Provide top\-down oversight across the entire lifecycle of injection molding programs, ensuring delivery against scope, quality standards, and schedule commitments.
* **Continuous Improvement**  

Identify opportunities to improve processes related to injection molding program execution, customer communication, and operational efficiency, and partner with cross\-functional teams to implement improvements.

**Desired Traits**


* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or Tool Engineering. Diploma or advanced certification in Tool \& Die / Tool Engineering from recognized tool room institutes (e.g., NTTF, CITD, IGTR, CTTC) is also acceptable. MBA is a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience in injection molding project management, manufacturing operations, supply chain, or customer\-facing manufacturing roles required.
* Strong understanding of injection molding processes, including tooling development, DFM considerations, part design for manufacturability, production ramp, and quality control.
* Experience supporting NPI programs, prototype tooling, bridge tooling, and production injection molding programs.
* Experience working with global manufacturing partners or contract manufacturers is preferred.
* PMP or project management certification and familiarity with program management frameworks is a plus.
* The work is fast\-paced. You will operate in an execution\-driven environment with tight timelines and high quality standards. Strong organization, prioritization, and attention to detail are essential.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to translate technical manufacturing topics into clear customer\-facing updates. Must be fluent in written and spoken English.
* Experience working directly with US\-based customers and/or during US business hours is preferred.
* This role requires a self\-starter mindset with strong ownership and accountability. You should be comfortable operating in a hands\-on, high\-performance environment focused on delivering measurable outcomes for customers.
* Aligned with our culture of continuous learning, you should have a strong interest in expanding knowledge across the manufacturing ecosystem and new product development processes.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

1f44af0e.description:
**Netradyne** 
 harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern\-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward\-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
   

  

**Role : Sr. Technical Program Manager (Product Development)**
**Experience : 10 to 15 years**
**Summary:**
 As a Technical Program Manager / Sr. Technical Program Manager, you will own electronic product development programs end\-to\-end — from ideation and concept definition through prototyping, design, validation, commercialization / industrialization, and final delivery. You will orchestrate cross\-functional teams spanning hardware, software / firmware, mechanical, quality, operations, sourcing and product management, alongside external partners such as ODMs, contract manufacturers and component suppliers. You will be accountable for the program plan, schedule, budget, risks and overall execution, ensuring the right product is delivered at the right cost, quality and time. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating both rapid Agile software cycles and structured hardware stage\-gate development, remaining flexible and calm in the face of uncertainty.
   

  

**Responsibilities \-**
* Own the end\-to\-end program lifecycle of electronic products from ideation to delivery, integrating hardware, software / firmware, mechanical and industrial design workstreams into a single executable plan.
* Drive disciplined stage\-gate execution across concept, prototyping, EVT, DVT, PVT and mass production, ensuring entry / exit criteria are met at each phase.
* Create and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, dependency maps and risk registers; surface critical path and proactively remove impediments.
* Plan and manage prototyping and bring\-up cycles, coordinating board bring\-up, integration, debug and iteration loops between hardware and firmware teams.
* Drive design and manufacturability reviews (DFM / DFA / DFT), BOM maturity, design\-for\-cost and design\-for\-reliability discussions with engineering and suppliers.
* Lead commercialization / industrialization activities — NPI ramp, manufacturing line setup and transfer, tooling, first\-article and yield improvement at the contract manufacturer.
* Coordinate certification and regulatory compliance (EMC, safety, ingress and applicable automotive / regional standards) within the program timeline.
* Partner with sourcing and operations on component qualification, supplier readiness, lead times and supply continuity.
* Manage cost, schedule and scope; track program health, costs and roadmaps through clear, communicable dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.
* Run Agile / Scrum for software and firmware deliverables, Kanban for recurring activities, and milestone\-based tracking for hardware; flex the model to fit each workstream.
* Communicate status, risks and trade\-offs to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders; build consensus and enable visibility across the organization.
* Plan achievable goals working with vendor / partner PMs and internal cross\-functional teams; make timely corrections and alternative plans to keep final deliverables on time.


**Requirements And Skills \-**
* Proven experience program managing electronic / electro\-mechanical product development end\-to\-end, from ideation through to delivery.
* Hands\-on exposure across the full stack — hardware, embedded software / firmware and mechanical — with the ability to converse credibly with each function.
* Demonstrated experience taking products through prototyping and into commercialization / industrialization and mass production.
* Strong program planning, risk management and cross\-functional leadership skills, with experience managing external manufacturing and supplier partners.
* Comfortable operating in both Agile development and structured hardware stage\-gate (EVT / DVT / PVT) environments.


**Desired Qualifications:**
* B.E / B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Computer Science Engineering.
* MBA is a plus.
* TPM: 8\+ years of Technical Program Management experience in an electronic product development scenario; Sr. TPM: 12\+ years, including ownership of full product programs.
* Hands\-on experience across SDLC and hardware product development (EVT / DVT / PVT), with successful delivery of commercial high\-tech electronic products from ideation to market.
* Experience in commercializing / industrializing new hardware products and managing the transfer to contract manufacturing.
* Familiarity with integrating edge devices with cloud platforms is advantageous.
* Proficient in MS Project, JIRA, Confluence, Tableau, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SQL.

* Hands\-on Agile experience or Scrum certification is a plus.

**About:**




  





 Odessa is a global technology company and a leading provider of asset finance software solutions, serving many of the world’s top financial institutions and equipment leasing organizations. Headquartered in the United States with a strong presence in India, Odessa delivers an enterprise platform that helps clients modernize leasing, lending, and asset management operations at scale.
 



  





 Odessa’s platform combines deep domain expertise, extensible architecture, broad integration, and modern digital capabilities to support complex business operations across the asset finance lifecycle. Odessa partners closely with clients deliver scalable, innovative solutions that improve efficiency, accelerate transformation, and create measurable business value.
 



  





**Primary role:**




  





 Odessa’s Platform Engineering team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross\-functional technology programs that support platform scalability, delivery excellence, and customer impact. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into actionable program plans and drive successful execution.
 



  





 The ideal candidate brings strong technical judgment, structured program governance, stakeholder influence, and the ability to improve delivery practices across teams. This is an opportunity to play a key role in advancing Odessa’s platform roadmap and enabling high\-quality outcomes for enterprise clients.
 



  





**What you'll do:**




  





 You will lead end\-to\-end delivery of high\-impact platform programs — taking complex, cross\-functional initiatives from early definition through production, with direct ownership and accountability for outcomes. This is a hands\-on role that requires equal comfort driving strategy in ambiguous environments and executing with precision in fast\-moving ones.
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Odessa’s platform programs — driving successful delivery against defined business and technical objectives, with accountability for execution, coordination, and program outcomes.
* Operate across teams and architectures, owning the gaps between teams, processes, and systems—defining program structure, anticipating bottlenecks, managing critical dependencies, and aligning organizations before friction becomes a delivery risk.
* Apply strong technical judgment to understand complex technical designs, surface trade\-offs, and facilitate alignment across engineering teams.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks across the full delivery pipeline — and enforce a rigorous definition of done that goes beyond code complete to include operational readiness, data integrity, and measurable customer adoption
* Continuously improving delivery processes by identifying recurring friction points and implementing scalable solutions that improve predictability and execution efficiency.
* Communicate program progress, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership, driving decision\-making, alignment, and consensus on complex technical and business priorities.
* Drive capacity planning and forecasting in partnership with engineering leaders, ensuring investments align to strategic priorities and delivery commitments.
* Contribute to the growth of Odessa's TPM community by sharing best practices, improving program management artifacts, and helping elevate execution standards across teams.



  





**Core qualifications:**




  




* 8–12 years of overall experience, with at least 4–6 years in program or technical program management, engineering leadership — demonstrating clear progression in scope, complexity, and cross\-functional ownership
* Deep understanding of Agile practices and software development processes — experienced working across multiple scrum teams, with a track record of real dependency and integration management across complex, cross\-functional programs
* Technical fluency to engage credibly in engineering discussions, understand system architectures and design principles, and evaluate the technical trade\-offs that shape platform decisions.
* Experience in banking, financial services, or enterprise software preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to synthesize technical complexity into clear, concise updates for a wide range of audiences
* Analytical and data\-driven approach to problem solving, with the ability to leverage data, investigate discrepancies, and build reporting mechanisms that provide meaningful program visibility and decision support.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience



  





**Preferred qualifications:**




  




* Experience using project and knowledge management tools such as JIRA and Confluence to drive program execution and documentation.
* Experience delivering programs in a platform or product development environment
* Domain experience in lending, leasing, or asset finance
* Experience contributing to program management best practices through the development of standards, playbooks, operating mechanisms, or success metrics in a dynamic and evolving environment



  





**Our commitment to you:**




  





 At Odessa, we are committed to creating an environment where talented professionals can do meaningful work, grow their capabilities, and make a measurable impact. We provide opportunities to work on complex enterprise technology programs, collaborate with high\-performing teams, and contribute to solutions that support leading financial institutions and asset finance organizations around the world.
 



  





 We value ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation. As part of Odessa, you will be encouraged to bring fresh ideas, strengthen delivery practices, and help shape scalable platform outcomes in a culture that supports professional development, inclusion, and long\-term career growth.

44364237.title: Technical Program Manager
44364237.description:
**Background** 




 Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep\-tech startup democratising clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.
 



  





**Why** 




 Everyone worries about the dooms\-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.
 



  





 As the Technical Program Manager at Praan, you will partner with the Founder and technical teams to ensure that the company's technology outcomes are met successfully within defined timeframes. You would be responsible for ensuring resource planning, time planning, and exceptional cross\-team communication to test and deliver products and services on time.
 



  





**Job Description** 



* Partner with the founder to drive the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple complex technical programs, ensuring alignment with company goals, quality standards, and timelines
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including scope, milestones, timelines, and resource allocations
* Set clear goals and objectives for project teams, and ensure all team members understand their roles and responsibilities
* Ensure resource planning and availability basis project plans to ensure the team is adequately resourced to achieve desired outcomes.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between diverse technical teams, ensuring seamless integration of hardware, software, and engineering disciplines
* Collaborate closely with technical leads to manage technical risks and address challenges as they arise
* Identify potential risks, issues, and bottlenecks that may impact project delivery, and develop proactive mitigation strategies
* Troubleshoot technical issues and conflicts that may arise during the development process, working closely with teams to find effective solutions
* Ensure that all projects meet quality standards and technical specifications by implementing rigorous testing and validation processes
* Conduct regular reviews of project deliverables to confirm alignment with technical and business requirements
* Drive the adoption of best practices in project management, Agile methodologies, and team collaboration to enhance efficiency and productivity
* Prepare and present detailed program reports to senior management, highlighting key metrics, project milestones, and potential roadblocks



  





**Skill Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electronics Engineering, or a related field
* Proven experience in shipping complex hardware products and managing multiple product lines from concept to launch
* Proven experience of managing technical teams of 20 or more team members, in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* 4\+ years of experience in technical program management or a related role
* Strong understanding of engineering principles across Electrical, Embedded, Mechanical, Computer Vision, Software, Chemical engineering
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies, with experience in implementing these practices in project management
* Proven ability to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels
* Strong leadership and team\-building skills, with a collaborative approach to working with diverse teams



  





**Praan is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, caste, gender, disability or any other criteria. We just care about working with great human beings!**

c6aec82e.title: Technical Program Manager, Network Capacity Planning
c6aec82e.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience partnering with Data Science teams or directly leveraging machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting models, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Experience in network capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or supply\-demand matching.
* Proficiency in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, and data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheet software) to synthesize complex capacity metrics and performance loops.
* Strong foundational knowledge of network infrastructure concepts, including network routing, peering, cache infrastructure (CDN), or capacity placement.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 As a Network Capacity Planner, you will ensure Google Cloud’s growth by guaranteeing network capacity is delivered efficiently and on time to support products and customers. Operating across critical planning and execution horizons, you will blend a deep understanding of network fundamentals with machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting, automate anomaly detection, and simulate complex capacity scenarios.
   

  

 Acting as a key technical collaborator alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers, you will navigate customer requirements, mitigate supply stockouts, and manage inventory buffers. Your work will directly balance resource efficiency with high availability, safeguarding infrastructure performance and driving strategic demand attainment across the global network fleet.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leverage deep knowledge of network fundamentals to understand critical paths, skillfully navigate complex customer requirements, and co\-develop tailored solutions alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers.
* Own the execution window, capturing large agreement requirements and navigating network lead times.
* Build forecasting models leveraging machine learning and AI to improve predictive accuracy, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Mitigate supplies shortages, maintain optimal inventory levels, manage policy\-based buffers, and plan for major peak traffic events.
* Collaborate to build AI\-assisted automation for ordering and resource fulfillment while designing metrics to track fleet efficiency and demand attainment.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

c32d232c.title: Technical Program Manager 5
c32d232c.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This job leads technical programs strategically, aligning with organizational goals and managing cross\-functional teams for successful outcomes. It requires technical expertise, leadership, and influence on organizational objectives. The role is key to driving program success and organizational development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**
* Understanding technical program scopes, participating in milestone planning, and ensuring alignment with product, business, and budgetary requirements
* Leading cross\-functional teams, clarifying roles and responsibilities, and fostering collaboration for the duration of the program
* Creating, building, and maintaining detailed program plans and records, managing critical path tasks effectively
* Identifying program goals and success criteria, driving their development and implementation with stakeholders and the core team
* Resolving conflicts with management engagement, building consensus, and assigning resources to program plans
* Recommending improvements to engineering processes, alleviating inaccuracy and duplication, and performing resource forecasting
* Analyzing risks, establishing contingency plans, and initiating corrective actions to maintain program integrity
* Communicating program updates, managing changes, and ensuring all stakeholders are informed of progress and issues
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**Employees at all levels are expected to:**
* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.


**Disclaimer:** 
 This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.
   

  

 Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non\-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best\-in\-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality \- to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.
   

  

**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree
   

  

 While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.
   

  

**Relevant Work Experience**
 10 Years \+

458f6394.title: Architect, Apps & AI
458f6394.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**  

The focus of the Domain Solution Architect role is to Make the Market and drive Digital Transformation and Modernization Solutions with deeper focus on the Technology and Service Offerings that are specific to each of the Microsoft Consulting Services Domains. The Architect also plays a key role in driving the entire lifecycle of large and complex projects, early pre\-sales, delivery oversight and also responsible for architectural and technical success for our customers. They will lead in identifying and creatively solving complex customer problems, envisioning and enabling critical processes, and fundamentally helping the customer to achieve their objectives.  

  

The Architect must be effective in fostering senior level relationships. They also play a key role in employing, leveraging partners as part of the overall Microsoft services delivery model  

  

**The Architects responsibilities will include:** Drive \& Accelerate production\-level Cloud Solutions in line with Customer and Microsoft strategy. Make the Market with innovative Digital Transformation and Modernization projects. Providing customer guidance during envisioning solution \& benefits, defining workloads \& methodology, project scope and sizing. Drive a positive Customer Experience by providing high quality delivery on strategic, complex deals, demonstrate Technical Leadership: Create Clarity, Generate Energy and Deliver Success Playing a vital part in business strategy by providing risk assessment, reviewing proposals, identifying new Services development area based on market trends, and customer expectations. Driving successful solution deployments by ensuring proper business value and customer/partner satisfaction. Technically driving Microsoft and partners team to secure delivery of the solution in the defined scope of work. Growing the business through mentoring, talent pipeline development, and community evangelism and sharing experiences to develop assets within the Azure Community. Growing the Business by transforming Services opportunity to Projects with intentional selling of applicable packaged Microsoft Services Offerings. Provide guidance and support around scope definition and solution architecture during services sales cycle and make it a winning proposal. Driving operational excellence and innovation, leveraging new ideas contributing to increase Microsoft value to customers. **Experience required for this role includes:** Engagement / Stakeholder management. Successfully demonstrated leadership in 5\+ years as solution architecture for enterprise class customers. Excellent Communication (up / down/ peers). Proven track level in business domain \& technical conversation. Holistic Infrastructure solution, design and architecture. Proven experience in presales and closing . Previous track record delivering the full project life cycle.  

  

**A strong focus on below technologies is required:** Deep domain expertise of cloud infrastructure solutions including Subscription Design, Identity and access management, Network topology and connectivity, Storage, Monitoring, Compute. Knowledge on Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well Architecture Framework (WAF), Zero Trust Security Framework. Knowledge on Application Architecture, Migration of Infrastructure services to Azure IaaS / Pass, Greenfield deployment\- optimization of applications, automation using Infrastructure\-as\-Code. Knowledge on Networking fundamentals\- VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, Ingress/Egress patterns and services. Knowledge about OSS, Docker Containers, Kubernetes and related architectures. Knowledge On Various DevOps Tools and Technologies: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub. Knowledge on using integrated development environments \- Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code. **Other** Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications** **Required/Minimum Qualifications**  

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.

eee68045.title: Solutions Specialist - Presales
eee68045.description:
**Role Purpose\-**
 To support business development efforts by guiding and overseeing the demonstration and delivery of Nucleus’ platforms \& solutions as a part of client sales pitches and provide support in client management at the demo stage.
   

  

**Areas of Responsibility\-**
**Product Demonstration\-**
* Participate in sales strategy meetings and offer inputs based on market/competitor information and internal analysis.
* Ensure that support is provided to sales teams during pitches through product demonstrations and presentations that best highlight the product’s features, utility and competitive advantage to potential clients.
* Engage, question, and participate in deep\-dive discussions/ value workshops with customers and/or Sales team for thorough understanding of customers' existing scenarios, business drivers, pain\-points, gaps, competition, core objectives; seek clarity on and understand customers' evaluation processes \& key evaluation criteria.
* Lead and conduct clients demos or workshops for large account pitches and offer inputs based on client requirements and product features.
* Act as a product evangelist and highlight benefits of product features to clients as well as internal teams.
* Conduct GA Sanity Testing after GA release deployed in Pre\-Sales servers.


**RFPs\-**
* Thoroughly review the RFP document to understand the client's requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission guidelines.
* Identify key stakeholders and subject matter experts needed for the response.
* Collaborate with technical experts to design a solution that meets the client's needs.
* Ensure the proposed solution aligns with the company's capabilities and strategic goals.
* Draft responses for each section of the RFP, including functional aspects and Executive Summary.
* Use existing content libraries and past proposals to streamline the writing process.
* Ensure that all responses comply with the RFP requirements and guidelines.
* Verify that all mandatory information and documents are included.
* Conduct internal reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Edit the content to improve readability and impact.
* Identify potential risks associated with the proposed solution and develop mitigation strategies.
* Document any assumptions and dependencies.
* Perform a final review of the entire RFP response to ensure completeness and quality.
* Prepare for potential presentations, demos or discussions with the client post\-submission.


**Relationship Building\-**
* Liaise with client stakeholders and ensure all requirements are gathered in order to structure the product demos and other supporting collaterals
* Engage with prospective clients and industry leaders to understand business challenges and incorporate changes in internal procedures


**Process Improvement\-**
* Stay up to date with industry leading best practices and latest trends and offer insights to sales teams as well as product development teams.
* Implement new processes and tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of product demonstrations.


**People Management\-**
* Review MIS reports created by Pre\-sales Executives; analyze and provide insights to senior stakeholders as required.
* Manage, mentor and inspire a team and team members including managing performance, goals and development potential, and evaluate potential new talent.
* Provide support to resolve conflict between multiple work streams / groups; provide inputs on goal setting and performance appraisals of team members; identify training needs for associates based on the client requirements.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices across the team; provide support to team members to achieve their knowledge goals and build expertise.


**Requirements**
* Detailed Knowledge of Products and Solutions.
* Good understanding of the target domain/industry.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a customer\-centric approach.
* Proven networking and relationship\-building skills to establish and maintain strong connections with customers, partners, and internal teams.


**Benefits**
 Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the internal talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

* Drive multi\-year technology roadmaps, modern platform architectures, and operating models
* Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, cost\-efficient, and aligned with business objectives
* Architect and oversee large\-scale managed services engagements, including application management, cloud operations, and platform engineering

* 22\-30 years of overall experience
