* Demonstrated ability to interact with and influence CXO\-level executives

* Thought leadership (public speaking, whitepapers, or blogs in architecture and AI/GenAI)

7b318958.description:
**Req ID:** 380554
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Technical Product Owner \- AI Digital Solutions (CDMO) to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Job Title \- Technical Product Owner – AI Digital Solutions (CDMO)
  
  

Department \- Digital Technology / Pharmaceutical Services Group (PSG)
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Owner – AI Digital Solutions (CDMO) to lead the identification, prioritization, and delivery of AI\-enabled digital products across our global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) network.
  
  

This role combines deep expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing, GxP regulatory compliance, AI\-driven digital transformation, product ownership, and business consulting to accelerate enterprise\-wide innovation. The successful candidate will serve as the strategic bridge between manufacturing sites, business domain experts, the Pharmaceutical Services Group (PSG), Digital Technology, Data Science, and Engineering teams.
  
  

The Technical Product Owner will identify high\-value AI opportunities, define product vision and roadmaps, prioritize business requirements, and ensure the delivery of scalable, compliant, and business\-centric digital solutions that improve manufacturing efficiency, product quality, compliance, and customer outcomes.

1b174e42.description:
Unlock your potential with Dassault Systèmes, a global leader in Scientific Software Engineering as an
 **Industry Solution Technical Consultant** 
**in** 
**Pune, India** 
 !
   

  

 The Consumer\-Packaged Goods \& Retail and Home \& Lifestyle Industry domains in Dassault Systèmes requires a strong candidate with expertise in 3DExperience DELMIA Digital Manufacturing. The Industry Solutions Technical team works for creating the right solution package for the various customer needs. They also create content for the demos and POCs used by the Tech Sales and Marketing teams. The goal is to help customers adopt 3DEXPERIENCE platform including DELMIA Digital Manufacturing in their capital facilities, such as Consumer Packaged Goods \& Retail Suppliers.
   

  

 A good functional user with knowledge on MBOM, Process planning and simulation is expected. The ideal candidate will also have a strong interest in handling production complexity, supply chain volatility and understanding of home \& lifestyle Industry regulatory compliance.
   

  

 Do you enjoy challenge? Here at Dassault Systèmes, we empower people with passion to change the world.
   

  

**Role Description \& Responsibilities**
* Create demo data to be used by the Tech Sales team for marketing and Sales purposes.
* Develop industry specific solution to showcase DELMIA Digital manufacturing capabilities.
* Develop technical documents and handbooks to accurately represent application design.
* Collaborate with the Industry Solutions team to set specifications for new applications / demonstrations using DELMIA Digital Manufacturing.
* Design creative prototypes/digital factories according to specifications
* Use your functional knowledge in DELMIA to produce high quality demo content
* Explore and master specialized applications such as point cloud and apply for the demo.


**Qualifications**
* 1\-2 years’ experience in 3DExperience – DELMIA (MUST)
* Defining MBOM, Bill of Processes (MUST)
* Simulation and Validation of context data for different manufacturing scenarios, which includes assembly process simulation, human ergonomics and robotics simulation (MUST)
* Knowledge of Factory Flow Simulation (Nice to have)
* Knowledge end to end Product development, Lifecycle management (MUST).
* Experience of working in a production line (assembly lines) of any discipline, Manufacturing Operation Management, tooling, and vendor development will be (ADDED ADVANTAGE)
* Knowledge on 3DSpace or ENOVIA (Nice to have).


**What’s In It For You**
* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Be at the forefront of building software products that are being deployed in mission\-critical projects world wide
* Be offered avenues to develop yourself for career progression
* Not a low\-level development opportunity, as you would get to work in the real business world and with a wide range of customers \& coworkers
* Work on a variety of technologies, products and solutions


 Inclusion statement
   

  

 As a game\-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

Description and Requirements
  
  

CareerArc Code
  
CA\-MM
  
  

\#LI\-MM1
  
  

**Hybrid:** \#LI\-Hybrid
  
  

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
  
  

We are looking for a Senior AI Data Architect / Solution Engineer to design the architecture that delivers trusted data at scale — and to build the AI products that put it directly in the hands of the business. This is a hands\-on, senior role for someone who can set the technical blueprint, build the agents on top of it, and act as the bridge between business needs and technical reality.
  
  

You will work closely with the Director and Enterprise Architect, serve as technical lead and advisor to the team, and partner with the Senior AI Data Engineer to take designs from blueprint to production. Success is measured by the trust, scale, and adoption of the data and AI products that ship — and by the business outcomes they unlock.
  
  

Here is how, through this role, you will contribute to BMC's and your own success:
  
  

* Architecture for Scale (Primary Focus) — Design the reference architecture and delivery patterns that take governed data from the semantic layer to every downstream consumer — dashboards, applications, and AI agents — reliably and at scale, with the build\-vs\-buy calls and standards that let the platform grow without painful rework.
* AI Data Products \& Agents — Architect and build the Data Agent, the natural\-language interface that lets business users query governed data without writing SQL; design agentic workflows with orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.
* Semantic Foundation — Co\-design the semantic layer (HoneyDew / DBT) — the metrics, dimensions, and governed business meaning that power both analytics and AI — ensuring agents query governed definitions, not raw tables.
* Technical Leadership — Serve as technical lead and trusted advisor; set patterns, run design reviews, and mentor engineers, partnering with the Data Engineer to take designs to production.
* Business Translation — Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements; own stakeholder relationships and move fluently between executive framing and engineering detail.
* Ownership \& Execution — Take features and subsystems end\-to\-end, proactively identifying gaps and driving work forward even when requirements are incomplete or evolving.


To ensure you're set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:
  
  

* 8\+ years across data architecture and hands\-on engineering, including production systems that held up under real enterprise use.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep, hands\-on experience designing and building on Snowflake and DBT.
* Proven experience designing and building LLM / agentic solutions — RAG, function / tool calling, orchestration (LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph), prompt engineering, and evaluation / observability.
* Deep understanding of the semantic layer as the architectural bridge between source data and business meaning — and why it is foundational to trustworthy AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders and influence architecture decisions across teams.
* Strong communication and the ability to lead through execution in a fast\-moving environment.


**Broad technical exposure (depth not required in all areas):**  

* Cloud\-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* CI/CD and modern engineering practices for data and AI systems.
* Containerization and distributed systems (Docker, Kubernetes, microservices).


Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills:
  
  

* HoneyDew or other universal/headless semantic layers (HoneyDew, Cube, AtScale, dbt Semantic Layer).
* Snowflake Cortex / Snowflake Intelligence, or production text\-to\-SQL systems.
* Prior technical\-lead or principal\-engineer role with mentorship responsibility.
* Background bridging pre\-sales / solution engineering and hands\-on delivery.


Our commitment to you!
  
  

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!
  
  

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!
  
  

BMC is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, age, sex, creed, color, religion, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy, disabled veteran or status as a protected veteran. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.
  
  

BMC Software maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.
  
  

At BMC we believe in pay transparency and have set the midpoint of the salary band for this role at 4,700,000 INR. Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
  
  

The salary listed is just one component of BMC's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.
  
  

We are committed to ensuring that our employees are paid fairly and equitably, and that we are transparent about our compensation practices.

f408c5cb.title: Solution / Enterprise Architect- Application Engineering
f408c5cb.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


As a **Solution/Enterprise/Lead Architect – Application Engineering** at EPAM, you will play a dual role as a technology leader and client partner. You will lead solution strategy, oversee architecture governance, and manage large\-scale managed services engagements. You will directly interact with CXO\-level stakeholders to define transformation roadmaps while guiding and mentoring teams of architects and engineers to deliver excellence.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and own the solution strategy for large\-scale digital transformation and managed services programs
* Drive multi\-year technology roadmaps, modern platform architectures, and operating models
* Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, cost\-efficient, and aligned with business objectives
* Architect and oversee large\-scale managed services engagements, including application management, cloud operations, and platform engineering
* Define SLAs, governance models, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement frameworks
* Ensure operational excellence through automation, AI/GenAI, and DevOps\-driven practices
* Stay hands\-on with architecture, proof\-of\-concepts, and technology exploration
* Lead technical due diligence, solution assessments, and modernization strategies
* Advocate for innovation, including cloud\-native, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and AI/GenAI\-enabled solutions
* Act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and other CXO\-level executives
* Bridge business strategy with technology execution, presenting clear roadmaps and business cases
* Lead pre\-sales, RFP/RFI responses, and executive\-level presentations to secure new business opportunities
* Lead a community of solution architects, principal engineers, and delivery leads across multiple geographies
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning
* Mentor senior architects on architecture best practices, client engagement, and managed services solutioning

**Requirements**

* 22\-30 years of overall experience
* 15\+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, and solution design, hands\-on architecture.
* Proven track record in leading large\-scale managed services programs (multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar engagements)
* Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), enterprise integration, and platform modernization
* Hands\-on experience with at least one programming language (Java, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python) along with GEN AI, AI architecture
* Strong expertise in service delivery models, SLAs/KPIs, and governance frameworks
* Experience with AI/GenAI integration in managed services (automation, predictive analytics, conversational AI, knowledge management), Implementing AI solutions hands\-on.
* GenAI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Langgraph,Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), Vector DB
* Demonstrated ability to interact with and influence CXO\-level executives
* Proven experience in IT consulting or global delivery organizations
* Excellent leadership, communication, and presentation skills

**Nice to have**

* Experience with AIOps, MLOps, and intelligent automation
* Strong business acumen to participate in contract negotiations, service pricing, and P\&L discussions
* Thought leadership (public speaking, whitepapers, or blogs in architecture and AI/GenAI)

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

**Job Description**
 As a key contributor within our team, the Product Architect plays a central role in defining the technical direction and roadmap for the Business Unit. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the technical vision and architecture strategy for the Business Unit, translating market and customer requirements into innovative and scalable product solutions.
   

  

 You will work closely with Product Management, customers, and industry forums to analyze requirements, define solution architectures, and shape the product roadmap. The role requires strong expertise in system analysis, solution design, effort estimation, and resource planning to ensure successful product development and delivery. As a key technical leader, you will influence architectural decisions, ensure alignment with customer expectations, and contribute to the development of next\-generation embedded telecom solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Translate business and product requirements into detailed solution architecture, including application, integration, deployment, security, and data design.
* Own and guide the configuration of cloud services and platform components in close collaboration with the DevOps and infrastructure teams.
* Continuously evaluate and keep cloud components, platform services, and related frameworks up to date based on research, best practices, scalability needs, and performance considerations.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making across cross\-functional teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve architecture\-level issues related to performance, scalability, deployment, and cloud platform behavior.
* Perform technical evaluation and proof\-of\-concept activities for new tools, frameworks, and cloud services before adoption.
* Mentor development teams and provide architectural leadership to ensure consistent implementation of best practices.
* Maintain architecture documentation and ensure all stakeholders have visibility into design decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-to\-have**
* Should have at least 10 years of experience in developing cloud\-based microservices applications. Experience with applications developed using Spring Boot and Java 8\+ is a plus and Experience in telecom domain, BSS/OSS, or large\-scale enterprise platforms is an added advantage.
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Industrial science or equivalent experience
* Should have experience in designing highly scalable architectures. Experience working as a Solution Architect for more than 5 years is a plus and ability to work with cross\-functional teams, including development, QA, DevOps, operations, and business stakeholders.
* Should have experience in defining solution architecture and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Should have experience working with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB and Cassandra.
* Should have experience working with distributed cache technologies such as Hazelcast and Redis.
* Should have experience working with messaging/queuing systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
* Should have familiarity with DevOps and cloud platform tools, such as load balancers, Kubernetes, Helm charts, and OpenShift storage and networking layers.
* Should have expertise in debugging field issues related to scalability and performance.
* Should have understanding of application security, secure coding practices, authentication/authorization, and common cloud security principles.

* Knowledge of AI/ML and MCP server development is a plus

03eb4b70.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to "Build and sell Microsoft AI, Cloud applications, services, and devices with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more," SME\&C Channel Partner Sales (CPS) is responsible for driving revenue outcomes with partners through innovative solutions–at scale. The Global Channel Partner Sales team delivers SME\&C growth and market share across AI Business Solutions, Cloud \& AI Platforms, and Security within GPS by capturing total addressable market (TAM) and accelerating cloud growth at scale through our top Channel Sales partner. Our approach is grounded in Cloud Solution Provider acceleration, co\-sell precision, and performance accountability—executed consistently across all solution areas and every stage of the MCEM Win Formula. We are committed to delivering on our segment and revenue accountabilities by aligning execution with measurable impact, fostering partner transformation, and enabling scalable, outcome\-driven growth.
   

  

 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will guide the development of business solutions, provide deep technical insights, and accelerate the growth of Microsoft Tech priorities. You will work closely with partners to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, and guide them through architectural design sessions, developing proof of concepts, and help them transition from legacy systems to modern cloud environments, ensuring that their solutions are optimized for performance and cost\-efficiency.
   

  

 Join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect and play a pivotal role in guiding our most significant partners to designing and implementing innovative scalable, secure, and efficient cloud architectures that meet market needs. By leveraging your skills in technical leadership, cloud computing, software development, problem solving and systems architecture, you will drive business impact by enabling digital transformation, optimizing performance, and driving innovation through the effective use of cloud technologies.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 As a Partner Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), you will serve as the deep technical SME to partners’ technical force \& own the partner’s technical strategy plan for their Cloud Solution Area (CSA). Withing your responsibilities are:
   

  

* Guide Solution Development \& Activation \- You’ll lead the development and activation of new or enhanced partner offerings that align with Microsoft Cloud priorities. Your focus will be on ensuring these solutions are robust, scalable, secure, and tailored to meet evolving customer needs.
* Empower Innovation \- You’ll run technical innovation workshops, tech briefings, and envisioning sessions to build technical intensity across partner teams. By collaborating with engineering and product teams, you’ll help accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies and shape partner offerings that align with both business goals and technical requirements.
* Strategic Sales Enablement \- You’ll play a key role in activating transformational deals by providing architectural guidance, resolving technical blockers, and enhancing solution design. Your work will directly contribute to workload consumption and revenue impact.
* Champion Technical Excellence \- You’ll guide partners through architecture design sessions, proof\-of\-concepts, and MVP builds. You’ll ensure that solutions follow Microsoft’s Cloud and AI best practices and are optimized for performance, scalability, and security.
* Thought Leadership \& Stakeholder Management \- You’ll build long\-term engagements with strategic partners, influencing their adoption of Microsoft technologies. You’ll develop deep technical relationships with CXOs and foster executive alignment to support joint success.
* Partner Enablement \& Business Acumen \- You’ll coach broader partner technical teams to ensure pre\-sales, deployment, and consumption are embedded in solution development. You’ll help partners build resilience to technical challenges, navigate competitive landscapes, and translate technical concepts into business value.

a5ac636d.title: Technical Architect
a5ac636d.description:
The Technical Architect provides enterprise\-level architectural leadership across application, data, cloud, and integration platforms. This role defines architecture blueprints, reference designs, standards, and reusable patterns that guide engineering teams, while partnering with business and technology stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. A meaningful portion of the role focuses on technical incubation and rapid prototyping to quickly validate new product concepts. This hands\-on role drives the 0\-to\-1 build of functional MVPs leveraging AI/ML, generative models, and multi\-agent workflows. Ultimately, this role establishes the security and scalability guardrails that turn successful proofs\-of\-concept into resilient, production\-ready architectures
   

  

**Essential Job Duties / Responsibilities**
* Define and maintain architecture blueprints, reference architectures, design standards, and platform patterns to ensure consistency and scalability across enterprise systems.
* Lead the hands\-on prototyping and rapid incubation of emerging technologies (including Applied AI, Multi\-Agent workflows, and Generative AI), solutioning with modern design patterns to safely and quickly extract value from legacy core systems without disrupting enterprise stability.
* Translate business and product requirements into end\-to\-end technical architecture, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, security controls, and operational readiness.
* Establish the technical foundation, sandbox environments, and engineering guardrails (e.g., cost monitoring, rate\-limiting, and error\-handling loops) required for the safe execution of autonomous and semi\-autonomous AI agents.
* Provide architectural leadership and technical direction across multiple concurrent initiatives and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead technical decision\-making, design reviews, and architectural governance, balancing competing priorities, cost, performance, and risk.
* Partner with solution and data architects to model and document interfaces between systems, including request/response APIs and asynchronous messaging.
* Mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
* Stay current on industry trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously enhance architecture capabilities.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Demonstrated experience producing architecture diagrams, detailed designs, and technical specifications for complex solutions.
* Deep hands\-on experience building 0\-to\-1 products or leading rapid\-delivery engineering initiatives within a highly ambiguous environment.
* Proven engineering experience implementing LLM\-orchestrated applications, RAG pipelines, and multi\-agent state machines (e.g., LangGraph).
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, microservices, API\-first design, and modern, fast\-to\-deploy backend/frontend frameworks.
* Working knowledge of security controls, compliance frameworks, and architectural governance practices.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, influence engineering decisions, and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Fluency in English; strong communication, problem\-solving, planning, and organizing skills.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or equivalent formal training. TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred
   

  

 Experience: Six to seven (6\-7\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing, and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management

e30ac4f6.title: Solutions Architect (Presale & Cloud Partner)
e30ac4f6.description:
Location: Gurgaon (Onsite, 5 days a week)
   

  

 Experience: 2\-4 years in Cloud / DevOps / Infrastructure; 2\+ years in Presales, Solution Architecture, or Customer\-Facing Technical Roles
   

  

**About Infra360**
 Infra360 is a fast\-growing Cloud, DevOps, and Infrastructure Services company helping startups and enterprises modernize, secure, and scale their platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
   

  

**We Work With Technology\-driven Organizations On**
* Cloud migrations and modernization
* DevOps \& SRE enablement
* Cloud cost optimization and cloud economics
* Security, reliability, and platform scalability


 At infra360, presales is a core business function, not sales support. This role directly impacts deal quality, delivery success, and long\-term customer trust.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a strong Presales / Solutions Architect who can bridge business requirements, technical architecture, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Founder, Head of Growth / Customer Success, and Delivery Leads to design the right solutions, scope engagements accurately, and ensure infra360 wins the right deals — not just more deals.
   

  

 This role has high ownership and visibility and acts as a gatekeeper for delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cloud Partner \& Program Enablement
* Support AWS Partner Network (APN) requirements (GCP \& Azure are big plus as well), including architecture alignment and assessment inputs
* Participate in cloud migration and modernization programs by owning technical eligibility and assessments
* Collaborate with the Head of Growth on deal registration, co\-sell motions, and funding opportunities
* Client Discovery \& Presales Ownership
* Lead technical discovery calls and workshops with CTOs, engineering leaders, and platform teams
* Understand customer pain points across scale, reliability, security, and cost
* Translate business context into clear technical and service\-level solutions
* Solution Architecture \& Design
* Design cloud and DevOps architectures primarily on AWS (Azure/GCP exposure is a plus)
* Define modernization approaches, including containers, serverless, CI/CD, observability, and SRE practices
* Create target\-state architectures, diagrams in draw.io, migration strategies, and phased execution roadmaps
* Proposals, RFPs \& SOWs


* Own technical solutioning for:
+ Proposals and solution decks
+ RFPs / RFIs
+ Statements of Work (SOWs)

* Perform high\-level effort estimation, scope definition, and risk identification
* Ensure solutions are delivery\-feasible, margin\-positive, and outcome\-driven
* Cloud Economics \& Assessments
* Conduct cloud cost assessments, optimization reviews, and TCO / ROI analysis
* Support cloud migration and modernization assessments (e.g., AWS MAP)
* Help customers understand cost vs performance vs reliability trade\-offs
* Presales → Delivery Handover
* Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery teams
* Clearly document assumptions, scope boundaries, risks, and success criteria
* Support early delivery phases to ensure alignment and avoid scope drift
* Internal Enablement
* Create reusable presales assets (architecture templates, pitch decks, estimation frameworks)
* Mentor engineers on solution thinking and customer communication
* Work with leadership to continuously improve win rates and deal quality


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Technical**
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS (mandatory)
* Good understanding of:
+ Cloud networking, IAM, and security fundamentals
+ Containers (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS/AKS)
+ CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling
+ Observability, reliability, and performance concepts

* Experience designing and reviewing production\-grade cloud architectures


**Presales \& Business**
* Proven experience in technical presales or solution architecture roles
* Comfortable leading customer\-facing discussions and workshops
* Experience creating SOWs, proposals, and technical sections of RFPs
* Ability to explain complex technical ideas in simple, business\-friendly language


**Soft Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership mindset — comfortable pushing back on poorly scoped deals
* Structured thinking with strong attention to detail
* Collaborative approach with sales, delivery, and leadership teams


**Good to Have**
* AWS / Azure / GCP certifications
* Experience with managed services or consulting organizations
* Exposure to security, compliance, or audit\-led engagements
* Experience working with mid\-market or enterprise customers


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* Higher win rates with better\-qualified opportunities
* Clean, well\-scoped SOWs with minimal delivery escalations
* Strong trust from customers and internal delivery teams
* Reduced founder dependency on technical presales over time
* Improved margins and deal predictability


**Why Join infra360**
* High\-ownership, high\-impact role
* Direct collaboration with founders and leadership
* Opportunity to shape presales standards and solution frameworks
* Exposure to complex, real\-world cloud and DevOps challenges
* Clear growth path as the company scales

**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
 
**The Role**
 Presidio is looking for a AWS Cloud (DevOps) Architect to interface directly with clients and contribute to small workgroups to deploy cloud\-based solutions for clients. Successful candidates will prove their ability to leverage their experience with orchestration, configuration, and automation tools to build secure, reliable cloud platforms for customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop cloud design patterns and architecture framework required for the project implementation.
* Define architecture standards for the development team, encourage the best practices, prepare the technical documentation for the project deliverables.
* Translate the Design Into Implementable pattern for the DevOps engineering team.
* Act as the single point of contact for any technical delivery related to a project.
* Provide technical thought leadership to the team with solution decisions, technical issues and for internal organization initiatives.
* Technical guidance and assistance on effort estimation to pre\-sales teams for the client proposals.
* Project management activities include project estimation, work breakdown structure, setting the project schedules and sending the project status reports to clients.
* Assist Project Management team to help define and organize tasks across the sprints by participating in sprint planning and story point estimation.
* Mentor and guide the team members on the cloud technologies.


**Must Have Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in the industry with good exposure to Cloud, DevOps, and Automation.
* 4\+ years of experience in designing and architecting public/private cloud preferably AWS
* Certified in Solutions Architect Professional and/or Specialty in AWS.
* Must have good knowledge on core infrastructure domains like
* Networking, Compute, Security, Backup and Monitoring.
* Proficient in one or more of the following IaC tools – Ex: AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible.

* Expert in Business Continuity plans and related designs (DR).
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure cost management and optimization.
* Experience on setting up Datacentre to AWS Cloud connectivity using Site\-to\-Site VPN and/or Direct Connect.
* Experience in large scale migrations to cloud, with exposure to end\-to\-end migration methodology from Discovery, Build \& Migration phases

* Seasoned in migrating and transforming legacy solutions to cloud
* Experience in any of the Database configuration and administration
* Experience in implementing Landing Zones and Control tower

**This role is for one of our clients**

 Min Experience: 9\+ years

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. **Analytics, AI \& Data Engineering Consulting Lead**

 We are looking for a highly accomplished Analytics, AI \& Data Engineering Consultant who combines deep technical expertise with strong consulting and business leadership capabilities. The ideal candidate should have started their career as a hands\-on software/data engineer, evolved into leading enterprise analytics and AI programs, and now be capable of engaging CXOs to shape data and AI strategies.
   

  

 This role requires someone equally comfortable discussing cloud architecture with engineers, statistical models with data scientists, and business transformation with executive stakeholders.

* Serve as the trusted advisor for senior client stakeholders including CIO, CDO, CTO, VP Engineering, and Business Leaders

* Guide engineering teams on scalable design patterns
* Drive API\-first architecture and microservices\-based AI deployment
* Lead CI/CD implementation for analytics and ML platforms
* Establish engineering best practices for reliability, security, observability, and maintainability


**Delivery Leadership**
* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising Data Engineers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Architects, and BI Developers
* Own solution delivery, governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication
* Mentor technical teams and establish engineering excellence
* Drive innovation initiatives, accelerators, reusable assets, and AI platforms


**Business Development**
* Support pre\-sales activities, solution design, and proposal development
* Lead client presentations, solution workshops, and executive demonstrations
* Develop reusable AI accelerators and industry\-specific offerings

**Required Technical Skills**
**Programming**
* Python
* SQL
* PySpark
* Any BI tool


**Leadership Expectations**
 The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
   

  

  

* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to dive deep into technical discussions
* Ability to transition seamlessly between architecture, coding, consulting, and executive discussions
* Proven success managing teams of 20\-100\+ members across global delivery models
* Experience leading multi\-million\-dollar analytics and AI transformation programs
* Passion for mentoring and building high\-performing engineering and consulting teams


**Desired Educational Background**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related engineering discipline from a premier engineering institution

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 The successful candidate will have begun their career as a hands\-on software or data engineer, with strong experience in coding, system design, and data platform implementation. Over time, they should have progressed into leading analytics, AI, and engineering teams while developing strong consulting, client engagement, and business leadership capabilities. They should be equally adept at writing production\-grade code when required, architecting enterprise\-scale solutions, and influencing executive stakeholders to drive measurable business outcomes. **About The Company**

Backed by Bain Capital, Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technolo

4e91fa48.title: Technical Program Manager
4e91fa48.description:
**Who are we?**
 Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it's not just about finding risk, but remediating it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies including Siemens, Airbus, SalesForce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead and coordinate key technical initiatives that drive customer success and adoption of the Checkmarx One platform. You’ll manage complex, cross\-functional programs—spanning migrations, onboarding, integrations, and custom enterprise projects—to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery and measurable customer outcomes.
   

  

 This role requires a balance of technical fluency, program leadership, and customer focus. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Professional Services, customer success, and security teams to ensure customers achieve success with Checkmarx’s solutions from implementation through long\-term adoption.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead complex, customer\-facing technical programs from planning to execution, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Build and optimize program management processes that enhance consistency, visibility, and scalability across global teams.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on scope, dependencies, and milestones.
* Drive continuous improvement across operations by identifying gaps and leading change initiatives.
* Provide executive\-level reporting on program progress, metrics, and success outcomes.
* Act as a trusted technical liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring delivery aligns with their architecture and business goals.


 Requirements:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience managing complex technical programs in SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise software.
* Proven track record leading customer delivery programs such as migrations, onboarding, or integrations.
* PMP or Scrum certification preferred.
* Strong technical understanding of system architecture, APIs, SDLC, and integrations.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable delivery frameworks and improving global operational processes.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience reporting to executives.
* Comfortable collaborating across global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR, ISO 27001\) preferred.


 What we have to offer:
   

  

 Checkmarx offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, competitive compensation, great work\-life balance, as well as great benefits and perks throughout the year. Checkmarx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

447e5dad.title: Program Manager
447e5dad.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), technical support, escalation management, or IT consulting.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree with 4 years of experience in sales operations, management consulting, finance, or program management.
* Proficient in executing strategic initiatives and utilizing sales enablement platforms, with a focus on adopting and deploying AI\-powered solutions to streamline workflows and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Exceptional project and stakeholder management, with a demonstrated ability to partner seamlessly with external entities to successfully scale operational systems.
* Leveraging direct SQL and data analytics expertise to uncover and troubleshoot intricate data quality concerns, uphold data integrity.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the point of contact for high\-priority escalations from intake to execution and closure.
* Improve processes and performance by analyzing, identifying, articulating, and quantifying the impact of required changes to deliver improvement opportunities.
* Deliver operational performance across all escalation paths and team members, ensure that all escalations are triaged, tracked, investigated, and resolved appropriately.
* Partner with compliance, finance, payroll, and regional strategy and operations to optimize timelines of case resolution and demonstrate a record in process optimization.
* Influence and communicate to build relationships with cross\-functional partners. Work directly with vendor partners.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. 57fc1257.title: Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant - Databricks
57fc1257.description:
**About This Job**
**Kanerika Inc**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Role**
**Job Description**
 Kanerika is growing its Databricks pipeline of prospective client engagements and needs a dedicated Pre\-Sales Solutions Consultant to own the technical sales motion, from initial discovery through proposal, estimation, and demo, so the Practice Lead isn't the bottleneck on every deal. This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and client communication, translating prospect requirements into a compelling, accurately scoped Databricks solution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead technical discovery calls with prospective clients to understand current data architecture, pain points, and goals.Translate client requirements into draft solution architectures on Databricks, in partnership with the Practice Lead.Build effort estimates, scoping documents, and inputs into SOWs/proposals for Databricks engagements.Develop and deliver technical demos and proof\-of\-concept walkthroughs tailored to prospect use cases.Respond to RFI/RFP technical questionnaires with accurate, well\-positioned answers about Kanerika's Databricks capability.Maintain and evolve a library of reusable proposal content, case studies, demo scripts, and solution one\-pagers.Work closely with sales/business development to qualify opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint.Hand off won deals to the delivery team (Practice Lead and engineers) with clear documentation of scope, assumptions, and client context.Track win/loss patterns and proactively share feedback to refine Kanerika's Databricks positioning and offerings.Learn new features of databricks across unity catalogue, AI, Genie, AI Gateway, LakeBase etc. and prepare demo environments to showcase.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
 6–10 years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, or pre\-sales/solutions consulting roles.Working technical knowledge of Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, and cloud data platforms (Azure preferred) enough to scope and credibly discuss solutions, even if not the most hands\-on coder on the team.Demonstrated experience in pre\-sales activities: discovery, estimation, proposal writing, and client presentations.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, persuasive proposal and demo content.Comfort working directly with prospective clients, including executive\-level stakeholders.Ability to balance multiple active opportunities and shifting priorities in a pipeline\-driven environment.Experience collaborating with both sales/business development and technical delivery teams.
   

  

**Preferred / Nice To Have**
 Prior experience in an IT services/consulting pre\-sales function, ideally with a cloud data or analytics practice.Databricks certification (Solutions Architect or Data Engineer) or willingness to obtain one in the first 90 days.Familiarity with proposal/estimation tooling and CRM systems used in technical sales cycles.Exposure to competitive cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery) to support comparative positioning.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within 3 months: Owns discovery and scoping for new opportunities with light support from the Practice Lead; has a working demo environment and core proposal assets.Within 6 months: Independently running technical pre\-sales motions end\-to\-end; pipeline conversion rate becomes trackable and improving.Within 12 months: Established as a trusted technical voice in the sales cycle, with a reusable, scalable pre\-sales playbook for the Databricks practice.

d7169e36.title: Senior Consultant Solutions
d7169e36.description:
**Job Summary**
 The
 **Senior Consultant – Solutions** 
 is responsible for supporting the development of differentiated procurement solutions, proposals, RFx responses, and sales pursuit materials for ProcureAbility’s internal stakeholders and external clients. This role works closely with the US Solutions Team, delivery leaders, subject matter experts, sales stakeholders, and leadership teams to translate client requirements into compelling procurement solutions and high\-quality client\-facing deliverables.
   

  

 The Senior Consultant – Solutions will support both
 **business development** 
 and
 **sales solutioning** 
 activities. Business development responsibilities include supporting lead qualification, prospect research, sales campaign execution, market research, and pipeline documentation. Sales solutioning responsibilities include developing opportunity\-level solution strategies, creating proposals, supporting pricing and commercial documentation, preparing RFx responses, and coordinating inputs from delivery and functional experts.
   

  

 This position acts as a client\-facing and internal consultant on ProcureAbility’s procurement services, capabilities, operating models, delivery approaches, and solution offerings. The role requires strong procurement understanding, excellent communication skills, PowerPoint and documentation expertise, and the ability to work across time zones with US\-based and global stakeholders.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Supports the development of differentiated procurement solutions for prospective and existing clients across procurement consulting, managed services, analytics, market intelligence, digital enablement, sourcing, category management, and procurement operations.
* Works alongside the US Solutions Team to respond to RFPs, RFIs, proposals, sales presentations, client requests, and other pursuit\-related deliverables.
* Engages with prospects and internal sales stakeholders to understand client business needs, procurement pain points, buying priorities, and potential solution fit.
* Supports client discovery discussions by listening to requirements, asking clarifying questions, documenting client needs, and identifying relevant ProcureAbility capabilities.
* Translates client requirements into structured solution narratives, operating models, service descriptions, scope documents, process flows, and proposal content.
* Develops high\-quality, professional proposals, RFx responses, presentation decks, solution documents, case study inserts, executive summaries, and other sales collateral.
* Coordinates with procurement delivery leaders and subject matter experts to gather inputs on delivery approach, staffing, methodology, assumptions, timelines, and value proposition.
* Supports opportunity\-level sales strategy by helping define the solutioning approach, win themes, differentiation, client messaging, delivery model, and commercial positioning.
* Documents sales solutioning approach, pricing strategy, proposal assumptions, client notes, meeting outputs, action items, and key decisions throughout the sales cycle.
* Supports the creation and maintenance of reusable solutioning assets, proposal templates, capability decks, service descriptions, standard responses, and knowledge repositories.
* Conducts market research, company research, prospect research, procurement maturity research, and industry analysis to support sales pursuits and client conversations.
* Assists in qualifying opportunities by assessing client fit, scope relevance, service alignment, procurement needs, potential deal size, and readiness to engage.
* Supports the end\-to\-end sales cycle from inbound opportunity through proposal development, client presentations, follow\-ups, negotiations, and closure.
* Helps shorten the sales cycle by producing timely, accurate, and client\-relevant solution materials.
* Works with internal stakeholders to ensure solution quality, consistency, commercial viability, and alignment with ProcureAbility’s service offerings.
* Interfaces with Legal, Finance, Sales, and Delivery teams to support contract triage, negotiation inputs, scope clarification, and proposal assumptions.
* Maintains accurate opportunity documentation in CRM tools such as HubSpot, including pipeline notes, sales activities, proposal status, next steps, and forecasting inputs.
* Supports sales metrics tracking, dashboard updates, reporting, and internal stakeholder communication related to pipeline and pursuit progress.
* Drives standardization and continuous improvement in solutioning processes, proposal development, RFx response quality, sales documentation, and pursuit governance.
* Supports internal review meetings, proposal readouts, pursuit strategy discussions, client presentation preparation, and executive briefings.
* Helps develop strong storytelling and differentiated value propositions for C\-suite and senior procurement stakeholders.
* Represents ProcureAbility professionally in client interactions, conferences, webinars, and business development discussions as required.
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**Management \& Supervisory Responsibilities**
* Typically reports to Management. Direct supervisor job title(s) may include: Manager – Solutions, Senior Manager – Solutions, Director – Solutions, Director – Sales Solutioning, or Head of Solutions.
* This role is generally an individual contributor position but may be required to coordinate workstreams with analysts, consultants, SMEs, delivery teams, or proposal support resources.
* May provide guidance, coaching, review comments, and quality oversight to junior team members supporting proposal development, research, documentation, and CRM updates.
* May lead specific pursuit workstreams, proposal sections, solution development activities, or internal coordination efforts depending on opportunity size and complexity.


**Job Qualifications**
 Experience Requirements
   

  

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement consulting, procurement operations, business development, sales solutioning, proposal development, or related professional services roles.
* Experience working in or supporting the procurement consulting or procurement managed services environment.
* Experience supporting US\-based and global clients across different time zones.
* Experience developing proposals, RFx responses, client presentations, sales collateral, and executive\-ready documentation.
* Experience supporting business development, lead qualification, solution design, opportunity pursuit, and sales cycle management.
* Experience in procurement solution areas such as strategic sourcing, category management, procurement operations, supplier management, market intelligence, analytics, digital procurement, or managed services.
* Experience supporting negotiations, contract reviews, scope definition, commercial assumptions, or contract administration is preferred.
* Experience working with CRM tools such as HubSpot or similar pipeline management platforms is preferred.


**Knowledge Requirements**
* Strong understanding of procurement functions, including sourcing, category management, supplier management, procurement operations, spend analytics, market intelligence, and procurement transformation.
* Strong knowledge of procurement consulting and managed services delivery models.
* Ability to understand client procurement challenges and translate them into practical, structured, and differentiated solutions.
* Strong business development mindset with the ability to identify client needs, shape opportunities, and support sales conversion.
* Excellent storytelling, proposal writing, documentation, and executive presentation skills.

a4bcc859.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.  

  

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).  

  

As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).  

We are known for our unwavering customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.  

If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 13\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 10\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 6\+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
* Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non\-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data \& analytics

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).  

  

As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).  

We are known for our unwavering customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.  

If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 13\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 10\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 6\+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
* Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non\-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data \& analytics

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 8591c2b1.title: Cloud Solution Architecture Manager
8591c2b1.description:
**Overview**
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. CE\&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
   

  

 The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization, an organization within CE\&S, is leading the effort to enable customer success on the Microsoft Cloud by harnessing leading, AI\-powered capabilities and human expertise to deliver innovation solutions that accelerate business value, drive operational excellence and nurture long term loyalty.
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Solution Architect (GSA) manager, specializing in AI Business Solutions, who is passionate about driving our customers’ AI transformation on the Microsoft platform. This role will be part of the Customer Success AI Business Solutions team and is designed to engage in the execution of consumption within key accounts.
   

  

 The ABS GSA Manager is a senior people and business leader responsible for driving AI innovation, incubation, and scale across strategic customers. This role leads a team of GSAs (incl Early in Career GSAs) and works in close partnership with Sales, CSAMs, and global peers to validate AI scenarios, shape repeatable offerings, and accelerate platform wins across Microsoft’s AI stack.
   

  

 This is a high impact leadership role requiring strong execution, cross group influence, and the ability to operate effectively across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 People Leadership
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of GSAs across multiple countries
* Build a high performing, inclusive team with strong technical depth and customer empathy
* Drive clarity on priorities, capacity, and role expectations across geographies
* Partner with Global and Regional leaders on talent planning, hiring, and succession


 Business \& Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Own ABS GSA execution across strategic accounts and priority initiatives \- lead the Digital Copilot and Agents Accelerator initiative for your geo
* Ensure customer engagements align to ABS objectives: Win the Platform, Agents for All, and scale innovation
* Balance hands on customer engagement with effective delegation and team empowerment
* Act as a senior escalation and decision point for complex customer scenarios


 Innovation \& Incubation
   

  

* Lead the incubation and validation of AI and agent based scenarios
* Partner with global IP, Product, and Engineering teams to shape scalable offerings
* Ensure learnings are captured and fed back into global solutions and playbooks
* Drive reuse, standardization, and repeatability across customer engagements


 Cross Group Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Sales, CSAMs, and Business Value teams to align execution
* Partner with other GSA leaders globally to ensure consistency and leverage global best practices


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications:
   

  

 Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 10\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience. 7\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.
   

  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**
* Proven experience leading senior technical or solution architecture teams in a matrixed environment
* Strong background in enterprise technology, cloud, or AI led transformation
* Demonstrated ability to lead across multiple countries and cultures
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
* Track record of driving clarity, focus, and results in complex environments


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Models Microsoft culture, values, and leadership principles
* Creates clarity and focus in ambiguous, fast moving environments
* Builds trust with customers and internal partners
* Develops future leaders and invests in long term capability building
* Balances short term execution with long term strategic impact
* Experience with Microsoft platform technologies (Azure, Copilot, agents, data, M365\)
* Prior experience in customer facing roles (architecture, consulting, delivery, or technical sales)
* Experience building or scaling innovation programs or technical incubation models


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
