15a89a30.title: Software Architect
15a89a30.description:
**Dear Aspirant!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

**We are looking for: Software Architect**
**You’ll make an impact by:**
* Architecture \& Design:
* Define end\-to\-end solution architecture for enterprise applications and automation platforms.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.
* Establish architecture standards, design principles, and technology roadmaps.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical governance across projects.
* Design reusable frameworks, components, and integration patterns.
* DevOps \& Platform Engineering:
* Architect and govern CI/CD platforms and DevOps toolchains.
* Design and implement Azure DevOps build and release pipelines using YAML.
* Define deployment strategies, branching models, and release governance processes.
* Develop automation solutions for build, testing, deployment, and operational activities.
* Enable quality, compliance, and security automation across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure:
* Design and implement cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Define infrastructure architectures using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/OpenTofu).
* Establish scalability, reliability, availability, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Drive containerization and deployment using Docker technologies.
* Define monitoring, logging, and observability strategies.
* Integration \& Enterprise Automation:
* Design and implement API\-based integrations between internal and external enterprise systems.
* Develop solutions using Azure DevOps REST APIs and custom workflow automations.
* Architect enterprise reporting, dashboarding, and analytics solutions.
* Support data migration and modernization initiatives.
* Partner Management:
* Collaborate with business partners, product owners, project managers, architects, and development teams.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to engineering teams.
* Participate in technology evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and strategic decision\-making.
* Mentor developers and promote engineering standards.
* Documentation \& Compliance:
* Prepare and maintain:
* Solution Architecture Documents, High\-Level Design (HLD), Low\-Level Design (LLD).
* Technical Specifications, Deployment Guides, Test and Release Documentation.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality, security, and governance standards.


**Use your skills to move the world forward!**
* B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline/ M.E. / M.Tech. / MCA / M.Sc. (Preferred)
* 10–14 years of overall software development and architecture experience.
* Proven experience designing enterprise\-grade solutions on Azure.
* Strong experience in full\-stack application development using .NET and Angular.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps pipeline architecture and automation.
* Experience in architecting integrations between enterprise applications.
* Experience leading technical discussions and architecture reviews.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, and DevOps methodologies.
* Architecture \& Design:
* Software Architecture and System Design, Enterprise Application Architecture
* Design Patterns and SOLID Principles, API Design and Integration, Cloud\-Native Architecture
* DevOps \& Automation: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, CI/CD Pipeline Design, Release Management, DevOps Best Practices, Cloud Technologies.
* Microsoft Azure, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure DevOps, AWS (Good to Have), Infrastructure \& Containers, Docker, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu), Monitoring and Observability Tools.
* Programming \& Development: C\# / .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET, Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, REST APIs.
* Scripting \& Automation: PowerShell, Python, Bash Shell Scripting
* Emerging Technologies: AI\-Assisted Software Engineering, Workflow Automation, Engineering Productivity Solutions, Analytics and Reporting Platforms
* Preferred Certifications:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ\-204\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Azure DevOps or Cloud\-related certifications.


**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!**
 This role is based in Bangalore, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.
   

  

 We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

219733d1.title: IT Architect
219733d1.description:
Imaging Endpoints (IE) is an Imaging Technology and Imaging Clinical Research Organization (iCRO). We are passionately focused on our vision to
 *Connect Imaging to the CureTM* 
 . Everything we do is aligned with this singular purpose. We work every day excited to advance imaging science, technology, and services to bring curative technologies to humankind. We have supported many of the most impactful new drug approvals in oncology, and we are seeking the most talented individuals globally that are passionate in their desire to assist us in our mission to customize each clinical trial’s imaging to optimize the opportunity to demonstrate efficacy.
 



  





 Imaging Endpoints is based in Scottsdale, Arizona, with offices in Cambridge, Massachusetts; London, UK; Leiden, Netherlands; Basel, Switzerland; Hyderabad, India and Shanghai, China. We are an affiliate of HonorHealth, one of the largest healthcare systems nationally, and Scottsdale Medical Imaging Limited (SMIL/RadPartners), the largest private radiology group in the United States. We are recognized as the world’s largest and most preeminent iCRO in oncology.
 



  





 The IT Solution / Enterprise Architect translates business needs, operational challenges, and strategic objectives into secure, scalable, and cost\-effective technology solutions. This role collaborates with business stakeholders, IT teams, security, vendors, and leadership to develop technology roadmaps, solution designs, integration strategies, and implementation plans aligned with company policies, industry best practices, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation goals.
 



 The architect provides leadership across infrastructure, cloud, enterprise applications, data, security, and integration domains by evaluating current\-state technology, defining future\-state architecture, guiding solution delivery, and ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES**



* **Solution Design and Implementation** 
 : Analyze business requirements, workflows, risks, and constraints to design secure, scalable, interoperable, and supportable technology solutions.
* **IT Architecture Governance and Standards** 
 : Define, maintain, and enforce architecture standards, reference designs, documentation expectations, and technology governance controls.
* **Cloud, Infrastructure, and Application Architecture** 
 : Support architecture across infrastructure, cloud platforms, PaaS, SaaS, virtual desktop technologies, enterprise applications, databases, integrations, and medical imaging\-related systems.
* **Security, Compliance, and Risk Management** 
 : Collaborate with IT security, compliance, and operations teams to address cybersecurity, data protection, availability, resiliency, and business continuity requirements.
* **System Optimization and Problem Management** 
 : Assess systems, configurations, monitoring, workflows, and support processes to reduce complexity, eliminate redundancy, improve reliability, and optimize cost.
* **Technical Leadership and Delivery Guidance** 
 : Guide engineering, infrastructure, application, security, and support teams throughout design, implementation, validation, release, and operational transition.
* **Documentation and Knowledge Management** 
 : Ensure architecture diagrams, solution designs, installation guides, operational procedures, support models, risk assessments, and technical documentation remain complete, accurate, and current.



  





**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**



* **Experience** 
 : Requires 18\+ years of progressive information technology experience, including technology implementation, enterprise application delivery, infrastructure and cloud architecture, solution design, system integration, vendor coordination, and technology operations management.
* **Leadership and Delivery Experience** 
 : Experience should include leading or supporting complex technology rollouts, modernization initiatives, security\-conscious solution design, and cross\-functional collaboration with business, IT, compliance, and vendor stakeholders.
* **Education** 
 : Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline is preferred. A
 **bachelor’s degree** 
 in a relevant technical field with equivalent enterprise architecture, solution architecture, cloud, infrastructure, or application delivery experience may also be considered.
* **Certifications** 
 : Relevant professional certifications in AWS, Microsoft Azure, Citrix, Cybersecurity, ITIL, or enterprise architecture frameworks are strongly preferred.



  





**TECHNICAL SKILLS**



* **Cloud Platforms \& Services:** 
 Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, PaaS, SaaS, cloud architecture, migration, cost optimization, and secure cloud solutions.
* **Infrastructure \& Virtualization:** 
 Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, servers, storage, networking, virtualization, disaster recovery, high availability, Citrix, and Azure Virtual Desktop.
* **Enterprise Applications \& Integrations:** 
 Experience with enterprise applications, modernization, system integrations, APIs, middleware, workflow automation, and application dependencies across infrastructure and security layers.
* **Database \& Data Management:** 
 Knowledge of SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, database architecture, data modeling, reporting, and data visualization concepts.
* **Security \& Compliance:** 
 Understanding of cybersecurity, IAM, data protection, risk assessment, vulnerability management, regulatory compliance, and secure solution design.
* **Architecture Documentation:** 
 Ability to create architecture diagrams, solution designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, operational procedures, and support documentation.
* **IT Service Management \& Governance:** 
 Familiarity with ITIL practices, change management, incident/problem management, service transition, architecture governance, technical standards, and operational controls (preferred).
* **Financial \& Vendor Management:** 
 Experience evaluating technology costs, licensing models, vendor solutions, TCO, budgeting, and cost optimization opportunities (preferred).
* **Domain Knowledge:** 
 Experience with DICOM and imaging applications preferred.



  





**SOFT SKILLS**



* **Executive Communication:** 
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* **Strategic \& Analytical Thinking:** 
 Ability to assess business needs, evaluate technology options, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.
* **Problem Solving \& Decision\-Making:** 
 Ability to analyze complex issues, identify root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and make informed decisions.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Ability to lead through influence, align teams, guide technical decisions, and promote architecture standards.
* **Organization \& Presentation Skills:** 
 Ability to manage priorities, prepare presentations, facilitate discussions, and communicate risks, decisions, and recommendations.
* **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management:** 
 Strong collaboration skills with business teams, IT, security, compliance, partners, and vendors to align expectations and deliverables.
* **Documentation Skills:** 
 Ability to create clear and structured architecture documents, technical specifications, procedures, decision records, and implementation plans.
* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** 
 Focus on process improvement, technology simplification, risk reduction, and service quality enhancement.



  





**SKILLS**



* Strong understanding of DLP concepts, policies, and technologies, including DLP solutions from leading vendors.
* In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft 365 suite, including Azure AD, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and associated security controls.
* Strong understanding of ISO 27001 implementation and auditing
* Strong understanding of PAM solutions
* Good understanding of AWS network security concepts
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to data privacy and protection (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).
* Experience with security incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management processes.
* Flexible to work in shifts to provide round\-the\-clock security coverage, including nights, weekends, and holidays (On demand).
* Proficient in analyzing security logs, identifying anomalies, and responding to security incidents effectively.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**IMAGING ENDPOINTS’ TEAM CHARACTERISTICS**



* Passion to
 *Connect Imaging to the CureTM* 
 and pursue a meaningful career by improving the lives of cancer patients through imaging.
* Strong desire to be part of a dynamic, global team working closely together and growing year after year in a rewarding environment to help humanity through imaging.
* Commitment and caring for our fellow team members, their families, and the communities IE serves \- see more information about Caring Endpoints at https://caringendpoints.org/.
* Integrity and high ethical standards; we always do the right thing.
* High intellect and ingenuity; we enjoy solving problems, finding a better way, and the challenge of making a difference by improving lives.
* Structured, organized, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated; we approach each day with a detailed plan and excitement to accomplish the day’s objectives while striving to improve ourselves and IE.
* Accountable; we do what we say and communicative effectively to meet deadlines; we enjoy advancing clinical trials, helping patients, and celebrating success.
* High standard for excellence; we proof our own work, hold high standards for ourselves and our team, and always prioritize quality above all else.



  





**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**




 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, ability to adjust focus.

 Cloud Engineer (CE008\)
   

  

 Capgemini Delhi, India Cloud Engineer \- 3\-5 Years Full\-Time Bachelor’s degree with cloud certification preferred
   

  

**Job Description**
 Capgemini is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Cloud Engineer to join our cloud infrastructure and digital transformation team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing cloud\-based solutions that support business applications and enterprise systems. The candidate should have hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, infrastructure automation, networking, security, and cloud migration projects.
   

  

 As a Cloud Engineer, you will collaborate with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to build scalable, secure, and highly available cloud environments. You will play a critical role in modernizing enterprise infrastructure and ensuring that cloud resources are efficiently utilized while maintaining compliance and security standards.
   

  

 This role offers an excellent opportunity to work with cutting\-edge cloud technologies and contribute to large\-scale digital transformation initiatives for global clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Cloud Infrastructure Management
   

  

* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Configure and manage virtual machines, storage accounts, networking resources, and cloud services.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance of cloud environments.
* Monitor resource utilization and optimize cloud costs.
* Support cloud governance and compliance initiatives.


 Cloud Architecture \& Deployment
   

  

* Assist in designing cloud\-native and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Implement cloud infrastructure according to business and technical requirements.
* Deploy and configure cloud services and applications.
* Participate in cloud architecture reviews and technical discussions.
* Support multi\-cloud and hybrid\-cloud environments.


 Cloud Migration
   

  

* Plan and execute migration of on\-premises applications and infrastructure to cloud platforms.
* Assess existing systems and recommend migration strategies.
* Perform cloud readiness assessments.
* Minimize downtime during migration activities.
* Validate migrated applications and infrastructure.


 Automation \& Infrastructure as Code
   

  

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates.
* Automate provisioning and configuration management processes.
* Create deployment scripts and automation workflows.

**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Database Specialist Solution Architect to join the India WWSO Specialists team and help customers modernize their database estates on AWS. In this role, you will be the hands\-on technical expert who works directly with customers to plan, design, and execute database migrations \- moving workloads from commercial databases like Oracle and SQL Server to AWS purpose\-built databases including Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon RDS.
   

  

 You will engage across the full migration lifecycle: from discovery and schema assessment through proof\-of\-concept validation and production cutover planning. This is a deeply technical, customer\-facing role for someone who thrives on solving complex database challenges and enabling customers to achieve better performance, scalability, and cost efficiency on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Engage with customers to assess existing database environments, identify migration candidates, and recommend target AWS database services.
   

  

* Design database migration architectures using AWS DMS, Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), and native replication approaches.
* Conduct hands\-on proof\-of\-concept engagements demonstrating performance, compatibility, and operational benefits of AWS databases.
* Provide technical guidance on schema conversion, stored procedure refactoring, and application compatibility for Oracle/SQL Server to Aurora/RDS/DynamoDB migrations.
* Develop migration runbooks, cutover plans, and rollback strategies for production database migrations.
* Support competitive technical evaluations against Oracle, SQL Server, and other cloud database offerings.
* Collaborate with Database Sales Specialists to qualify opportunities and accelerate deal closure through technical validation.
* Create and deliver technical workshops, immersion days, and enablement sessions for customers and partners.
* Contribute to the development of reusable migration tools, scripts, and best\-practice documentation.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

8a2c0ee1.description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.

* Provide delivery leadership across the entire project lifecycle—from initial planning, backlog grooming, and sprint execution, to release planning and post\-delivery retrospectives

* Effectively communicate project status, blockers, and progress to stakeholders at all levels
* Champion a “Quality First” approach and promote continuous improvement within and across teams
* Handle shifting business priorities and navigate conflicting demands with calm, focused leadership
* Encourage creative problem\-solving and challenge short\-term thinking in favor of long\-term value
* Bring structure and direction to highly complex and ambiguous problem spaces
* Cultivate a delivery culture of accountability, ownership, and measurable outcomes
* Contribute to broader organizational improvements by identifying process and structure enhancements across teams
* (Nice to have): Experience delivering AI/ML projects or working closely with data science/AI teams


**Skills \& Experience**
* 5\-8 years of experience leading software development and product delivery teams
* Proven success managing end\-to\-end delivery of complex technical projects—not just as a Scrum Master or Agile coach, but with full ownership over planning, tracking, and stakeholder engagement
* Experience working with multiple cross\-functional Agile teams in a scaled environment
* Strong command of Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence)
* Experience in navigating business priorities and influencing stakeholders to achieve project goals
* Excellent communication (written, verbal, and presentation) and interpersonal skills
* Ability to build trust, support team dynamics, and encourage high performance

Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. 2ee17b76.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
2ee17b76.description:
Instrumental builds the manufacturing acceleration platform behind the world’s most complex electronics. We capture digital exhaust and engineering context from assembly lines—images, test logs, BOM data, performance, repair cycles—and our AI engines identify insights that are difficult or impossible for human engineers to find. We accelerate the companies building the AI era by improving manufacturing yield, throughput, and ramp. NVIDIA, Meta, L3Harris, and their manufacturing partners rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product introduction and production.
   

  

 Instrumental is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead and service strategic customer programs across Taiwan (and partner with our team in China to deliver solutions for Vietnam and other APAC regions as needed). As our sole on\-the\-ground representative, you will work directly with customers and contract manufacturers (CMs) to integrate, optimize, and expand Instrumental’s AI\-powered manufacturing solutions. This is a high\-impact, customer\-facing engineering role supporting some of our fastest\-growing accounts during a period of rapid company growth.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a seasoned professional with a background in manufacturing design, automation, or technical program management — someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer engagement. You’ll have the autonomy to drive outcomes while collaborating with a global team to ensure customers achieve transformative value.
   

  

 Come join our team if you are passionate about improving electronics manufacturing, love working with a global team, and are energized when traveling to factories across Taiwan, Asia Pacific, and the world. The ideal candidate is multi\-faceted, technically savvy, organized, and deeply customer\-oriented.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own end\-to\-end program delivery for strategic accounts. In this role, you’ll travel to customer factory sites to accomplish company\-critical missions, such as deploying Instrumental hardware/software into manufacturing environments and accelerating customer “time to value” by hand\-tuning Instrumental algorithms and software. You’ll have support from our global team, but will be accountable for program success.
* Build relationships with customers and factory stakeholders. While on\-site, you’ll build rapport with the various stakeholders who are critical to Instrumental’s success and pave the way for further adoption. You’ll leverage these relationships to complete your missions quickly and effectively. You’ll cement a strong technical and dependable reputation for yourself and Instrumental at large.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams across time zones to resolve challenges. Act as the central point of communication between engineering, product, and customer teams worldwide, ensuring alignment and timely resolution of technical or operational issues. By bridging time zones and disciplines, you’ll keep projects moving forward smoothly and develop customer confidence in Instrumental’s solutions.
* Leverage Instrumental’s software to drive value. You’ll quickly become an expert in Instrumental’s software and technology, including many non\-customer\-facing functionalities. This will enable you to quickly identify how to get the most performance out of the system – whether that’s by making a physical tweak in the real world, adding training labels, or replicating customer tests. You’ll use your engineer’s understanding of how our customers derive value to rapidly achieve results.


**What You Have**
* Experience getting things done in electronics factories. 5\+ years of professional experience in electronics manufacturing, doing engineering or operations – either on the “brand” or EMS side. You understand factory environments, processes, and politics and can leverage that expertise to get things done quickly.
* Demonstrated ability to complete missions. You can share countless stories of mission ownership and completion, where you were able to deliver despite unforeseen or challenging circumstances. You love the idea of applying your diverse engineering and operations skillsets to critical company missions.
* Love the factory floor more than an office. This role is based out of a customer factory site. You will also be expected to travel to other factory sites on a regular basis, including transiting in the evenings and on weekends.
* Strong relationship\-building skills. You naturally develop trust and rapport with customers, suppliers, and partners. You enjoy representing the company externally, aren’t afraid to tactfully challenge those in senior positions, and foster long\-term, collaborative relationships that help drive mutual success.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication. This role will require rapid and effective communication with a variety of global stakeholders, representing Instrumental with our most important customers.
* Project Management. Excellent hands\-on experience', and 'strong execution and follow\-up project schedule and assigned tasks
* Bonus. Mandarin Speaking


 You’re encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn’t precisely match the job description.
   

  

 At Instrumental, protecting company and customer information is a shared responsibility. All employees are expected to comply with company security and privacy policies and promptly report suspected security incidents or policy violations.

* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. 189adbbf.title: AI Solutions Consultant (Customer-Facing | Prompt Engineering | AI Automation)
189adbbf.description:
**About MyOperator** 




 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform.Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform.Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor\-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We’re hiring a Front Deployed Engineer (FDE)—a customer\-facing, field\-deployed engineer who owns the end\-to\-end delivery of AI bots/agents.
 



  





 This role is “frontline”: you’ll work directly with customers (often onsite), translate business reality into bot workflows, do prompt engineering \+ knowledge grounding, ship deployments, and iterate until it works reliably in production.
 



  





 Think: solutions engineer \+ implementation engineer \+ prompt engineer, with a strong bias for execution.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Requirement Discovery \& Stakeholder Interaction** 



* Join customer calls alongside Sales and Revenue teams.
* Ask targeted questions to understand business objectives, user journeys, automation expectations, and edge cases.
* Identify data sources (CRM, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) required for the solution.
* Act as the AI subject\-matter expert during client discussions.



  





**2\. Use Case \& Solution Documentation** 



* Convert discussions into clear, structured use case documents, including:
* Problem statement \& goals.
* Current vs. proposed conversational flows.
* Chatbot conversation logic, integrations, and dependencies.
* Assumptions, limitations, and success criteria.



  





**3\. Customer Delivery Ownership** 



* Own deployment of AI bots for customer use\-cases (lead qualification, support, booking, etc.). Run workshops to capture processes, FAQs, edge cases, and success metrics. Drive the go\-live process: requirements through monitoring and improvement.



  





**4\. Prompt Engineering \& Conversation Design** 



* Craft prompts, tool instructions, guardrails, fallbacks, and escalation policies for stable behavior. Build structured conversational flows: intents, entities, routing, handoff, and compliant responses. Create reusable prompt patterns and "prompt packs."



  





**5\. Testing, Debugging \& Iteration** 




 Analyze logs to find failure modes (misclassification, hallucination, poor handling). Create test sets ("golden conversations"), run regressions, and measure improvements. Coordinate with Product/Engineering for platform needs.
 



  





**6\. Integrations \& Technical Coordination** 




 Integrate bots with APIs/webhooks (CRM, ticketing, internal tools) to complete workflows. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes/root\-cause analysis.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Customer bots go live quickly and show high containment \+ high task completion with low escalation.
* You can diagnose failures from transcripts/logs and fix them with prompt/workflow/knowledge changes.
* Customers trust you as the “AI delivery owner”—clear communication, realistic timelines, crisp execution.



  





**Requirements (Must Have)** 



* 2–5 years in customer\-facing delivery roles: implementation, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or similar.
* Hands\-on comfort with LLMs and prompt engineering (structured outputs, guardrails, tool use, iteration).
* Strong communication: workshops, requirement capture, crisp documentation, stakeholder management.
* Technical fluency: APIs/webhooks concepts, JSON, debugging logs, basic integration troubleshooting.
* Willingness to be front deployed (customer calls/visits as needed).



  





**Good to Have (Nice to Have)** 



* Experience with chatbots/voicebots, IVR, WhatsApp automation, conversational AI platforms with at least a couple of projects.
* Understanding of metrics like containment, resolution rate, response latency, CSAT drivers.
* Prior SaaS onboarding/delivery experience in mid\-market or enterprises.



  





**Working Style \& Traits We Value** 



* High agency: you don’t wait for perfect specs—you create clarity and ship.
* Customer empathy \+ engineering discipline.
* Strong bias for iteration: deploy → learn → improve.
* Calm under ambiguity (real customer environments are chaotic by default).

22dc8755.title: Digital Health Solutions Consultant (Freelancer)
22dc8755.description:
**About Us** 




 Deccan AI Experts is a pioneering AI company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in high\-quality human\-curated data, AI\-first operations, and advanced AI evaluation systems. Our global network of healthcare technology and digital health experts helps train and evaluate next\-generation AI models through expert clinical judgment, healthcare technology expertise, and real\-world digital transformation experience.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a
 **Digital Health Solutions Consultant (Freelancer)** 
 to support advanced AI evaluation initiatives focused on digital health platforms, healthcare IT, Electronic Health Records (EHR/EMR), telemedicine, clinical workflows, interoperability, healthcare analytics, and AI\-generated healthcare content evaluation.
 



 In this role, you will evaluate AI\-generated digital health solutions, healthcare workflows, implementation strategies, interoperability recommendations, patient engagement platforms, and technical documentation. Your expertise will help improve AI systems designed for healthcare providers, hospitals, health technology companies, and digital transformation initiatives.
 



 This position is ideal for professionals with experience in digital health consulting, healthcare IT, health informatics, clinical systems implementation, healthcare operations, or healthcare technology.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Review AI\-generated healthcare solution architectures, implementation plans, workflow documentation, interoperability designs, and digital transformation recommendations.
* Evaluate enterprise healthcare systems involving EHR/EMR platforms, patient portals, telehealth, clinical decision support systems, remote patient monitoring, and healthcare analytics.
* Verify AI\-generated recommendations for healthcare workflows, clinical documentation, interoperability standards, patient engagement, and operational efficiency.
* Assess AI\-generated healthcare solutions for usability, scalability, compliance, security, and enterprise readiness.
* Identify workflow gaps, interoperability issues, implementation risks, compliance concerns, and patient safety considerations.
* Provide structured feedback to improve AI performance in healthcare technology, digital health consulting, and clinical workflow optimization.
* Review peer\-developed deliverables to maintain quality and consistency standards.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Medicine, Pharmacy, Public Health, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related healthcare field.
* Master's degree in Health Informatics, Healthcare Management, Public Health, or a related discipline is preferred.
* **2\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 in digital health, healthcare IT, clinical informatics, healthcare consulting, health technology implementation, or healthcare operations.
* Implementing or supporting digital health solutions.
* Designing and optimizing healthcare workflows.
* Familiarity with interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, SNOMED CT, ICD\-10, CPT, and LOINC.
* Understanding of healthcare regulations and standards including HIPAA, GDPR (where applicable), CMS, Joint Commission standards, and healthcare quality frameworks.
* Excellent analytical thinking, healthcare workflow analysis, documentation, stakeholder communication, and written English skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate healthcare technology solutions objectively.
* Ability to work independently in a remote, fast\-paced environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working with hospitals, healthcare systems, digital health startups, health technology vendors, consulting firms, insurance organizations, public health agencies, or healthcare providers.
* Experience implementing EHR/EMR systems, telehealth platforms, clinical decision support systems, patient engagement solutions, or healthcare analytics platforms.
* Experience evaluating AI\-generated healthcare workflows, digital transformation strategies, interoperability documentation, or clinical technology recommendations.
* Familiarity with Generative AI, AI\-assisted clinical documentation, AI benchmarking, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), healthcare AI governance, or clinical decision support AI is highly desirable.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Competitive hourly pay:
 **₹1,800/hour**
* Fully remote with flexible working hours.
* Opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge AI initiatives in digital health, healthcare technology, and Generative AI.
* Exposure to advanced AI systems focused on healthcare transformation, clinical workflows, interoperability, and intelligent healthcare solutions.
* Flexible project\-based opportunities with global teams.
* Work on next\-generation AI solutions supporting hospitals, health systems, digital health companies, healthcare technology providers, consulting firms, and public health organizations.

Built to replace legacy infrastructure and fragmented data services, Couchbase empowers enterprises with a unified platform architected for performance, flexibility and global scale.
   

  

 With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.
   

  

 Couchbase believes data should never slow you down, but act as the foundation for your next breakthrough. Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world’s biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what’s next on their roadmap. Visit couchbase.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Want to be part of our story? Apply today!
   

  

**Sr Solutions Engineer**
 We are looking for a Sr Solution Engineer in Mumbai to support the rapidly growing Couchbase user community and help drive customer success.
   

  

 Our Solution (Pre\-Sales) Engineers are the primary technical field experts, responsible for actively driving and managing the technical components of a sales engagement. This includes explaining Couchbase advantages and differentiators, and how our Couchbase solutions stack meets these customer challenges, all while getting customers excited about using this new approach for delivering consistent business value.
   

  

 This specific position focuses on assisting customers who interact with our technology via application code and the application development process. This development centric position requires experience in presales, software development experience as well as time developing business solutions. Experience with one or more Enterprise Programming Languages and Solution Development methodologies.
   

  

**Location: Mumbai**
**Responsibilities**
* Operate in a consultative process with customers and prospects to define their challenges and opportunities. Map these challenges to the Couchbase Ecosystem by presenting differentiating and sustainable business value.
* Educate and become a trusted advisor and challenge assumptions and current status while delivering value to the prospects and customers.
* Present art of the possible and think outside the box approaches and solutions.
* Support technical and business discovery activities including workshops, demonstrations, across multiple opportunities
* Work closely with the sales team on account strategy and identifying additional opportunities in existing and new accounts. Ensuring the success of customer PoC/Pilots through effective management of acceptance criteria and issue escalation/resolution.
* Develop and deliver exceptional and engaging company/product presentations and demonstrations. Work with all technical levels from managers, to architects and developers and explain the Couchbase Ecosystem and its applicability to business objectives and business value
* Be the technical product expert and advisor for customers and stay up\-to\-date on the data solutions competitive landscape
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to provide feedback from the field and represent the customer perspective

* 2\+ years of experience in software development or related industries
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases or other distributed high\-performance systems
* Excellent presentation skills with an ability to present technical solutions concisely to customers or potential customers all the way from development roles to the C\-Suite
* Passion for diving into technical issues and solving customer challenges
* Programming skills with any one of the following: Java, Python, Javascript, .NET. C, SQL
* Experienced in at least one of the major cloud services providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Experienced in designing solutions on at least one major database platform including data modeling, indexes and query optimization.


 Desirables
   

  

* Experience with virtualization and containerization technologies (i.e. Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift, Containers etc)
* Experience with database platform development is a plus.
* Hands on experience with development at large scale

ab4e079e.title: IT Infrastructure Cloud Engineer
ab4e079e.description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment and pharmaceutical products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA.


Group's key figures are approx. 7\.296 billion Euros turnover, over 950 laboratories across 59 countries and about 65,000 staff.

 **Job Description** **Title: Senior Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineer**

**About Eurofins**


Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company providing analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. With a global presence and a commitment to innovation, Eurofins supports customers in ensuring the safety, authenticity, and sustainability of products and services worldwide.

**The Opportunity**


We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineer to join our Core Infrastructure Project Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer passionate about building, automating, and operating reliable enterprise\-scale infrastructure across hybrid and multi cloud environments.


As part of a Core Infra team, primarily responsible for the engineering, configuration, installation, and maintenance of; Windows physical and virtual servers, Active Directory, Azure cloud and on\-prem environments based on Hyper\-V/VMWare, storage, backups, and disaster recovery planning. We rely on our engineers to empower our users with high availability, excellent performance levels and key services. Ideally, we are seeking an experienced project engineer to deliver insights and guidance as we design, build, and operate state\-of\-the\-art multi\-cloud infrastructures. Of most interest to us is someone who brings ideas and solutions, a lateral thinker, demonstrates a unique and informed viewpoint, and enjoys collaborating with a cross\-functional team to develop real\-world IT service. .

**What You'll Do**

* Deliver enterprise infrastructure projects involving Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, PKI, Storage, Backup, VMware, and Hyper\-V technologies.
* Lead migration, transformation, and modernization initiatives across on\-premises and cloud environments.
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure solutions aligned with business and architectural requirements.
* Drive automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code adoption using PowerShell, Terraform, and Ansible technologies.
* Collaborate with Architects on technical designs, migration plans, implementation procedures, and project documentation.
* Collaborate with global infrastructure, security, and application teams to execute complex cross\-functional projects.
* Contribute to cloud adoption, identity modernization, datacenter transformation, and infrastructure standardization programs.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to improve service delivery, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure successful project execution through planning, testing, deployment, knowledge transfer to platform support team, and stakeholder engagement.

 **Required Qualifications**

**Education**


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Experience**

* 8\+ years of experience in enterprise Microsoft infrastructure administration and engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Windows Server environments.
* Proven experience managing Microsoft Active Directory.
* 4\+ years of experience supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure services.
* Experience with GCP \& AWS Cloud platforms is an added benefit
* Experience with virtualization technologies such as Hyper\-V and VMware.
* Experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure monitoring solutions.

**Technical Skills**


We are looking for candidates with experience in several of the following areas:

* Windows Server administration and engineering
* Microsoft Active Directory
* Microsoft Entra ID administration
* Microsoft PKI Services
* Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud services
* Virtualization technologies (Hyper\-V and VMware)
* Core infrastructure services such as DNS, DHCP, and NPS
* PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
* Exposure to configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible
* Linux system administration
* Enterprise monitoring, alerting, and observability platforms
* Backup and disaster recovery solutions
* Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS services
* Storage technologies and infrastructure management
* Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex infrastructure issues

**Additional Technical Knowledge**


Experience or exposure in the following areas is considered a strong advantage:

* Docker and Kubernetes
* CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins
* Bare\-metal server administration (iLO, iDRAC, firmware management)
* Security and identity management best practices

**Professional Competencies**


We are looking for someone who:

* Demonstrates strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Has a curious and proactive mindset focused on reliability, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Communicates effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Takes ownership and drives initiatives from concept to implementation.
* Works collaboratively across regional and international teams.
* Maintains high standards of documentation and operational excellence.
* Excellent writing and communication skills (fluent spoken and written English); excellent interpersonal skills and able to interact and work efficiently with people at all levels in an organization (internal employees and customers, contractors, managers, third parties, etc.).
* Familiarity with relevant regulatory requirements (GxP, HIPAA, GDPR, …) is a plus
* Knowledge of laboratory (regulated/controlled environment) operations and processes is a plus
* Apply curiosity and technological intellect to analyze emerging concepts and make necessary recommendations to achieve transformational results in Deployments, Application \& Infrastructure Support, and Automation Setup and Implementation.

 **Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified Professional certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Identity, or Security).
* VMware certifications.
* Terraform Associate certification.
* ITIL Foundation certification (Nice to have)

7ecd58e9.description:
### **Key Responsibilities**


### **1\. Project Delivery \& Governance**


* Plan and coordinate all aspects of **AIC projects** (strategy/assessments, architecture/design, implementation/execution, and transition to operations) from initiation through closure.
* Ensure **service delivery success, quality, and customer satisfaction** through effective project and program management practices.
* Lead project initiation activities, including confirmation of **client objectives, success metrics, scope, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and governance model**.
* Develop, maintain, and execute **project plans, schedules, budgets, work breakdown structures, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs**.
* Own **project administration** in AHEAD’s tools (e.g., PSA), ensuring accurate project setup, resource plans, budgets, billing milestones, and status updates.
* Apply **change control** and Project Change Request (PCR) processes for scope, schedule, and budget changes in collaboration with ELs, TLs, and Sales.

### **2\. Stakeholder \& Client Management**


* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned projects, driving **clear and proactive communication** with client stakeholders and internal leadership.
* Facilitate **status meetings, steering committees, and executive\-level updates**, providing transparent views of progress, risks, decisions, and financial health.
* Align delivery with **AIC and client standards** (e.g., Agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery), ensuring the ways\-of\-working are explicit and followed.
* Partner with Engagement Leads and Client Directors to **shape a top\-notch client experience**, including responsiveness, expectation management, and structured escalation handling.

### **3\. Coordination of Global \& After\-Hours Work**


* Oversee and coordinate **after\-hours and weekend change windows** (e.g., production cutovers, platform migrations, major releases) in partnership with US\-based PMs and TLs.
* Act as the **primary offshore liaison** during change events when assigned, ensuring alignment with approved implementation plans, backout plans, and validation steps.
* Maintain continuous **communication channels across time zones** (India U.S.) so that risks, blockers, and status are clearly handed off and tracked.
* When no after\-hours activities are scheduled, work aligned to India/U.S. overlap hours to **independently lead small to medium AIC projects** (e.g., cloud adoption pilots, data platform workstreams, application modernization sprints).

### **4\. Risk, Quality, and Financial Management**


* Identify, document, and manage **project risks, issues, and dependencies**, driving timely mitigation and escalation as needed.
* Ensure appropriate **quality gates** are defined and met (e.g., design reviews, test readiness, go/no\-go, post\-implementation reviews).
* Track and manage **project budgets, burn rates, and margin**, raising concerns early and partnering with ELs and practice leadership to protect both **client value and profitability**.
* Support **PSA data hygiene** by maintaining accurate time entry expectations, project end dates, budget adjustments, and revenue alignment.

### **5\. Practice \& PMO Enablement**


* Model and reinforce **AIC PMO standards** for project hygiene, governance, and reporting, including use of standard templates, dashboards, and inspection routines.
* Contribute to **practice development**, including harvesting reusable artifacts (plans, RAID logs, status report templates, change playbooks) and improving delivery frameworks.
* Provide **coaching and mentoring** to junior project managers, coordinators, and consultants who are performing PM tasks on AIC engagements.
* Collaborate with Resource Management and Delivery leaders regarding **resource planning and capacity management**, helping to structure onshore/offshore staffing models that align to AIC scoping guidelines.

### **6\. Pre\-Sales \& Opportunity Support (As Needed)**


* Identify **follow\-on opportunities** and work with client\-facing teams to position next\-phase work informed by project outcomes and client feedback.
### **Must Have Skills \& Experience**


* **10–12\+ years** of progressive **IT project management** experience, including multi\-phase engagements in at least one of the following areas:
	+ **Cloud platforms** (Azure, AWS, GCP) – migrations, modernization, landing zones, platform build\-outs.
	+ **Data \& AI** – data platform implementations, analytics/BI, AI/ML initiatives.
	+ **Application modernization / DevOps** – refactoring, re\-platforming, or re\-architecting workloads.
* Demonstrated success leading **medium to high complexity, multi\-stakeholder projects** with significant client visibility.
* Strong working knowledge of **project management standards and methods**, including both **Agile (Scrum/Kanban)** and **waterfall/hybrid** approaches.
* Experience coordinating work across **global, distributed teams**, including offsite/offshore resources and cross\-practice contributors.
* Proven ability to **plan and manage after\-hours or production change activities** (e.g., cutovers, major releases, infrastructure or platform changes affecting production).
* Excellent **written and verbal communication skills** in English, including experience with:
Executive\-ready status reports and presentations.  

	+ 
	
	Facilitating workshops, working sessions, and steering meetings.  
	+
* Proficiency with **project management tools** (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Microsoft Azure DevOps boards, Atlassian Jira, Salesforce, or similar tools).
* Strong **analysis, problem\-solving, negotiation, and conflict management** skills.
* Demonstrated ability to:
	+ Manage **project budgets, forecasts, and financials**.
	+ Operate with a **consultative mindset**, connecting delivery activities to business and operational outcomes.
### **Nice to Have Skills**


* Background in **consulting** or a services organization with **AIC\-style project portfolios** (cloud, data, AI, application/platform transformations).
* Experience in one or more of the following:
	+ **Cloud migration programs**, landing zone builds, or modernization roadmaps.
	+ **Data platform** (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, Redshift) or analytics initiatives.
	+ **DevOps / Continuous Integration (CI) – Continuous Delivery (CD)** enablement or platform engineering initiatives.
* Familiarity with **AHEAD\-style delivery artifacts** (e.g., engagement plans, outcome roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, action plans).
* **PMP or Agile certifications** (e.g., PMI\-ACP, PSM, CSM, SAFe) are a plus.
* Experience working within or alongside a **centralized PMO** in a global context.

dd34fe3c.title: Cloud Platform Architect
dd34fe3c.company: The Edge Partnership - The Edge in Asia
dd34fe3c.description:
Our client is a is a global SaaS provider of investment research publishing and distribution technology used by financial institutions. The company serves investment banks, asset managers and financial services firms worldwide. Technology team is building an enterprise\-scale AWS platform supporting global customers across eight AWS regions. The environment includes multi\-account AWS Control Tower architecture with Infrastructure\-as\-Code, cloud migration from on\-premises infrastructure and modern DevOps practices.
 



  





**Location: Hyderabad / Remote** 




  





**Experience Range: 12\+ Years** 




  





**Key skills: Cloud Architect, AWS, Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, Linux, Database Cluster, AWS Landing Zone, Control Tower, Custom Automation, PCI, ISO Compliant, IAM, VPN Architect, Secrets Management, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, IPAM, VPC pattern, Enterprise identity architecture, Terraform architecture, Security and compliance architecture, Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, CI/CD, GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions.** 








**MANDATE: CANDIDATE MUST BE CURRENTLY WORKING IN A BFSI ORGANIZATION.** 




  





**SHARE YOUR UPDATED CV WITH JOB REFERENCE NUMBER \- JOB 16741 TO radhika@theedgepartnership.com** 




  





**Some of the key responsibilities will include:** 



* Design and implement multi\-region AWS infrastructure, leveraging Control Tower, custom OU structures, and network segmentation.
* Architect and build AWS Landing Zones to support multiple entities and workload isolation.
* Build and manage reusable Terraform and Terragrunt modules to streamline IaC provisioning.
* Lead the migration of legacy systems (Cassandra, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Airflow, Tomcat) from on\-prem to AWS.
* Guide the design of CI/CD pipelines integrating GitLab, Github and GoCD for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Enforce security\-by\-design principles, including IAM hardening, traffic segregation, and logging.
* Support Linux system architecture and design highly available database clusters.
* Define and implement best practices to meet PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and internal security policies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support operational excellence and compliance goals.



  





**To be eligible for this role you will require:** 




 Strong technical skills in:
 


* 15\+ years of experience in cloud architecture with deep AWS knowledge.
* Proven experience building multi\-region, highly available architectures in AWS.
* Expertise in Terraform, Terragrunt, and Ansible at scale.
* Strong Linux systems background and familiarity with database clustering (e.g., MySQL, Cassandra).
* Experience building AWS Landing Zones using Control Tower or custom automation.
* Hands\-on experience designing PCI and ISO compliant environments.
* Proficient in secure networking, IAM, VPN architecture, and secrets management.
* Experience with regulated domains (e.g., FinTech, healthcare) is strongly preferred.
* Deep AWS networking architecture: Transit Gateway and/or Cloud WAN, IPAM, shared VPC patterns, centralized egress, hybrid connectivity to on\-prem.
* Enterprise identity architecture: IAM Identity Center / SSO federation with Entra ID or Okta, permission\-set design, ABAC/RBAC models.
* Strong Terraform architecture skills: module library design, state strategy, multi\-account pipelines (Terragrunt strongly preferred).
* Datacenter\-to\-cloud migration experience: migration wave planning, rehost/replatform decisions, coexistence architectures where on\-prem and cloud run side by side.
* Security and compliance architecture in regulated environments (ISO 27001, SOC 2, or financial\-services equivalents).
* Excellent written and verbal communication \- ADRs, architecture diagrams, and executive\-level narratives.
* M\&A technology integration: consolidating acquired companies' cloud estates, Git providers, CI systems, or identity stacks.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture: per\-customer account isolation, tenant provisioning automation, noisy\-neighbor and blast\-radius design.
* CI/CD platform architecture on GitHub Enterprise / GitHub Actions (OIDC to AWS, reusable workflows, org\-level governance).
* Config management architecture (Ansible) bridging heterogeneous estates.
* Container platform architecture (EKS) and legacy Java/Tomcat\-era application estates.
* FinOps / cloud cost architecture at multi\-account scale.
* Experience designing for or with AI\-assisted / agentic engineering workflows.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or equivalent depth.



  





 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your personal information may be processed using secure recruitment technologies, including AI\-assisted tools, for recruitment, assessment, interview documentation, candidate representation, and related business purposes. Further information is available in our Privacy Policy.
 



  





 Please note that due to the high number of applications only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us in the next 5 business days, we regret to inform you that your application for this position was unsuccessful.

2b5d9c51.title: Senior Cloud/Infrastructure Consultant (Remote)
2b5d9c51.description:
* **Job Title:** 
 Senior Cloud/Infrastructure Consultant (Remote)
* **Work Mode:** 
 Fully Remote
* **Schedule:** 
 Flexible (up to 40 hours per week, based on project availability)



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for Senior DevOps Engineers to join a paid remote AI training program focused on Infrastructure as Code (IaC). In this role, you will write realistic engineering\-ticket\-style prompts, configure LocalStack sandboxes, and build golden solutions with passing end\-to\-end tests to help AI models master Terraform, AWS CDK, and CloudFormation. This is a flexible, remote opportunity well\-suited for senior\-level DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure engineers seeking project\-based, asynchronous work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Task Creation:** 
 Write natural language prompts that read like real engineering tickets, including realistic ambiguity and professional context, so AI can handle real\-world scenarios.
* **Environment Configuration:** 
 Set up and configure LocalStack sandboxes (local AWS mocks) to validate infrastructure tasks
* **Golden Solution Development:** 
 Craft the initial infrastructure state and a "golden solution" that includes passing automated end\-to\-end tests
* **Quality Benchmarking:** 
 Ensure tasks meet a high quality bar; simple or poorly formatted tasks will be rejected.
* **Response Evaluation:** 
 Choose the correct response between two AI\-generated answers to a given infrastructure question
* **Prompt Writing:** 
 Draft simple prompts that act as a starting point for AI models to build upon



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Seniority** 
 : Must be a Senior\-level practitioner in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure Engineering
* **IaC Platform Expertise** 
 : Professional, hands\-on experience with at least one of the following — High Priority: AWS CDK, Terraform (HCL), or CloudFormation; Medium/Low Priority: Pulumi, AzureRM, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet
* **Programming Languages:** 
 Strong proficiency in at least one of the following for infrastructure scripting and testing: TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, or Java
* **Communication** 
 : Ability to articulate complex technical concepts fluently in written English, following strict style guidelines



  





**Eligibility Requirements** 



* Candidates must be legally authorised to work in one of the following locations: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Puerto Rico, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States



  





**Compensation** 



* Earn up to $50 USD/hr — plus additional incentives; rates vary based on expertise and project requirements
* Paid via PayPal and AirTM



  





**Work Arrangement** 



* Fully remote; choose your own schedule
* Flexible workload depending on project availability, most experts spend 5–10 hrs/week, up to 40 hours
* Free access to leading AI tools (GPT, Claude, and more) worth over $200/month included at no extra cost



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 Selection decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and project requirements. We are committed to inclusive and fair engagement practices and consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics.
 



  





*Ready to put your infrastructure expertise to work on AI? Apply now — interviews begin within days of application.*

7737c883.title: Service Manager – SAP Application Managed Services (AMS)
7737c883.description:
Role: Service Manager – SAP Application Managed Services (AMS)
 



 Experience: 10 to 15 years
 



 Work Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore
 



 Notice: Short notice joiners preferred
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience**




 10–15 years of IT experience with at least 5 years in SAP Service Delivery or SAP AMS.
 



 Strong knowledge of SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
 



 Experience managing integrated SAP landscapes including modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehouse Management, BW, APO, Fiori, Ariba, and middleware integrations.
 



 Hands\-on experience with ITIL Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management.
 



 Experience managing global support teams and working in a 24x7 delivery model.
 



 Strong customer\-facing communication and executive presentation skills.
 



 Experience using ServiceNow, SAP Solution Manager, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar service management tools.
 







**Preferred Qualifications**




 ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional certification.
 



 SAP certification in any functional or technical area.
 



 PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification is desirable.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for an experienced SAP Service Manager to lead the day\-to\-day delivery of SAP Application Managed Services (AMS) for a global enterprise customer. The role is responsible for ensuring stable operations across the SAP landscape, driving service excellence, leading operational governance, managing major incidents, and collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to deliver high\-quality support services.
 







 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in SAP operations, ITIL service management, stakeholder engagement, and leading cross\-functional support teams in a global delivery environment.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**Service Delivery Management**




 Own end\-to\-end SAP AMS delivery across multiple SAP modules and integrated applications.
 



 Ensure SLA, KPI, and operational targets are consistently achieved.
 



 Manage daily service operations, incident resolution, problem management, and service requests.
 



 Drive operational stability and continuous service improvement.
 



**Incident \& Major Incident Management**




 Lead Major Incident (P1/P2\) management and ensure timely restoration of services.
 



 Coordinate with functional teams, Basis, Infrastructure, Security, Middleware, and third\-party vendors during critical incidents.
 



 Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and ensure preventive actions are implemented.
 



 Track recurring issues and drive permanent resolution.
 



**Change \& Release Management**




 Coordinate SAP releases, patching activities, maintenance windows, and production deployments.
 



 Support vulnerability remediation, SAP Notes implementation, and infrastructure upgrades.
 



 Ensure business readiness, testing completion, and successful production transitions.
 



 Participate in release planning and Hypercare activities.
 



**Customer \& Stakeholder Management**




 Act as the primary operational contact for customer service management teams.
 



 Conduct Daily Operations Reviews, Weekly Service Reviews, and Monthly Governance meetings.
 



 Present service performance, risks, improvement initiatives, and action plans to customer leadership.
 



 Build trusted relationships with business stakeholders and technical teams.
 



**Governance \& Reporting**




 Publish daily, weekly, and monthly service dashboards.
 



 Track SLA, MTTR, incident trends, problem backlog, change success rate, and customer satisfaction metrics.
 



 Maintain RAID logs and service improvement plans.
 



 Ensure audit readiness and compliance with organizational standards.
 



**Team Leadership**




 Lead a cross\-functional SAP support team across multiple time zones.
 



 Manage work allocation, shift planning, resource utilization, and performance management.
 



 Coach team members and develop future service leaders.
 



 Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
 



**Continuous Improvement**




 Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational activities.
 



 Drive service improvement initiatives using ITIL best practices.
 



 Reduce incident volume through proactive monitoring and preventive maintenance.
 



 Improve operational efficiency through standardization and knowledge management.
 







**Key Competencies**




 Service Delivery Management
 



 SAP AMS Operations
 



 Major Incident Management
 



 Change \& Release Governance
 



 Stakeholder Management
 



 Customer Relationship Management
 



 SLA \& KPI Management
 



 Risk \& Escalation Management
 



 Continuous Service Improvement (CSI)
 



 Vendor Management
 



 Team Leadership \& People Development
 



 Executive Communication
 



 Operational Excellence
 



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**




 SLA Compliance (\>98%)
 



 Incident Response and Resolution Time
 



 Mean Time to Restore Service (MTTR)
 



 Major Incident Reduction
 



 Change Success Rate
 



 Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
 



 Problem Resolution and RCA Closure
 



 Service Improvement Initiative Delivery
 



 Knowledge Management Compliance
 



 Resource Utilization and Team Productivity
 







**Success Profile** 




 The successful candidate will demonstrate a proactive leadership style, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead complex SAP operations in a fast\-paced global environment. They will be customer\-focused, operationally disciplined, and capable of driving service excellence while continuously improving delivery performance

74c8182d.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager
74c8182d.description:
Dover is a diversified global manufacturer with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, specialty systems, consumable supplies, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Fueling Solutions, Imaging \& Identification, Pumps \& Process Solutions and Refrigeration \& Food Equipment. Dover combines global scale with operational agility to lead the markets we serve. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 60 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at dovercorporation.com.

**Designation:** Senior Program Manager: Process, Execution \& Portfolio Manager

**Experience:** 15 – 20 Year

**Location :** Jigani, Bangalore


We are seeking a high\-calibre **Senior Engineering Program Manager** to bridge the gap between breakthrough innovation and scalable manufacturing. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end journey of new product development (NPD), from initial laboratory research (R\&D) to full\-scale market delivery.


The ideal candidate is a hybrid leader who possesses both the technical rigor of **Technology Development,** **Product Development** using **Design for Six Sigma (DFSS)** principles and strategic mindset required for **Innovation Portfolio Management**. You will be responsible for navigating complex technical challenges while ensuring that our product pipeline aligns with long\-term business goals.

 **Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* **Program \& Portfolio Leadership:** Drive the strategic execution of the innovation portfolio, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across multiple high\-priority projects.
* **Stage\-Gate Governance:** Own and optimize the **Stage\-Gate process**, leading cross\-functional teams through rigorous design reviews, risk assessments, and milestone approvals.
* **New Product Development (NPD):** Lead products through the entire lifecycle, ensuring technical specifications, timelines, and budget targets are met or exceeded.
* **DFSS \& Quality Excellence:** Implement **Design for Six Sigma (DFSS)** methodologies to ensure product robustness, reliability, and performance from the earliest design phases.
* **Technology to Product Scaling:** Manage the transition of "Lab\-to\-Fab," ensuring that emerging technologies are successfully scaled into manufacturable, commercially viable products.
* **Design for Manufacturing (DFM):** Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to integrate **DFM/DFA** principles, reducing cost and complexity while maintaining high quality.
* **Laboratory \& Resource Management:** Oversee laboratory operations, ensuring equipment, protocols, and safety standards support rapid prototyping and experimental validation.
* **Stakeholder Orchestration:** Act as the primary liaison between engineering, executive leadership, and external partners, translating technical roadmaps into business value.

 **Must Have Skills:**

* **Education:** Master’s or PhD in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.
* **Experience:** 15\+ years in R\&D or Product Development, with at least 5 years in a leadership/managerial role.
* **Methodology Expertise:** Certified or highly proficient in **DFSS (Green/Black Belt),** proven track record in **Stage\-Gate** project management and R\&D portfolio
* **Strategic Execution:** Proven track record of scaling at least one complex technology from laboratory concept to successful commercial launch.
* **Leadership**: Experience of managing engineering teams and laboratory environments.
* **Project Management Tools:** PMP certification, statistical analysis software (e.g., Minitab, MATLAB), and lab management tools.
* **Communication:** Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence the top\-level business leaders


We consider several job\-related, non\-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.
