f611187a.title: Creative Delivery Manager (Digital Agency)
f611187a.description:
We are a fast\-growing UK digital agency with offices in the UK, Dubai and India. We specialise in high\-end websites, e\-commerce, custom software, AI solutions and digital marketing for businesses worldwide.
 



 We're looking for an experienced Creative Delivery Manager who is passionate about quality and operational excellence. This is not a traditional project management role. You'll be responsible for ensuring that every website, software project, SEO campaign, paid marketing campaign and creative asset delivered by our team meets the highest standards.
 



 Working closely with our Senior Project Manager in South Africa, you'll act as the operational lead for our India delivery team, coordinating multiple departments while ensuring every project is delivered on time, on budget and to an exceptional standard.
 



 You will not be expected to implement the work yourself, but co\-ordinate effectively and know what to look for and how to maintain standards. 
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is a hands\-on coordination and quality assurance role. You'll oversee the day\-to\-day delivery of projects across SEO, web development, software development, UX/UI, graphic design and digital marketing.
 



 Your role is to ensure that work is delivered efficiently, follows best practices and meets both our internal standards and our clients' expectations. You'll be the final quality checkpoint before projects are presented to clients.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Coordinate multiple client projects simultaneously.
* Manage delivery across SEO, Paid Media, Web Development, Software Development, UX/UI and Creative teams.
* Review and approve graphic/web designs to maintain high\-quality standards and brand consistency.
* Ensure projects remain on schedule and internal deadlines are achieved.
* Review websites, software, landing pages, SEO deliverables, marketing campaigns and creative work before client delivery.

1163351f.title: Technical Program Manager
1163351f.description:
**About Huru** 




 Huru is a UAE\-based fintech company on a mission to make financial services simpler, more accessible, and more empowering for everyone. Licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE, we are building a modern financial platform designed for the way people live, work, save, spend, and send money today.
 



 Our growing suite of services includes digital accounts, Visa cards, domestic and international money transfers, bill payments, savings solutions, and microfinance products—helping customers manage their financial lives with greater ease and confidence.
 



 At Huru, we're not just building products; we're building a better financial future for our customers. We move fast, think big, and put our customers at the center of everything we do. If you're excited about solving meaningful problems in a high\-growth fintech environment, we'd love to have you on board.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the execution and delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives across the organization.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, Product, Design, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, and Business teams. You will be responsible for driving execution, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, improving delivery processes, and ensuring strategic programs are delivered on time with exceptional quality.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with outstanding program management and stakeholder management skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of strategic technology programs from planning through execution and launch.
* Define program scope, milestones, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Build and maintain comprehensive execution plans across multiple engineering teams.
* Coordinate cross\-functional initiatives involving Engineering, Product, Design, QA, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
* Drive alignment between business priorities and engineering execution.
* Track multiple concurrent technical workstreams while ensuring delivery against commitments.
* Manage backend, mobile, web, DevOps, data, infrastructure, and platform initiatives simultaneously.
* Coordinate API integrations, third\-party dependencies, payment gateway implementations, banking integrations, cloud infrastructure deployments, and production releases.
* Identify execution risks early and proactively drive mitigation plans.
* Remove blockers, facilitate decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional conflicts.
* Lead Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog reviews, program reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Prepare executive dashboards, program status reports, risk registers, dependency trackers, and delivery metrics.
* Establish scalable program management processes, governance frameworks, documentation standards, and reporting mechanisms.
* Continuously improve execution efficiency, delivery predictability, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration.



  





**What we are looking for** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Program Management, Engineering Management, or Technical Project Management.
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex software programs involving multiple engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, Scrum, and Kanban.
* Solid technical understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud platforms, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software architectures.
* Ability to effectively partner with engineering teams without being a hands\-on developer.
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent technology initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, prioritization, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar project management and collaboration tools.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, digital wallets, or other regulated industries.
* Understanding of payment processing, card issuing, remittances, financial integrations, or banking systems.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or security\-related programs.
* Familiarity with engineering KPIs, DORA metrics, release management, and delivery governance.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent certifications are an advantage.



  





**Why join Huru** 




  




* Be part of one of the fastest\-growing fintech companies in the UAE.
* Work on products that impact thousands of customers across financial services.
* Collaborate with talented engineering, product, and business teams solving complex technical challenges.
* Shape how technology programs are executed across the organization.
* Enjoy significant ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to influence company\-wide delivery practices.
* Grow your career in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment.

The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The CSM will leverage their knowledge of online media, communication and relationship building skills, and analytical abilities to provide campaign intelligence and campaign strategy consultation, including identifying areas where LinkedIn can provide more value to our clients.
   

  

 The CSM will be measured by their ability to build, cultivate, and partner with our clients as well as their ability to drive incremental revenue. The CSM is a nimble team player who is comfortable managing multiple clients, campaigns, and projects concurrently.

* Grow and maintain existing business through renewals, tactical reactivations and upsells.
* Co\-develop a strategic plan for your book of business with your Account Executive.
* Use data and insights to highlight the value of advertising, demonstrate ROI, and make recommendations for optimizations and additional investment.
* Inspire innovation by regularly sharing ideas and best practices with peers and sales leaders.
* Embrace our learning culture to develop yourself as a sales professional and colleague to your peers and internal partners.
* Travel requirements: approximately 30% for client meetings, industry events, and team collaboration


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of experience in advertising sales, media buying and planning, or relevant consulting work


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of auction based or programmatic campaign management and optimization experience (i.e. Social, Google Adwords, SEO/PPC, ad exchange/trading desks)
* Experience in media account management
* Demonstrated analytical background and experience with statistical analysis, return on investment modeling, and advertising/media analytics
* Ability to think strategically with a proven track record of providing consultative and data\-driven solutions
* Ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks and work within deadlines with little supervision
* Ability to work independently and collaborate cross\-functionally
* Experience working with large customers


**Suggested Skills**
* Digital Marketing
* Digital Advertising
* Strategic Communications
* Solution Based Selling
* Campaign Management

Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.


Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**About Candescent**
--------------------


Candescent is the largest non\-core digital banking provider. We bring together the transformative technologies that power and connect account opening, digital banking and branch solutions for banks and credit unions of all sizes on any core. Our Candescent solutions power the top three U.S. mobile banking apps and are trusted by banks and credit unions of all sizes.


We offer an extensive portfolio of industry\-leading products and services with an extensible ecosystem of out\-of\-the\-box and integrated partner solutions. In addition, our API\-first architecture and developer tools enable financial institutions to optimize and expand upon their existing capabilities by seamlessly integrating custom\-built or third\-party solutions. And our connected in\-person, remote and digital experiences reinvent customer service across all channels.

**Job Summary**
---------------


As a Technical Program Manager at Candescent, you will lead cross\-functional technical initiatives, manage program execution, and ensure alignment between engineering deliverables and business objectives. You’ll be responsible for planning, tracking, and delivering high\-impact programs that span multiple teams and technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the planning and execution of complex technical programs across engineering, and product teams.
* Define program scope, goals, success metrics, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain detailed program schedules, risk assessments, and mitigation plans.
* Drive alignment across teams by identifying dependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring timely delivery.
* Communicate program status, risks, and decisions to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Foster continuous improvement by introducing scalable processes, tools, and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with internal standards and external regulations.
* Support technical decision\-making and provide guidance on architecture, integration, and deployment strategies.
* Champion a culture of accountability, transparency, and innovation.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (Master’s or MBA is a plus).
* 5\+ years of experience in technical program management, preferably in a software or cloud\-based environment.
* Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional technical programs.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Confluence).
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems and propose effective solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices architecture, and modern development frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.
* Technical background in software engineering or systems architecture.
* Experience working in a startup or high\-growth environment.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and equity package
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous PTO and flexible work arrangements
* Inclusive and collaborative culture

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

You’ll coordinate technical efforts across engineering, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams — ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and at the highest quality.



This role requires technical acumen, solid organizational skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.



### **Key Responsibilities**

* Process \& Quality Management: Maintain documentation, track program metrics, and ensure compliance with integration standards and quality controls.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to process enhancements and best practices in program management and hardware delivery execution.
### **Required Skills**



* 5\+ years of experience managing technical programs or projects within IT hardware, infrastructure, or system integration environments.
* Demonstrated success coordinating complex programs that involve multiple hardware and infrastructure components (servers, storage, networking, etc.).
* Strong understanding of hardware integration processes, validation testing, and release management.
* Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with AHEAD project management tools (e.g. Jira, Smartsheet, Salesforce).
### **Preferred Skills**



* PMP or Agile certification.
* Experience in data center, cloud, or hybrid infrastructure deployments.

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work\-life balance
**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling
**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well\-being

**Inclusive and people\-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

**Tech Superpowers**

 Knows what's new in cloud; our solvers impact\-engineer 'the new' through intelligent architectural design.

* **Modern Tech Consultant DNA:**

More than cloud\-certified, cloud\-capable. Proven impact through cloud\-led solutioning, with the ability to assess trade\-offs and position the right tools for the right outcomes. Learns the new\-tech and executes with pace \& precision.



  





**Experience \& Relevance** 




**Architectural Pedigree:** 
 8\+ years of relevant experience in cloud architecture and software development with direct involvement in designing and implementing components of cloud solutions on Cloud Platforms (Google Cloud and/or AWS).
 


* Experience with structured Enterprise Architecture practices, hybrid cloud deployments, and on\-premise\-to\-cloud migration deployments and roadmaps.
* Experience in network infrastructure, security, and application development.
* Experience in building, architecting, designing, and implementing distributed global cloud\-based systems.
* Experience in technology solutions, the enterprise technology buying/evaluation process, and large\-scale computing solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and infrastructure as code.

 Eager to directly interface with clients, building core technical advisory and architectural design skills in pre\-sales or solutioning contexts, effectively showcasing complex technical solutions. Proven track record for architecting, building, and deploying cutting\-edge cloud solutions that consistently deliver substantial business value and unprecedented growth for enterprises.

 high ownership, relentless execution, and bias for real\-world impact.

 P2P, claims, HR — not in theory, but in production.

220fb4af.title: Data & AI Delivery Leader
220fb4af.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.


Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.


We boldly go.

**Where is the work:**


Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.  

Role Summary  

We are seeking a Data \& AI Delivery Leader to provide architecture leadership and delivery direction for strategic enterprise Data and AI initiatives. This role combines the technical depth of a solution architect with the execution ownership of a delivery leader, with equal accountability for enterprise data foundations, analytics architecture, and scalable AI solution delivery, while providing hands\-on architecture leadership in key solution areas.

  

The person will shape end\-to\-end solution direction, align work to enterprise standards, and guide delivery across cross\-functional teams to ensure scalable, secure, high\-quality outcomes. This is a leadership role for someone who can translate business needs into practical architecture and execution plans while providing continuity across initiatives spanning data platforms, analytics, semantic layers, AI/ML enablement, generative AI, knowledge retrieval, and intelligent automation. The role is intentionally balanced to lead both trusted data capabilities and AI\-enabled business outcomes, while also building long\-term team capability through mentoring, coaching, and practical knowledge transfer.

  

Key Responsibilities  

1\. Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership  

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for Data and AI solutions, providing hands\-on architecture leadership aligned with enterprise strategy, business goals, and platform standards.
* Define scalable, secure, and reusable architecture patterns across data ingestion, transformation, modelling, semantic layers, analytics consumption, AI/ML enablement, and generative AI solution components.
* Translate business capability needs into architecture blueprints, technical decisions, and implementation direction.
* Establish and maintain reference architectures, design guardrails, and reusable solution patterns.
* Ensure solutions are designed for performance, maintainability, interoperability, supportability, and long\-term scale.

  

2\. Delivery Leadership \& Execution Oversight  

* Serve as the delivery leader for solution execution, partnering across product, engineering, governance, security, and business teams from concept through implementation while maintaining reasonable direct involvement in solution shaping and critical execution decisions.
* Shape new initiatives by defining scope, delivery approach, sequencing, dependencies, risks, operating assumptions, and high\-level estimates.
* Drive architecture and delivery decisions across multiple concurrent efforts, balancing speed, quality, risk, sustainability, and value realization.
* Help structure work across core and flex capacity, aligning the right skills and teams to the highest\-value priorities.
* Support release planning, solution reviews, issue resolution, change management, and adoption planning to ensure successful implementation while staying close enough to help unblock critical issues when needed.

  

3\. Data Architecture, Analytics \& AI Solution Design  

* Define architecture patterns across cloud\-native data platforms, including data lake, warehouse, semantic, and consumption layers.
* Guide conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional, and semantic modelling across enterprise data domains.
* Ensure data structures, metrics, and semantic models are reusable, governed, and aligned to business definitions.
* Partner with data engineers, AI engineers, BI developers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to design scalable data products and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Ensure governed data foundations support reporting, self\-service analytics, operational insight, AI/ML workloads, and future extensibility, with active hands\-on participation in key data and analytics decisions.

  

4\. Enterprise AI Solution Leadership  

* Lead design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions, including generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, enterprise AI assistants, knowledge retrieval, intelligent workflow automation, and predictive analytics use cases.
* Define reusable AI architecture patterns covering prompt orchestration, model integration, retrieval design, vector\-based knowledge access, tool integration, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Guide model and solution design decisions based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and enterprise supportability.
* Ensure AI\-enabled solutions are grounded in trusted enterprise data and designed for measurable business outcomes.
* Help establish reusable AI design patterns, delivery approaches, and guardrails that accelerate future implementations, while staying closely engaged in critical AI architecture decisions and implementation trade\-offs.

  

5\. AI Delivery, Evaluation \& Operational Readiness  

* Define and promote practical delivery patterns for AI solutions from experimentation through pilot, production rollout, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Establish evaluation approaches for AI solution quality, groundedness, usefulness, reliability, and user adoption.
* Partner with platform and engineering teams on AI operational readiness, including observability, feedback loops, versioning, change control, and cost\-performance optimization, with active involvement in key production\-readiness decisions.
* Support scalable adoption of AI capabilities by creating playbooks, reusable assets, implementation patterns, and transition approaches for long\-term support.

  

6\. Governance, Responsible AI \& Enterprise Standards  

* Ensure enterprise standards, best practices, and governance policies are applied consistently across Data and AI solutions.
* Define and promote standards for data quality, lineage, documentation, traceability, security, privacy, operational readiness, and supportability.
* Ensure AI solutions are designed with responsible AI principles, including grounding, transparency, appropriate human oversight, and auditability.

* Mentor team members and provide leadership across architects, engineers, analysts, AI practitioners, and delivery partners, while building long\-term Data and AI capability through coaching, reusable playbooks, and practical knowledge transfer.

  

Qualifications  

Education  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.

  

Required Qualifications  

* 10\+ years of experience in solution architecture, data architecture, enterprise data platforms, analytics delivery, AI solution design, or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong experience leading end\-to\-end solution design and delivery for complex data, analytics, and AI initiatives in enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of cloud data platforms, preferably GCP / BigQuery or equivalent enterprise cloud ecosystems.
* Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, semantic design, analytical solution patterns, and governed data foundations.
* Practical experience designing or leading enterprise AI solutions, including generative AI, knowledge retrieval, AI assistants, or ML\-enabled decision\-support capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to balance enterprise data platform thinking with AI solution delivery and business adoption.
* Experience guiding cross\-functional teams across architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, security, and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to connect strategy, architecture, and delivery execution in a domain\-oriented operating model.
* Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, security, responsible AI, and enterprise standards.
* Experience shaping delivery scope, sequencing, dependencies, implementation approaches, and operating models for multi\-team initiatives.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and lead through change in a transforming enterprise environment.

  

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience supporting enterprise AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge retrieval, or similar Data and AI solution patterns.
* Experience defining AI governance guardrails, model risk controls, or responsible AI practices in an enterprise setting.
* Familiarity with metadata, data catalog, governance, vector search, or knowledge platform capabilities.
* Experience with Git\-based delivery practices, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern engineering standards for data and AI platforms.
* Exposure to domain\-oriented data product principles and federated delivery models.
* Experience helping scale AI adoption through reusable patterns, playbooks, delivery frameworks, or platform enablement.

  

Key Success Profile  

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on enterprise architecture and delivery leader who can bridge business priorities and technical execution, provide strong delivery accountability, and help build scalable, governed, enterprise\-grade Data and AI capabilities. They should be equally comfortable shaping data foundations, leading cross\-functional delivery, staying actively engaged in critical solution decisions, and accelerating pragmatic enterprise AI adoption while building long\-term team capability through mentoring, coaching, and practical knowledge transfer.

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. **Job Description:**

  



***Job Family Definition:***


The Cloud Developer builds from the ground up to meet the needs of mission\-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end\-to\-end technical solutions to solve customer problems.

f784bbff.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

602e2d76.description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 Core Brokerage Services Engineering (CBSE) enables Schwab to fulfill its custodial and clearing obligations as a Broker\-Dealer and enables clients to invest strategically and achieve their financial goals. The Solutions Architect is a key technical leader in the CBSE organization, ensuring that Schwab India software development and engineering teams coalesce with established and evolving technology governance, standards, practices, and strategy as well as regulatory standards and requirements. This role requires a strong background in leading end\-to\-end architecture direction for high\-volume heterogenous technology platforms as well as hands\-on experience throughout the software development lifecycle. It’s an exciting time to join CBSE as it endeavors to modernize its platforms while incrementally delivering new features and capabilities to Schwab’s clients and growing businesses.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Collaborate with peer platform architects, enterprise architects, and software development and engineering teams to develop and maintain cohesive current and target state software architecture documents and reference implementations.
* Balance long\-term thinking with crafting architecture increments that deliver business value near\-term, guiding technical leads in creating these designs.
* Mentor software developers and engineers to leverage established patterns and software engineering best practices and adhere to policies and standards.
* Champion end\-to\-end observability, monitoring and alerting, adherence to service level indicators and objectives, and operational excellence (24x7 availability).
* Identify and address scalability, latency, resiliency, and performance improvement opportunities.
* Lead architecture strategy sessions and engage hands\-on throughout the software delivery lifecycle to resolve challenges.
* Remain informed on industry trends in financial technology and apply this knowledge to drive innovation within the organization.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on full stack software development experience across diverse technologies such as .NET/C\#, Java/Spring framework, COBOL, Python, RabbitMQ/Kafka/IBM MQ, SOAP/REST services, and modern front\-end frameworks like Angular/React.
* Knowledge of both SQL (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, DB2\) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Aerospike) with extensive experience in designing and optimizing data solutions.
* 5\+ years hands\-on expertise architecting, designing and integrating components, and implementing large\-scale solutions
* Experience architecting and building private and public cloud\-based or cloud\-ready applications (e.g., PCF, GCP).
* Proven ability to handle fast\-paced agile delivery environment, prioritize competing deadlines, and contribute to multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrable ability to help others visualize application design and system integration patterns.
* Demonstratable proficiency in business analysis, problem\-solving, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Proven ability to build interpersonal relationships with various roles and garner fellowship.
* Ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and learn new technologies.
* Experience with AI and LLMs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot).
* Working proficiency with software configuration management and continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools (e.g., Remedy, ChangeMan, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Jenkins).
* Experience supporting production operations and providing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) expertise.
* Strong client focus and sense of ownership.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

**About Comply:** 




 Comply is a global leader in regulatory compliance software for financial services, offering a scalable SaaS platform backed by expert consulting.
 



 Serving thousands of firms worldwide, Comply empowers broker\-dealers, investment banks, RIAs, and more to manage compliance effectively.
 



 At Comply India, engineers build impactful, client\-focused solutions using AI and emerging technologies, with strong ownership and growth opportunities.
 



  





**Staff Engineer / Architect:** 




 At COMPLY, we are looking to build our team with talented and innovative engineers. Members of our team take a high degree of ownership when it comes to work we do. We care about what we do and the people we do it with. We're guided by a deep empathy for our customers and their needs, and we think carefully about how our users and our world may be affected by the decisions we make. We're constantly aiming to drive improvements for our users and build useful things that make our world better. We're looking for candidates comfortable in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment. We value tenacity, a commitment to learning, empathy, humility, ambition, curiosity and a deep\-seated belief in the power of data to inform and improve how things get done and decisions get made.
 



  





 We are looking for a Staff Engineer / Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at COMPLY: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client\-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands\-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 You will help drive the technical direction of COMPLY's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client\-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.
 



 This role is intentionally cross\-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client\-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Internal AI Engineering Platform:** 



* Help drive the architecture of COMPLY's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi\-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co\-design enterprise\-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in\-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.



  





**Client\-Facing Product Architecture:** 



* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of COMPLY's client\-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event\-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer\-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi\-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co\-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on\-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third\-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.



  





**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars:** 



* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI\-driven workflows and product features meet COMPLY's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.



  





**Essential Criteria:** 



* 6 to 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross\-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands\-on experience architecting client\-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi\-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands\-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one\-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five\-line summary that aligns an executive.
* A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems.
* Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use.
* Familiarity with MCP\-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi\-agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in\-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production.
* Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data\-sensitive domain.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD.
* A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on.
* The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day.
* A collaborative, forward\-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously.
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

Middle East \& India
**About the Role**


We are looking for an experienced SeniorSolution Consultant with deep expertise in Freight Forwarding, InternationalLogistics, and Supply Chain SaaS solutions. This role is pivotal in drivingbusiness growth by leading customer engagements, identifying businesstransformation opportunities, and delivering value\-driven technology solutions.


The ideal candidate will possess a strongblend of domain consulting, solution selling, business transformation, anddigital logistics expertise. Rather than functioning as a traditional pre\-salesresource, this individual will proactively engage prospective customers, leadsolution\-driven sales conversations, and serve as a trusted advisor throughoutthe customer journey.


You will work closely with Product,Marketing, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to help enterprisecustomers optimize freight forwarding operations through innovative SaaSsolutions while influencing product strategy by identifying market trends,automation opportunities, integration requirements, and emerging industryneeds.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Consulting \& SolutionSelling**

* Lead customer engagements by positioning Newage NXT solutions to address complex business challenges and digital transformation initiatives.
* Own solution\-driven customer conversations from discovery through solution validation, acting as a strategic business consultant rather than a traditional sales support resource.

* Act as a trusted advisor for customers undergoing digital transformation in freight forwarding and logistics operations.

* Identify measurable productivity improvements, cost savings, and ROI opportunities for customers.
* Design solutions that streamline processes such as: Customer Booking, Spot Quotation, Shipment Lifecycle Management, Documentation Management, Customs Compliance, Rate Management, Order Management \& Fulfillment, Supplier Collaboration, Transportation Planning

**Solution Design \& ProductCollaboration**

* Translate business requirements into scalable functional solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering teams to bridge customer requirements with product capabilities.
* Identify enhancement opportunities, industry trends, and competitive differentiators that improve the platform.
* Recommend integrations with ERP, CRM, TMS, WMS, EDI providers, customs platforms, carrier networks, and third\-party logistics applications.
* Drive continuous improvement of solution methodologies, implementation approaches, and consulting frameworks.

**Customer Engagement \& Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
* Lead customer workshops, business process assessments, and solution consulting engagements.
* Support implementation teams during project kick\-offs and solution handovers to ensure a seamless customer transition.
* Mentor junior consultants and foster knowledge sharing across cross\-functional teams.
* Represent Newage NXT at customer meetings, executive briefings, logistics conferences, industry forums, webinars, and trade exhibitions.

**Market Development, Industry Engagement\& Business Growth**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with regional freight forwarding, logistics, and supply chain trade associations to enhance Newage NXT's market presence and industry influence.
* Actively participate in regional trade association meetings, networking forums, and industry initiatives to identify emerging trends, customer needs, and business opportunities.
* Represent Newage NXT at company\-sponsored and industry events, including trade conferences, member network events, technology forums, exhibitions, and logistics summits to generate market awareness and customer engagement.
* Work closely with the Marketing team to develop and deliver product webinars, solution\-focused presentations, thought leadership content, digital campaigns, and customer outreach initiatives that strengthen market positioning and demand generation.
* Contribute to marketing collateral, case studies, whitepapers, blogs, and customer success stories that demonstrate Newage NXT's industry expertise.
* Research into customer businesses, competitive landscapes, and emerging logistics trends to identify new growth opportunities.
* Provide strategic insights that support product roadmap planning and business growth initiatives.
* Contribute directly to revenue growth by leading solution\-based customer engagements and demonstrating measurable business value through domain expertise and consultative selling.

**Preferred Experience**

* 12\+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Solution Selling, Business Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS Consulting.
* Strong experience with Freight Forwarding, International Logistics, or Supply Chain SaaS products.
* Proven experience leading customer\-facing solution engagements throughout enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working with enterprise customers across global markets.
* Proven track record of driving digital transformation initiatives in logistics organizations.
* Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and executive decision\-makers.
* Exposure to ERP, TMS, WMS, CRM, API, and EDI integrations.
* Excellent executive\-level presentation, negotiation, stakeholder management, and consultative selling skills.
* Experience representing organizations at industry conferences, trade associations, customer events, and technology forums is highly preferred.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
* MBA in Supply Chain, Operations, or Business Management is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in Logistics, Supply Chain, Cloud Technologies, or SaaS Solutions are an added advantage.

**Pre\-Sales \& Bid Manager**

**Location:** Ahmedabad (Work from Office)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About Recruitment SMART Technologies**

Recruitment SMART Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. (RSTI) is a UK\-headquartered AI HR\-Tech company specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for talent acquisition.

Our flagship product, **Sniper AI**, developed in collaboration with leading researchers from **Carnegie Mellon University**, is a revolutionary AI\-powered recruitment platform that intelligently matches CVs with job specifications at exceptional speed and accuracy.

We serve enterprise customers across the **UK, USA, Europe, UAE, and India**, delivering innovative HR Technology and AI\-driven recruitment solutions.

**Website:** https://recruitmentsmart.com

We are looking for an experienced **Pre\-Sales \& Bid Manager** to lead the complete bid management lifecycle and support enterprise sales by preparing winning technical and commercial proposals.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **Pre\-Sales, Bid Management, Proposal Management, Solution Consulting, RFP/RFQ/RFI responses, customer presentations, and stakeholder management** within the **IT, SaaS, ERP, HRMS, CRM, or AI Software** domain.

**Bid \& Proposal Management**

* Lead Proof of Concepts (POCs), Product Evaluations, and Pilot Implementations.

**Solution Design \& Requirement Analysis**

* Participate in customer requirement gathering sessions.

* Analyze customer requirements and perform functional gap analysis against existing product capabilities.
* Recommend suitable configurations, customizations, integrations, or solution approaches wherever required.
* Prepare functional solution blueprints, workflow diagrams, solution documents, and implementation recommendations.

**Stakeholder \& Customer Management**

* Act as the primary bridge between Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Customer Success, Security, Finance, and customers.

* Build strong relationships with enterprise customers, partners, consultants, and technology stakeholders.
* Manage customer visits, product workshops, executive meetings, and solution presentations.
* Ensure smooth communication throughout the pursuit cycle.

**Product \& Market Intelligence**

* Gather customer feedback and provide inputs for future product enhancements.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Identify emerging customer requirements and industry trends.
* Support Product Management with feature recommendations and roadmap inputs.

**Sales Enablement \& Marketing Support**

* Prepare high\-quality PowerPoint presentations for customer meetings and executive presentations.
* Develop reusable sales collateral including:
* Case Studies
* Solution Briefs
* Brochures
* Flyers
* Statements of Qualification (SoQ)
* Product Presentations
* Success Stories
* Support the Sales team in closing enterprise opportunities through effective solution positioning.

**Reporting \& Knowledge Management**

* Publish Weekly Bid Status Reports, Proposal Pipeline Reports, and Management Presentations.
* Maintain proposal libraries, reusable content, templates, case studies, and best\-practice documentation.
* Ensure all pre\-sales artefacts remain updated.
* Continuously improve proposal quality and pre\-sales processes through process optimization.

**Leadership \& Continuous Improvement**

* Lead cross\-functional bid solution teams for strategic opportunities.
* Mentor junior Pre\-Sales team members.
* Participate in internal knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, AI trends, HR\-Tech innovations, and industry best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Minimum **3 years of experience** in Pre\-Sales, Bid Management, Proposal Management, or Solution Consulting.

* Excellent proposal writing and business documentation skills.

* Ability to interact with CXOs, senior management, and enterprise customers.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Candidates having experience in one or more of the following industries will be preferred:

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Storage Engineering expert to join our dynamic infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and securing our cloud storage infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, scalability, and reliability. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud storage solutions, data management, and cloud security practices. Additionally, the candidate should have experience with carve\-out projects, involving the separation and migration of IT infrastructure and services during corporate divestitures or acquisitions.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 The Cloud Storage Engineer is a strong technical expert, with proven expertise able to lead projects to be executed in various countries. She/He will handle the following areas:
   

  

**Cloud Storage Management**
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud storage solutions across various cloud platforms (AWS, Azure etc.).
* Monitor cloud storage performance, availability, and usage to ensure optimal operation.
* Implement and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions for cloud storage systems.


**Optimization And Scaling**
* Optimize cloud storage configurations for performance, cost\-efficiency, and scalability.
* Develop and execute strategies for data lifecycle management, including archiving and deletion policies.
* Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams to integrate storage solutions with other cloud services.


**Technical Support And Troubleshooting**
* Provide expert\-level support for cloud storage\-related issues, including performance tuning and troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain documentation, including procedures, policies, and best practices for cloud storage management.
* Guide and be point of escalation for storage support team (in run\-mode).


**Carve\-Out Project Management**
* Lead and manage the cloud storage aspects of carve\-out project, ensuring smooth separation and migration of data and services.
* Develop and execute detailed migration plans, timelines, and risk assessments for carve\-out initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and minimal disruption during the carve\-out process.
* Address and resolve any technical challenges related to cloud storage during corporate divestitures or acquisitions.


**Collaboration And Innovation**

* Evaluate and recommend new cloud storage solutions and services to improve overall efficiency and performance.
* Work closely with development teams to understand storage requirements and provide tailored solutions.

* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in cloud \& on\-premise storage management or related field.
* Proven experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).
* Experience with cloud storage and on\-premise storage technologies (e.g., S3, Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, NetApp).
* Demonstrated experience in managing carve\-out projects, including data migration and IT separation.
* Experience in developing automation for storage processes using Terraform, Ansible, ServiceNow etc.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud storage architecture, data management, and security practices.
* Proficiency in cloud management tools and services.
* Strong understanding of networking, virtualization, and containerization as it relates to cloud storage.


**Soft Skills Required**
* Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire technical teams, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and presentations for leadership, ensuring transparency and understanding of network initiatives and their impact.
* Ability to think strategically, foreseeing potential challenges and developing proactive solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with a creative and analytical approach to overcoming obstacles and finding effective solutions in a dynamic environment.
* Commitment to ongoing personal and professional development, staying abreast of the latest industry trends and technological advancements.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
