At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

**J** OB SUMMARY


The **Senior Consultant – Solutions** is responsible for supporting the development of differentiated procurement solutions, proposals, RFx responses, and sales pursuit materials for ProcureAbility’s internal stakeholders and external clients. This role works closely with the US Solutions Team, delivery leaders, subject matter experts, sales stakeholders, and leadership teams to translate client requirements into compelling procurement solutions and high\-quality client\-facing deliverables.


The Senior Consultant – Solutions will support both **business development** and **sales solutioning** activities. Business development responsibilities include supporting lead qualification, prospect research, sales campaign execution, market research, and pipeline documentation. Sales solutioning responsibilities include developing opportunity\-level solution strategies, creating proposals, supporting pricing and commercial documentation, preparing RFx responses, and coordinating inputs from delivery and functional experts.


This position acts as a client\-facing and internal consultant on ProcureAbility’s procurement services, capabilities, operating models, delivery approaches, and solution offerings. The role requires strong procurement understanding, excellent communication skills, PowerPoint and documentation expertise, and the ability to work across time zones with US\-based and global stakeholders.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Supports the development of differentiated procurement solutions for prospective and existing clients across procurement consulting, managed services, analytics, market intelligence, digital enablement, sourcing, category management, and procurement operations.
* Works alongside the US Solutions Team to respond to RFPs, RFIs, proposals, sales presentations, client requests, and other pursuit\-related deliverables.
* Engages with prospects and internal sales stakeholders to understand client business needs, procurement pain points, buying priorities, and potential solution fit.
* Supports client discovery discussions by listening to requirements, asking clarifying questions, documenting client needs, and identifying relevant ProcureAbility capabilities.
* Translates client requirements into structured solution narratives, operating models, service descriptions, scope documents, process flows, and proposal content.
* Develops high\-quality, professional proposals, RFx responses, presentation decks, solution documents, case study inserts, executive summaries, and other sales collateral.
* Coordinates with procurement delivery leaders and subject matter experts to gather inputs on delivery approach, staffing, methodology, assumptions, timelines, and value proposition.
* Supports opportunity\-level sales strategy by helping define the solutioning approach, win themes, differentiation, client messaging, delivery model, and commercial positioning.
* Documents sales solutioning approach, pricing strategy, proposal assumptions, client notes, meeting outputs, action items, and key decisions throughout the sales cycle.
* Supports the creation and maintenance of reusable solutioning assets, proposal templates, capability decks, service descriptions, standard responses, and knowledge repositories.
* Conducts market research, company research, prospect research, procurement maturity research, and industry analysis to support sales pursuits and client conversations.
* Assists in qualifying opportunities by assessing client fit, scope relevance, service alignment, procurement needs, potential deal size, and readiness to engage.
* Supports the end\-to\-end sales cycle from inbound opportunity through proposal development, client presentations, follow\-ups, negotiations, and closure.
* Helps shorten the sales cycle by producing timely, accurate, and client\-relevant solution materials.
* Works with internal stakeholders to ensure solution quality, consistency, commercial viability, and alignment with ProcureAbility’s service offerings.
* Interfaces with Legal, Finance, Sales, and Delivery teams to support contract triage, negotiation inputs, scope clarification, and proposal assumptions.
* Maintains accurate opportunity documentation in CRM tools such as HubSpot, including pipeline notes, sales activities, proposal status, next steps, and forecasting inputs.
* Supports sales metrics tracking, dashboard updates, reporting, and internal stakeholder communication related to pipeline and pursuit progress.
* Drives standardization and continuous improvement in solutioning processes, proposal development, RFx response quality, sales documentation, and pursuit governance.
* Supports internal review meetings, proposal readouts, pursuit strategy discussions, client presentation preparation, and executive briefings.
* Helps develop strong storytelling and differentiated value propositions for C\-suite and senior procurement stakeholders.
* Represents ProcureAbility professionally in client interactions, conferences, webinars, and business development discussions as required.
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**MANAGEMENT \& SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------------------------

* Typically reports to Management. Direct supervisor job title(s) may include:
  

**Manager – Solutions, Senior Manager – Solutions, Director – Solutions, Director – Sales Solutioning, or Head of Solutions.**
* This role is generally an individual contributor position but may be required to coordinate workstreams with analysts, consultants, SMEs, delivery teams, or proposal support resources.
* May provide guidance, coaching, review comments, and quality oversight to junior team members supporting proposal development, research, documentation, and CRM updates.
* May lead specific pursuit workstreams, proposal sections, solution development activities, or internal coordination efforts depending on opportunity size and complexity.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------

### **Experience Requirements**

* Minimum of 10 **years of experience** in procurement consulting, procurement operations, business development, sales solutioning, proposal development, or related professional services roles.
* Experience working in or supporting the **procurement consulting** or procurement managed services environment.
* Experience supporting US\-based and global clients across different time zones.
* Experience developing proposals, RFx responses, client presentations, sales collateral, and executive\-ready documentation.
* Experience supporting business development, lead qualification, solution design, opportunity pursuit, and sales cycle management.
* Experience in procurement solution areas such as strategic sourcing, category management, procurement operations, supplier management, market intelligence, analytics, digital procurement, or managed services.
* Experience supporting negotiations, contract reviews, scope definition, commercial assumptions, or contract administration is preferred.
* Experience working with CRM tools such as HubSpot or similar pipeline management platforms is preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS**
--------------------------

* Strong understanding of procurement functions, including sourcing, category management, supplier management, procurement operations, spend analytics, market intelligence, and procurement transformation.
* Strong knowledge of procurement consulting and managed services delivery models.
* Ability to understand client procurement challenges and translate them into practical, structured, and differentiated solutions.
* Strong business development mindset with the ability to identify client needs, shape opportunities, and support sales conversion.
* Excellent storytelling, proposal writing, documentation, and executive presentation skills.
* Strong ability to create compelling PowerPoint presentations, solution documents, executive summaries, and RFx responses.
* Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders, including senior leaders and C\-suite client executives.
* Strong active listening skills and ability to ask thoughtful, clarifying questions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with sales, delivery, legal, finance, leadership, and subject matter expert teams.
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple pursuits, deadlines, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and ability to work in a metrics\-driven sales and solutioning environment.
* Strong analytical and research skills, including market research, company research, competitor research, and procurement trend analysis.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially **PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams** .
* Ability to provide **6 or more hours of overlap with the US Eastern Time Zone** .
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven, and collaborative team environment.
* Self\-starter with strong ownership, initiative, confidence, and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Procurement solutioning
* Proposal and RFx development
* Client relationship support
* Business development support
* Executive communication
* Storytelling and presentation development
* Stakeholder management
* Active listening and consultative questioning
* Market and prospect research
* Sales pipeline documentation
* CRM discipline
* Commercial awareness
* Attention to detail
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Time\-zone flexibility
* Continuous improvement mindset

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Engineering, Finance, or a related field required.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred but not mandatory.
* Procurement, supply chain, sourcing, or consulting certifications such as CPSM, CSCP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent credentials are preferred.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**
------------------------

* Prior experience in a procurement consulting, managed services, advisory, BPO, or professional services environment.
* Experience supporting Fortune 500 or global enterprise clients.
* Experience creating sales pursuit materials for procurement transformation, sourcing, category management, procurement operations, analytics, or digital procurement opportunities.
* Experience working with senior procurement stakeholders such as CPOs, procurement VPs, category leaders, finance leaders, and transformation leaders.
* Experience working with global delivery teams and distributed stakeholders.
* Exposure to procurement technologies, analytics platforms, CRM tools, and digital procurement solutions.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**
----------------------

* Role may require flexibility to support US\-based stakeholders and clients across time zones.
* May require attendance at client meetings, conferences, sales events, workshops, or internal strategy sessions.

b650fcb5.title: SFCC - Salesforce Commerce Cloud - QA Engineer
b650fcb5.description:
**Location****:**
India, Ahmedabad
**Department:** India Delivery Center
**Type:** Fulltime
  
**QA Engineer, SFCC**
=====================


### **About Astound Digital**



At Astound Digital, we are pioneers in the digital landscape, dedicated to transforming how the world interacts with technology, data, and creativity. Our role as trusted advisors in the digital landscape empowers the world’s most innovative brands with frictionless, end\-to\-end customer experiences. We are known for our comprehensive solutions, proven expertise, and collaborative, nimble approach that instills confidence in our clients. We embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation, efficiency, and better outcomes for our clients and employees. Join us to navigate and lead in the ever\-changing digital world, where your impact will extend beyond the ordinary.


### **Job Purpose**



As a QA Engineer specializing in Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), you will independently own testing for assigned features or a defined delivery area within an established project QA approach.



You will analyze business requirements, storefront behavior, Business Manager configuration, integration dependencies, and change impact; define appropriate risk\-based coverage; execute functional, exploratory, API, integration, and regression testing; investigate defects; and communicate quality status and remaining risks.



You will collaborate with engineering, delivery, product, and client stakeholders and contribute practical SFCC testing knowledge to the project team.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Own testing for assigned SFCC features or a defined delivery area from requirements analysis through execution, defect follow\-up, and quality reporting.
* Review requirements, acceptance criteria, customer journeys, solution details, Business Manager configurations, and integration contracts to identify gaps, dependencies, ambiguities, and testability risks.
* Apply risk\-based testing to prioritize critical customer journeys, changed areas, integrations, data conditions, and regression exposure within the established project QA strategy.
* Define and execute effective coverage across storefront, Business Manager, API, integration, system, end\-to\-end, regression, and exploratory testing levels.
* Validate critical e\-commerce journeys including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, payments, pricing, promotions, inventory, customer accounts, localization, and order processing.
* Validate relevant SFCC configuration and data in Business Manager, including catalogs, price books, inventory lists, promotions, campaigns, customer groups, site preferences, jobs, feeds, and replication where applicable.
* Design and execute API and integration testing for OCAPI, SCAPI, LINK cartridges, payment, tax, fraud, search, shipping, OMS, ERP, inventory, customer\-data, and other connected services.
* Validate authentication, payloads, schemas, negative scenarios, error handling, asynchronous processing, and cross\-system data consistency.
* Prepare and maintain suitable test data and verify environment, configuration, integration, and deployment preconditions before relying on test results.
* Investigate and document defects across application, configuration, integration, test\-data, environment, and third\-party service layers, providing clear evidence, impact, severity rationale, and reproduction steps.
* Estimate assigned QA work and communicate assumptions, dependencies, blockers, test\-data needs, regression impact, and remaining quality risks.
* Participate in refinement, technical discussions, defect triage, status reviews, release validation, and production smoke testing, raising quality concerns early.
* Identify valuable automation candidates and contribute to automated regression coverage when an established framework and assignment scope support it.
* Apply baseline accessibility, performance, security, resilience, browser, device, and localization checks to critical journeys, escalating when specialist validation is required.
* Use approved AI\-assisted QA tools for analysis, test design, documentation, and defect investigation while validating generated outputs against requirements and application evidence.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Typically 2\+ years of professional software\-testing experience, including hands\-on Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2C testing experience.
* Practical knowledge of SFCC storefront functionality and Business Manager configuration.
* Experience with at least one SFCC implementation model such as SFRA, SiteGenesis, etc.
* Experience with requirements analysis, risk\-based testing, exploratory testing, functional testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Hands\-on API and integration\-testing experience using Postman or an equivalent tool, including authentication, payload validation, negative scenarios, error handling, and data consistency.
* Experience testing critical e\-commerce journeys and third\-party services such as payment, tax, fraud, search, shipping, OMS, ERP, or inventory systems.
* Ability to prepare test data, validate environment and configuration preconditions, and distinguish application defects from configuration, integration, data, or environment issues.
* Ability to estimate assigned work and communicate assumptions, blockers, technical issues, quality status, and residual risks clearly.
* Solid understanding of web fundamentals including HTTP, REST, browser behavior, cookies, sessions, and client\-server interaction.
* Professional English communication skills sufficient for effective collaboration in a global delivery environment.


Preferred Qualifications


* Experience testing OCAPI or SCAPI services and complex SFCC integration landscapes.
* Experience across more than one SFCC architecture model, including SFRA, SiteGenesis, Composable Storefront, or PWA Kit.
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or another web\-test automation framework within an established automation solution.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated regression execution.
* Exposure to accessibility, performance, security, resilience, or multi\-region commerce testing.
* Client\-facing consultancy experience.
* A relevant Salesforce or commerce\-platform certification.

### **What we offer in return**


* **Global Collaboration:** The opportunity to work daily with diverse and talented professionals across the globe.
* **Off\-the\-Charts Career Growth:** Сlear career path and a performance review system, career coaching, training and certifications, mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* **Well\-being Is Top Priority:** Parental leave, paid time off, comprehensive health and medical plans.
* **Real Work\-Life Balance:** Dependent on location, we offer remote, in\-office, or hybrid working modes; flexible hours; work\-life balance support on every stage and level.

### **Why work for Astound Digital?**



Whether you’re working directly with our world\-renowned clients or with your Astound colleagues from around the globe, you will shape the future of digital commerce, using emerging technologies and innovative approaches.


**Grow your career with Astound Digital, and discover exciting opportunities while doing the work you love!**

07ee7b19.title: Principal Program Manager
07ee7b19.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

**Your Role**
 In this multi\-faceted role, you will be a key contributor to PTC’s Product Development teams, responsible for driving both release execution, as well as strategic programs and initiatives toward achieving the organization’s best\-in\-class goals. You will be relied on to lead highly complex projects. You will work closely with executive leaders and subject matter experts across departments and business units, and the Program Management Office team to achieve successful project results.
   

  

 To excel in this role, you must have excellent communications skills, an overall understanding of business processes, acumen to use advanced program management skills and the ability to think strategically and tactically. You will be expected to drive best practices, methodologies, tools, and improvements. You will be expected to work in a dynamic, collaborative, cross\-functional team environment with a global team. You should be detail\-oriented and enjoy working with teams to implement projects and initiatives. You should be passionate about process improvement.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 PMO shapes the processes and augments R\&D in their deliveries across segments and drives high impact programs. You will directly participate in the planning, development and launch of market\-leading strategic products across the digital thread portfolio. You will also support the definition and successful execution of strategic R\&D programs, on time and to the satisfaction of the stakeholders.
   

  

**Your Team**
 You will be part of Central R\&D Program Management Office, which works with all product development functions in locations across the world to deliver products. Our culture is one of collaboration, both within our team and across all the product development functions. Since the team works across different products, the experience sharing helps continual learning and improvement, aligning with common practices and reaching forward to advance and improve with every product cycle.
   

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day**
* Work with PM, Engineering \& QA teams on delivering projects and releases to meet R\&D strategic goals
* Plan, schedule, and control the build, test, and deployment of releases
* Enable and drive efficient release process / governance with no supervision
* Proactively identify, communicate, and manage risks
* Identify and manage dependencies, coordinate delivery across scrum teams
* Measure release cadence and effectiveness using common metrics; own release dashboards
* Drive process adoption, analyze current processes, identify gaps, and improve processes.
* Introduce new processes as per business priorities with minimal to no guidance from the immediate manager
* Coordinate release and backlog planning and prioritization between PM and R\&D teams
* Plan and lead periodic release status review meetings with senior management
* Lead all change management activities and ensure timely decisions on change requests
* Project manage functional working teams to implement actionable plans with strategic, technical, and tactical milestones
* Build best practices and lead analysis for continued improvements through RCAs and retrospectives.
* Drive strategic programs and engage the senior management and responsible stakeholders well while continuously grabbing opportunities to push the program forward.
* Organize and lead cross\-functional teams to ensure program execution from ideation and planning to successful implementation
* Drive execution of assigned strategic initiatives through all required phases towards successful delivery
* Define and use tools and business systems required to support existing process and best practices
* Support R\&D decision making through analytical reports and appropriate metrics; design and own R\&D dashboards; establish status reporting for the cross\-functional teams
* Collaborate with other Program and Release managers to define and improve organizational standards for programs, releases, processes and best practices


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree; Masters and/or PMP preferred
* 7\-12 years of experience in product development organizations, with minimum of 5 years in a program or project management role.
* Good understanding and working knowledge of Agile Scrum software product development methodology, good knowledge of Scrum Master responsibilities; SAFe knowledge a plus.
* Comfort in managing multiple projects with multiple business partners in a fast\-paced and dynamic team environment
* Self\-starter who can earn trust and can influence and motivate without authority
* Ability to work independently, as well as mentor and support more junior colleagues as needed
* Proactive in identifying and solving problems, looks beyond the obvious and can find the root of the problem
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
* Is effective in different presentation settings especially with large groups
* Proven ability to ‘Drive vs Coordinate’ to accomplish desired outcomes
* Strong business acumen and high comfort level dealing with ambiguity
* Ability to build and cultivate strong cross\-functional relationships
* Excellent facilitator, able to drive collaboration across the teams
* High level of organization and attention to detail
* Data savvy; Able to interpret data and use the knowledge for introducing optimization at different levels
* Fluent with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project management tools (Jira/Confluence, Qlik, Smartsheet, MS Project)
* Experience driving positive change via process improvement
* Keen interest in learning new methodologies and willingness to be coached and mentored for senior level engagements


 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

 Pre‑Sales Solution Engineer with

5433d152.title: Solutions Architect
5433d152.description:
**About the Role** 




  






 At Techjays, we are helping companies reimagine how they build, operate, and scale with AI at the core. We operate as part of the 1% of companies globally that can truly leverage AI the right way \- not just as experimentation, but as secure, scalable, production\-grade systems that drive measurable business outcomes.
 




  






 We are looking for a Solution Architect who can bridge the gap between client needs and technical delivery \- someone who can walk into a room with a prospective client, understand their business challenges, and walk out with a compelling, technically sound solution.
 




  






 This role sits at the intersection of pre\-sales, solutioning, and delivery governance. You will work closely with our directors, engineering leads, and clients to shape AI\-native solutions that are practical, scalable, and enterprise\-ready.
 




  





**Experience** 

 : 10\+ Years
 




**Location** 

 : Coimbatore / Hybrid
 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  






 ● Own the end\-to\-end solutioning process \- from understanding client requirements to designing architectures that are technically sound and commercially viable.
 





 ● Partner with the pre\-sales and business development team to respond to RFPs, build proposals, create solution decks, and participate in client presentations and discovery calls.
 





 ● Conduct architecture reviews and technical assessments for ongoing projects, ensuring solutions align with best practices, scalability requirements, and client expectations.
 





 ● Translate complex business problems into clear, structured technical solutions involving AI, cloud, backend systems, and integrations.
 





 ● Define high\-level and low\-level architecture for AI\-native applications including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and enterprise data platforms.
 





 ● Act as a technical advisor to clients during pre\-sales and early delivery phases, building confidence and trust through clarity and expertise.
 





 ● Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure smooth handoff from solutioning to execution, maintaining architecture integrity throughout delivery.
 





 ● Stay current with emerging AI technologies, cloud platforms, and enterprise architecture trends to bring relevant, forward\-thinking solutions to clients.
 




  





**Key Skillsets** 




  






 ● Strong foundation in backend engineering \- Python, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems.
 





 ● Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
 





 ● Good understanding of AI\-native solution design including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
 





 ● Experience with enterprise databases, data architecture, and integration patterns.
 





 ● Proven ability to create solution documents, architecture diagrams, and proposal decks that are clear and client\-ready.
 





 ● Strong grasp of security, scalability, and compliance considerations in enterprise systems.
 




  





  





**What We Are Looking For Beyond Skills** 




  






 ● A client\-first mindset \- able to listen, understand, and translate business pain into technical clarity.
 





 ● Strong communication and presentation skills \- comfortable leading conversations with C\-level stakeholders and technical teams alike.
 





 ● Structured thinker who can simplify complexity without losing technical depth.
 





 ● High ownership \- takes accountability for the quality and viability of every solution they sign off on.
 





 ● Collaborative by nature \- works well across sales, delivery, and engineering without ego.
 





 ● Passion for building solutions that solve real problems, not just showcase technology.
 




  





  





**What We Offer** 




  






 ● Flexible work environment
 





 ● Paid holidays and flexible time off
 





 ● Medical insurance (Self and Family up to ₹4 Lakhs per person)
 





 ● Opportunity to work on production\-grade AI systems
 





 ● Exposure to global clients and high\-impact pre\-sales engagements
 





 ● A culture that values clarity, integrity, and continuous growth

2d1ba674.title: Solutions Consultant - BFSI
2d1ba674.description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on\-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross\-platform solutions
* Your ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio based on customer business needs
* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
* Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions
* Demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to influence through effective presentations and customer\-specific demos, technical engagements, and workshops
* Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities
* Orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one\-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy
* Promoting end\-to\-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
* Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating our leadership
* Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever\-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
* (OT) \- Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap.


**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

72338260.title: Presales Solution Consultant
72338260.description:
**Siemens Digital Industries Software** 
 is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacturing of products across a wide range of industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the products we use every day are conceived, engineered, and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 As part of our continued growth, we are seeking a driven and highly motivated
 **Senior Presales Solutions Consultant** 
 to join our Technical Solutions team in
 **Bangalore, India** 
 . This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact by helping customers accelerate innovation through advanced simulation and digital engineering technologies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in Computer\-Aided Engineering (CAE) and simulation with strong customer\-facing consulting and technical sales skills. You will engage with engineering leaders, technical teams, and business stakeholders to understand their challenges, position Siemens Digital Industries Software solutions, and support strategic digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

 This position is intended for an experienced simulation professional who can leverage extensive CAE knowledge to support opportunities across the
 **Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, Industrial Machinery, Electronics, and Energy** 
 industries. The focus will be on driving customer engagements, conducting technical discovery workshops, delivering proof\-of\-concept projects, and enabling digital thread and digital twin transformation initiatives using the
 **Siemens Simcenter portfolio** 
 and the broader
 **Siemens Xcelerator platform** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technical discovery sessions, customer workshops, and consultative engagements.
* Position Simcenter 3D and Siemens Xcelerator solutions to address customer engineering and business challenges.
* Deliver compelling solution demonstrations, technical presentations, and executive briefings.
* Define, plan, and execute Proof\-of\-Concept (PoC) projects to demonstrate solution value.
* Support RFP responses, compliance assessments, competitive evaluations, and technical proposals.
* Drive discussions around Digital Twin, Digital Thread, Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), and simulation\-driven engineering.
* Collaborate closely with sales teams, account managers, partners, and industry specialists to qualify and advance strategic opportunities.
* Enable customers, partners, and internal teams through technical workshops, training sessions, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them define and execute their digital engineering and simulation strategies.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in CAE, simulation, engineering consulting, application engineering, technical account management, or technical presales.
* Strong expertise in one or more simulation domains, including:
+ Structural Analysis

a5881a34.description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made. What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
 In this role, you will help retail and CPG customers optimize their merchandising financial plans and assortment processes through scalable SaaS solutions that drive measurable business impact. You will partner with customers and cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into effective, scalable solution designs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**What lands you in this role**
* Develop strong breadth and depth across Impact Analytics planning solutions, including PlanSmart, AssortSmart, and ItemSmart, and articulate how each solution supports customer business objectives.
* Independently lead discovery and design workshops with customer business and functional stakeholders to understand current\-state processes, pain points, decision flows, and operational constraints.
* Translate customer As\-Is processes into clear To\-Be workflows within the product, aligning business needs with platform capabilities and best practices.
* Ask the right diagnostic and probing questions to uncover requirements, edge cases, dependencies, and decision criteria needed to shape an optimal solution.
* Evaluate and communicate trade\-offs between flow simplicity, user experience, scalability, configurability, and engineering effort while recommending the most practical path forward.
* Partner with product and delivery teams to identify repeatable, high\-value use cases and contribute to broadly applicable solution patterns that can benefit multiple customers.
* Build a strong understanding of the forecasting engine, downstream integrations, data flows, and related operational processes to anticipate delivery risks and advise on implementation considerations.
* Support client delivery and product delivery teams by proactively highlighting complications, edge cases, data dependencies, and process impacts that should be addressed during solution planning and rollout.
* Drive SIT (System Integration Tests) and UAT (User Acceptance Tests) with customer users using the train\-the\-trainer model deployed by Impact Analytics, ensuring users can effectively validate core business flows and gain confidence before go\-live.
* Address customer knowledge gaps during training and testing phases, driving outcomes by focusing users on the most relevant use cases and business problems based on the client’s context.
* Influence customer stakeholders and secure buy\-in for process changes that improve adoption, simplify workflows, and enable a more effective migration to the platform.
* Meaningfully contribute to assessments of the Planning suite P\&L to understand the trade\-offs and business implications involved in client\-specific customizations, major product upgrades, and differentiated upgrade paths based on customer tiering.
* Contribute to customer presentations, solution recommendations, and internal alignment discussions with clear, structured communication.
* Maintain clear accountability boundaries with Delivery/Implementation and Customer Success teams, particularly at discovery handoff, design review, and UAT sign\-off.


**Desired Profile**
* Experience in solution consulting, implementation consulting, business consulting, pre\-sales consulting, or a similar customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Prior experience with SaaS implementations or consulting engagements in retail or CPG environments is strongly preferred.
* A good understanding of merchandising, assortment, or adjacent retail planning processes is a must\-have.
* Experience in analytics roles or analytics\-led projects is a strong plus, especially where data\-driven recommendations informed business process changes.
* Ability to facilitate workshops, synthesize business requirements, and convert ambiguous needs into structured solution designs.
* Experience driving SIT, UAT, knowledge transfer, and train\-the\-trainer enablement in enterprise software implementations is highly valuable.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively, build trust, and influence customer decision\-making.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, delivery, and commercial teams in a fast\-moving SaaS environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts in a simple and business\-relevant way.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to understand the business impact of solution choices, especially in relation to customization and product investment decisions.
* Willingness to travel based on customer and project needs.


**What Successful Outcomes Would Look Like**
* Customers gain clarity on how their planning and assortment processes should operate in the platform.
* Delivery teams receive solution designs that are practical, scalable, and mindful of downstream dependencies.
* UAT, SIT, and training activities improve user readiness, adoption confidence, and implementation quality ahead of go\-live.
* Product teams benefit from structured feedback on common customer use cases, customization implications, and enhancement opportunities.
* Customer stakeholders align around process changes needed for successful implementation and long\-term value realization.
* Design gaps are caught during discovery and design review rather than surfacing during UAT or after go\-live, reducing rework and schedule risk.
* Time from discovery kickoff to signed\-off solution design is tracked against methodology phase gates and completed within expected timelines.


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to be part of some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India.
* Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem\-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions.
* A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude.
* A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure.
* Remuneration with best\-in\-class industry standards with generous health insurance cover


**Some Of Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune—alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Uniﬁed Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

50aa688d.title: Field Architect
50aa688d.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer\-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud\-native applications, and large\-scale data infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team to ensure customers are successful through technical discovery, architecture design, proof\-of\-value execution, production onboarding, performance validation, and long\-term expansion. Success in this role requires deep technical curiosity, hands\-on architecture skills, strong communication, and the ability to connect AIStor’s capabilities to the data\-intensive workloads that matter most to our customers.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Technical Architecture and Discovery: Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, application requirements, data architecture, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Define scalable AIStor architectures that map directly to those requirements.
* AI and Analytics Workload Design: Define and validate AIStor architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics platforms, data lakehouse environments, high\-performance data pipelines, large object workloads, and modern application data services.
* Object Storage and S3 Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in object storage, S3\-compatible architectures, distributed systems, metadata, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large\-scale namespace design.


 Customer Engagement \& Advisory
   

  

* Customer Technical Advisor: Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, including infrastructure, platform, analytics, AI, security, application, and operations teams. Guide customers toward informed architecture decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.
* Proof\-of\-Value Execution: Lead technical evaluations, system configurations, performance testing, interoperability validation, and proof\-of\-value engagements that demonstrate AIStor’s value in real customer environments.
* Customer Success Beyond the Win: Partner with Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers move from evaluation to production and from initial deployment to broader adoption across additional workloads, teams, and use cases.


 Ecosystem, Enablement \& Field Operations
   

  

* Cloud\-Native and Kubernetes Guidance: Provide technical leadership on Kubernetes, containers, automation, and cloud\-native deployment patterns, including hybrid cloud, private cloud, public cloud, and edge infrastructure models.
* Solution Integration and Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with technology partners, reseller partners, and customer teams to support complete solutions involving analytics engines, AI platforms, Kubernetes distributions, data protection tools, identity systems, observability platforms, and public cloud services.
* Technical Presentations and Enablement: Build and deliver compelling architecture presentations, whiteboard sessions, demonstrations, best practices, workshops, and technical enablement sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* RFP, RFI, and Technical Response Support: Contribute to or lead technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, security reviews, architecture questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.


 Product Intelligence \& Market Expertise
   

  

* Product and Engineering Feedback: Advocate for customer requirements internally by capturing field feedback, competitive insights, workload patterns, integration needs, and enhancement opportunities. Work with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and improve customer outcomes.
* Competitive and Market Expertise: Stay current on object storage, data lakehouse, AI infrastructure, analytics, Kubernetes, cloud, and competitive storage trends. Help internal teams and customers understand where AIStor is differentiated.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong background in enterprise storage, object storage, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or high\-performance data\-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of object storage concepts and S3\-compatible architectures; experience with HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, security models, replication, data protection, and scale\-out system design is highly valuable.
* 10\+ years of experience in a senior customer\-facing technical role such as Field Architect, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux, networking, storage systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern data center infrastructure.
* Experience designing or supporting AI, machine learning, analytics, data lakehouse, or large\-scale data pipeline environments.
* Familiarity with ecosystem technologies such as Databricks, Starburst, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI and analytics frameworks is a strong plus.
* Experience with public cloud and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, or private cloud platforms.
* Ability to conduct technical discovery, design architectures, build demonstrations, guide proof\-of\-value execution, analyze performance, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Comfortable working with heterogeneous enterprise environments involving compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and application teams.
* Strong verbal, written, whiteboarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customers, partners, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Strong customer\-success orientation, intellectual curiosity, sense of ownership, and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast\-moving environment.

**Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**


When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**


We are seeking a skilled **IT Architect (Azure Cloud Architect**) to join **Azure Platform Services \-CAT IT Division**


The preference for this role is to be based out of **Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**

**What you will do**

* Architect and design applications that run on Azure China/21Vianet and Commercial clouds by providing technical expertise and guidance in cloud technologies.
* Work with GCIO teams to champion the Azure services available and how they can enable the business to run more efficiently in Azure.
* Lead migrations from on\-premise deployments to Azure cloud environment.
* Work with the Principal Architects and IT Teams to develop roadmaps for Azure cloud services.
* Work with the IT Security team on analysis and security architecture for major initiatives.
* Work with other IT teams to establish, design, and support an enterprise cloud architecture that provides the required capacity plans and supports the long\-term strategic goals for enterprise cloud technologies.
* Lead and perform development, automation, and deployment assignments without close supervision.
* Complete technical evaluation of Azure cloud services for general on\-boarding including aligning service capabilities to business requirements, reference architecture designs, and controls to securely deploy solutions.
* Assist with documentation, training, and usability efforts.

**What you will have**

* Strong IT infrastructure and/or software development experience, especially in networking, application services, and distributed computing.
* Technical leadership or lead developer experience.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud architecture, systems design, application design, and development.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience automating infrastructure or application deployments using PowerShell, Python, Java, NodeJS, .NET, JSON, or YAML.
* Strong English communication, teamwork, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and customer service skills.
* **This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week schedule in the office.**

**Top Candidates Will Also Have:**

* Microsoft Azure Certification(s) such as: AZ\-305, AZ\-500, AZ\-104, AZ\-900, AZ\-204, or AZ\-400
* Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tools such as Azure DevOps
* Experience with the Azure Portal, CLI, PowerShell cmdlets, and/or REST APIs
* Experience using the Agile methodology
* Experience designing and/or building Azure solutions including web\-based UI or API applications, IoT solutions, data pipelines, or machine learning/AI capabilities.
* Experience working with corporate security on infrastructure or applications security compliance and remediation activities (e.g, Risk Acceptance, Security Configuration Baseline)

**Skills desired:**

**Core Application Systems: Knowledge** of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Manages application\-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

  

**Analytical Thinking**: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.  

Level Working Knowledge:  

* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
* Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
* Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
* Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
* Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

  

**Technical Excellence:** Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.  

Level Working Knowledge:  

* Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
* Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up\-to\-date on technical and procedural job components.
* Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
* Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
* Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

  

**Software Product Design/Architecture:** Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Demonstrates experience with the architecture and design of major or multiple products.
* Describes major software architecture alternatives and considerations.
* Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web.
* Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product.
* Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs.
* Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture.

  

**Application Modernization**: Knowledge of the concepts, processes and technologies of application modernization; ability to design, develop and deploy modernized applications in various business scenarios.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Creates and customizes cloud application modernization plans based on specific business requirements.
* Consults on security issues and problems regarding application migration.
* Coaches others on the modernization approach for microservice based application.
* Leads discussions on the challenges and risks in developing cloud\-native based applications.
* Provides insights on complex technical problems of co\-existence of legacy and new application systems.
* Compares and contrasts the benefits and drawbacks of various application modernization approaches.

  

**Architecture Modeling:** Knowledge of Architecture Modeling; ability to develop and modify enterprise architecture through conceptual, logical and physical approaches.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Consults on architecture framework design; verifies operational objectives for each framework design procedure.
* Determines corresponding indicators for each technology layer and evaluates the operational performance of each layer.
* Decides on specific roles and responsibilities of engineers within business, information and data architecture modeling.
* Coordinates materials for architecture design modeling.
* Evaluates technology product roles and strengths within the project and locates appropriate technology providers based on results.
* Interprets relevant principles for technology architecture modeling requirements from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).

  

**Business Assessment:** Knowledge of the activities, tasks, practices and deliverables for assessing and documenting business opportunities; ability to assess the benefits, risks, and success factors of potential applications.  

Level Working Knowledge:  

* Applies tools and techniques for gathering business requirements.
* Defines the activities, deliverables, and tools of a business assessment process.
* Documents best practices and techniques for assessing application opportunities.
* Participates in conducting and documenting business assessments.
* Participates in the preparation of risk assessment and benefits analysis.

  

**System and Technology Integration**: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  

Level Working Knowledge:  

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.
 **What you will get:**

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.
* Relocation assistance

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
* Career developments opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Employee mental wellness assistance program


**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers


This position requires working onsite five days a week.

0fd601d1.description:
How to contribute to our vision
   

  

 As an Enterprise Architect for Infrastructure, you will be a senior strategic leader responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the comprehensive infrastructure architecture for the entire organization. You will play a pivotal role in designing enterprise infrastructure architectures that span both Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) environments, enabling secure, reliable, and high\-performance connectivity between enterprise systems, industrial assets, IoT platforms, and cloud services. The core of your responsibilities will involve creating and managing the enterprise infrastructure roadmap, from evaluating the current state ('as\-is') to defining the target state ('to\-be') architecture.
   

  

 What You Need To Make a Difference
   

  

* 40% Architecture \& Strategy
+ Analyze industry trends, emerging technologies, and infrastructure best practices to continuously evolve the enterprise infrastructure architecture and create business value.
+ Define and communicate the target Infrastructure Architecture vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation initiatives, and enterprise architecture principles.
+ Develop and maintain the Infrastructure Transformation Roadmap, assessing current\-state capabilities and defining future\-state architectures across cloud, data center, network, workplace, and edge environments.
+ Shape the enterprise strategy for: Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS) Data Centers and Hosting Compute and Storage Networks and Connectivity End User Computing and Workplace Services Infrastructure Automation Platform Engineering Observability and Monitoring Backup, Recovery, and Business Continuity
+ Define architecture requirements for infrastructure services supporting Data, AI, Engineering, PLM, ALM, IoT, Digital Twin, and OT workloads.

* 40% Digital Transformation
+ Establish enterprise\-wide infrastructure architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and technology guardrails.
+ Drive the modernization and simplification of infrastructure platforms, reducing complexity, technical debt, and operational risk while improving scalability and performance.
+ Lead architecture assessments and evaluate infrastructure solutions, balancing business requirements, operational resilience, security, performance, sustainability, and cost optimization.
+ Define the target operating model for cloud and hybrid infrastructure services, enabling self\-service, automation, standardization, and platform\-based delivery.
+ Ensure infrastructure platforms are resilient, scalable, sustainable, and capable of supporting current and future business demands.

* 20% Collaboration \& Leadership
+ Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Security Architects, Platform Teams, and IT Operations to ensure alignment between business requirements and infrastructure capabilities.
+ Contribute to technology portfolio management, lifecycle planning, investment prioritization, and vendor strategy decisions.
+ Mentor architects and technology leaders while promoting infrastructure architecture best practices and knowledge sharing across the organization.


 Certifications
   

  

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* TOGAF
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) or Cisco CCNP Enterprise or Cisco CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader
* Kubernetes (CKA)
* Terraform Associate
* FinOps Practitioner


 Education
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Platform Architecture, or related IT leadership roles.
* Proven experience designing and governing large\-scale enterprise infrastructure environments in global organizations.
* Experience leading infrastructure modernization, cloud transformation, data center transformation, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience aligning infrastructure investments with business objectives and enterprise architecture strategies.
* Strong background in infrastructure strategy, technology roadmaps, architecture governance, and operating model transformation.


**Skills**
* Architectural Frameworks \& Methodologies
+ Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM)

* Technical Expertise
+ Cloud Platforms and Services
+ Data Center Technologies
+ Server, Compute, and Storage Platforms
+ Enterprise Networks and Connectivity
+ Workplace and End User Services
+ Virtualization and Container Platforms
+ Platform Engineering
+ Infrastructure Automation
+ Observability and Monitoring
+ Backup, Recovery, and Business Continuity

* Leadership \& Communication Skills
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and executive\-level recommendations.
+ Strong consulting, facilitation, and influencing capabilities across business, architecture, engineering, and operations teams.
+ Proven ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
+ Collaborative mindset with a passion for mentoring architects and enabling technology communities.
+ Open\-minded, curious, and committed to continuous learning and innovation.

 We are seeking a skilled
 **IT Architect (Azure Cloud Architect** 
 ) to join
 **Azure Platform Services \-CAT IT Division**
 The preference for this role is to be based out of
 **Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**
****What You Will Do****
* Architect and design applications that run on Azure China/21Vianet and Commercial clouds by providing technical expertise and guidance in cloud technologies.
* Work with GCIO teams to champion the Azure services available and how they can enable the business to run more efficiently in Azure.
* Lead migrations from on\-premise deployments to Azure cloud environment.
* Work with the Principal Architects and IT Teams to develop roadmaps for Azure cloud services.
* Work with the IT Security team on analysis and security architecture for major initiatives.
* Work with other IT teams to establish, design, and support an enterprise cloud architecture that provides the required capacity plans and supports the long\-term strategic goals for enterprise cloud technologies.
* Lead and perform development, automation, and deployment assignments without close supervision.
* Complete technical evaluation of Azure cloud services for general on\-boarding including aligning service capabilities to business requirements, reference architecture designs, and controls to securely deploy solutions.
* Assist with documentation, training, and usability efforts.


****What You Will Have****
* Strong IT infrastructure and/or software development experience, especially in networking, application services, and distributed computing.
* Technical leadership or lead developer experience.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud architecture, systems design, application design, and development.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience automating infrastructure or application deployments using PowerShell, Python, Java, NodeJS, .NET, JSON, or YAML.
* Strong English communication, teamwork, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and customer service skills.
* This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week schedule in the office.


****Top Candidates Will Also Have:****
* Microsoft Azure Certification(s) such as: AZ\-305, AZ\-500, AZ\-104, AZ\-900, AZ\-204, or AZ\-400
* Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tools such as Azure DevOps
* Experience with the Azure Portal, CLI, PowerShell cmdlets, and/or REST APIs
* Experience using the Agile methodology
* Experience designing and/or building Azure solutions including web\-based UI or API applications, IoT solutions, data pipelines, or machine learning/AI capabilities.
* Experience working with corporate security on infrastructure or applications security compliance and remediation activities (e.g, Risk Acceptance, Security Configuration Baseline)


****Skills Desired:****
**Core Application Systems: Knowledge** 
 of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Manages application\-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.


**Analytical Thinking** 
 : Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
* Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
* Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
* Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
* Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.


**Technical Excellence:** 
 Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
* Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up\-to\-date on technical and procedural job components.
* Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
* Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
* Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.


**Software Product Design/Architecture:** 
 Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Demonstrates experience with the architecture and design of major or multiple products.
* Describes major software architecture alternatives and considerations.
* Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web.
* Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product.
* Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs.
* Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture.


**Application Modernization** 
 : Knowledge of the concepts, processes and technologies of application modernization; ability to design, develop and deploy modernized applications in various business scenarios.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Creates and customizes cloud application modernization plans based on specific business requirements.
* Consults on security issues and problems regarding application migration.
* Coaches others on the modernization approach for microservice based application.
* Leads discussions on the challenges and risks in developing cloud\-native based applications.
* Provides insights on complex technical problems of co\-existence of legacy and new application systems.
* Compares and contrasts the benefits and drawbacks of various application modernization approaches.


**Architecture Modeling:** 
 Knowledge of Architecture Modeling; ability to develop and modify enterprise architecture through conceptual, logical and physical approaches.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Consults on architecture framework design; verifies operational objectives for each framework design procedure.
* Determines corresponding indicators for each technology layer and evaluates the operational performance of each layer.
* Decides on specific roles and responsibilities of engineers within business, information and data architecture modeling.
* Coordinates materials for architecture design modeling.
* Evaluates technology product roles and strengths within the project and locates appropriate technology providers based on results.
* Interprets relevant principles for technology architecture modeling requirements from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).


**Business Assessment:** 
 Knowledge of the activities, tasks, practices and deliverables for assessing and documenting business opportunities; ability to assess the benefits, risks, and success factors of potential applications.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Applies tools and techniques for gathering business requirements.
* Defines the activities, deliverables, and tools of a business assessment process.
* Documents best practices and techniques for assessing application opportunities.
* Participates in conducting and documenting business assessments.
* Participates in the preparation of risk assessment and benefits analysis.


**System and Technology Integration** 
 : Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.
* Relocation assistance


**Holistic Development**
* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
* Career developments opportunities with global prospects


**Health and Wellness**
* Medical coverage \-Medical, life and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program


**Financial Wellness**
* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance \-Annual incentive Bonus plan.

 Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers
   

  

 This position requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

 July 28, 2026 \- August 3, 2026
