f14e9ea9.title: Cloud, Data Science & AI Architect
f14e9ea9.description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise cloud, data, analytics, machine learning and Generative AI platforms.
* Architect and lead the development of scalable cloud and data platforms supporting digital transformation, business intelligence, advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
* Design cloud\-native, distributed and microservices\-based solution architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Define scalable data architectures for batch, streaming, event\-driven and real\-time processing workloads.
* Design enterprise data platforms covering data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata management, governance, analytics and consumption.
* Architect data\-lake, data\-warehouse and lakehouse solutions using platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, Synapse or equivalent technologies.
* Design cloud\-native data products, APIs and reusable services that enable business intelligence, advanced analytics and AI applications.
* Lead the architecture and deployment of machine\-learning solutions, including model development, feature engineering, deployment, monitoring, retraining and lifecycle management.
* Define and implement MLOps architectures using platforms and tools such as MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker or equivalent technologies.
* Lead the design of Generative AI solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, prompt engineering and agent\-based frameworks.
* Define AI orchestration patterns for intelligent assistants, copilots, autonomous agents and domain\-specific AI applications.
* Design and optimise enterprise\-grade data pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable and high\-quality data processing.
* Architect streaming and real\-time analytics solutions using Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming or equivalent technologies.
* Establish data\-modelling, indexing, partitioning, caching and performance\-optimisation standards for relational, NoSQL and analytical data stores.
* Design integration frameworks using APIs, event\-driven architectures, messaging platforms and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Work closely with data scientists, data engineers, cloud engineers, software architects, product teams and business stakeholders to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Establish architecture standards and best practices for cloud engineering, data engineering, DataOps, MLOps, DevSecOps, security, governance and operational excellence.
* Define modern CI/CD, automated\-testing and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure that cloud, data and AI solutions comply with enterprise requirements for security, privacy, regulatory compliance, data sovereignty and responsible AI.
* Define observability, monitoring, reliability, high\-availability, disaster\-recovery and cost\-optimisation strategies.
* Evaluate emerging cloud, analytics, data science and AI technologies and recommend appropriate enterprise adoption strategies.
* Conduct architecture assessments, technology evaluations, proofs of concept and solution trade\-off analyses.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define technical roadmaps, target\-state architectures and phased implementation strategies.


**Job Description \- Grade Specific**
* Extensive experience designing scalable, secure and highly available enterprise solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native, distributed, event\-driven and microservices\-based architectures.
* Deep expertise in designing and implementing enterprise data platforms covering ingestion, processing, storage, governance, analytics and data consumption.
* Strong experience with data\-lake, data\-warehouse and lakehouse architecture patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with data\-engineering platforms such as Apache Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent technologies.
* Strong experience with relational, NoSQL and analytical databases, including data modelling, indexing, partitioning and performance optimisation.
* Experience designing batch, near\-real\-time and real\-time data\-processing solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink or Spark Streaming.
* Strong understanding of machine\-learning and AI lifecycle management, including data preparation, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining and governance.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise MLOps platforms and practices.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience building Generative AI applications using large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation architectures.
* Experience with prompt engineering, model orchestration, grounding, evaluation, guardrails and responsible\-AI practices.
* Experience designing agent\-based and multi\-agent AI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with vector databases and semantic\-search platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, pgvector or equivalent technologies.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, together with working knowledge of at least one additional language such as Java, Golang or Node.js.
* Experience developing and deploying cloud\-native APIs, microservices and data services.
* Strong understanding of API management, service integration and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless computing and container\-based deployment architectures.
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep or equivalent automation technologies.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, master\-data management and access controls.
* Experience with cloud and data security, including encryption, identity and access management, key management, network security and secure data sharing.
* Understanding of regulatory, privacy and compliance requirements applicable to enterprise data and AI platforms.
* Familiarity with business\-intelligence and visualisation platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.
* Experience in the energy, utilities, manufacturing, rail, industrial or other asset\-intensive industries would be advantageous.

43269442.title: Cloud PreSales Senior Architect
43269442.description:
**Company Description**
**About Sopra Steria**
 Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The world is how we shape it.**
**Role Overview**
 Cloud Technology Enthusiast who love solving business problems using technology. Candidate should have excellent experience with diverse customer and partner facing roles supported technical aspects of sales activities for the technology products and services such as Cloud –PaaS \& IaaS, Databases \& tools and Systems.
   

  

 You will be a key player in the pre\-sales process and be able to understand complex customer environments and be able to build close customer relationships.

* Take full ownership of technical pre\-sales activities, driving solution strategy, competitive positioning, and customer success.
* Develop and deliver high\-impact proposals, ensuring alignment with client needs and industry best practices.
* Conduct C\-level client interactions, technical workshops, and deep\-dive discussions to position solutions effectively.
* Uses their recognised expertise to resolve issues
* Act as a trusted advisor and technology thought leader, guiding clients through their cloud transformation journeys.
* Demonstrable experience leading teams and pitching to clients
* Identifies and controls risks
* Good command of the market in their domain: competitor products, trends, changes in regulations
* Internally and, where relevant, externally recognised expertise in one or more business domains
* Oversees performance (profitability, lead\-times, quality) within their scope
* Advises senior business representatives on choices and implementation of a product
* Is a key player in pre\-sales in Cloud offerings and helps identify sales opportunities
* Contributes to steering product developments in liaison with Practice Director


**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Demonstrable experience in Azure and or AWS with a technical background and experience in technology deployments
* Demonstrable knowledge of Microsoft solutions and their application to a clients cloud strategy
* Strong leadership in orals during RFPs, client executive briefings, and high\-stakes technical demonstrations.
* Demonstrable experience of leading engagements and managing client stakeholders
* Ability to engage and influence C\-level executives, technical leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Good command of the market in their domain: competitor products, trends, changes in regulations
* Internally and, where relevant, externally recognised expertise in one or more business domains
* Recognised in one or more business domains and recognised expertise with one or more products or product groups as a whole
* Expertise in workshop facilitation techniques, particularly the fundamentals of co\-design work
* Good command of the impacts of agility
* Good command of and transfers motivational management practices
* Demonstrated experience managing several complex product assessment tasks


**Attributes and Qualities**
* High level of written and oral communication
* Appetite for business challenge
* Ability to motivate and inspire colleagues
* Customer orientated approach
* Innovative
* Problem solving skills


 Total Experience Expected: 14\-18 years
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Microsoft Azure / AWS Solutions Architect Expert
* Azure IaaS (virtual machines, storage, networking, security).
* Azure Backup \& Recovery Services.
* Azure Governance (Blueprints, policies, tagging, cost management).
* Azure SQL Databases (Managed Instances, PaaS, IaaS).
* Azure Security (Zero Trust, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure AD, AIP).
* Azure Serverless and integration (Batch, Function, Logic Apps, EventGrid).
* Azure Containers (AKS, ACI, ACR).
* Active Directory\\Entra ID (Azure AD, Azure AD DS, on premises AD DS).
* On premises infrastructure, virtualisation technologies or applications
* Experience with Windows Server\\Linux OS.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell).


**Additional Information**
**Desirable skills and experience It would be great if they had…**
* An ability to see the bigger picture, understanding where activities are inter\-related while ensuring dependencies are clear and appropriately managed to achieve success
* Adaptable and flexible to new work requests and highly demanding priorities
* Honed abilities to motivate and support others to achieve a common business goal
* Good knowledge of at least one business domain


**Key performance indicators How will they be measured?**
* Feedback from customers and colleagues
* Growth of the Practice
* Knowledge acquisition of more junior members of the practice
* Utilisation

 All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

* Ability to develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with customers, partners and consultants
* Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels of an organization to maximize problem resolution while effectively presenting information and responding to highly specialized functional questions
* Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills
* Ability to work independently effectively and proactively
* Teamwork mentality
* Contributes to the growth of the functional consulting practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral.
* Ensures compliance with the following internal and external company policies and procedures: Company project methodology On\-time submission of Time, Travel and Expenses report Company procedures related to travel and expenses
* Skill set and availability requirements as per the organization's needs

* Understanding and experience with the functional requirements for the product line assigned.
* Understanding of Database structures. Understanding of various functional platforms and infrastructures.
* Understands Blue Yonders product suite so as to convey relationships and touch\-points to the customer.
* Works with appropriate parties to ensure issues are resolved.
* Travel readiness based on business needs.

**Our Values**

  

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Position Summary The GRC \& BCP/DR Specialist is responsible for coordinating governance, risk, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery activities for Burlington Managed Network Services. The role ensures that service governance, risk and issue logs, compliance evidence, audit readiness, disaster recovery plan integration, DR testing support, and continuity reporting are managed in a structured and auditable manner. **Details:**
 Job Description
   

  

 Role is part of Stefanini's Infrastructure Services Division, the Digital Workplace Platform (DWP) team continues to grow, and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
 **Microsoft 365 Technical Architect** 
 to join our Professional Services team.
   

  

 As a
 **Microsoft 365 Architect** 
 , you will be responsible for implementing and managing Microsoft 365 solutions for our clients. You will work closely with clients to understand their business requirements and provide technical expertise to ensure successful deployment and adoption of Microsoft 365 technologies.
   

  

 We are looking for a profile with a solid Microsoft 365 technical background combined with strong customer leadership skills. This role will require significant customer interaction. The candidate must have broad, multi\-discipline, Enterprise IT experience and must deliver customer\-centric solutions that improve the user experience.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**Details:**

* Collaborate with clients to understand their technical and business needs and implement Microsoft 365 solutions that align with their goals and objectives.

* Stay up to date with the latest Microsoft 365 technologies, features, and best practices, and provide recommendations to clients for leveraging these advancements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, system administrators and project managers, to ensure seamless integration of Microsoft 365 solutions with existing systems and processes.
* Provide technical guidance and support to clients to promote adoption and maximize the benefits of Microsoft 365 technologies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Microsoft 365, including performance, connectivity, and security concerns.
* Be able to create and maintain documentation of technical architectures (HLDs, LLDs, Operations Manual, etc.), configurations (configuration checklist) and procedures (SOPs, etc.) related to Microsoft 365 solutions.

8b2cfaec.title: Customer Success Manager- Marketing cloud
8b2cfaec.description:
**Description**
 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high\-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
   

  

 advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
   

  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.


**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive\-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.


**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**
* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural\-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI\-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning \& Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross\-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision\-making.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Preferred/Mandatory Qualifications and Skills
   

  

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9\+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 2\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C\-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry\-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning \& Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.


**Cloud Specific Experience**
 Salesforce product certifications are required for this role. Recommended Marketing Cloud certifications:
   

  

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands\-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber \& data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi\-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

* Review and quality\-assure work products — including configuration, customization, testing, and documentation

- Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent Dynamics 365 CE projects to successful delivery in a consulting environment

- Strong, hands\-on configuration and customization expertise across the Dynamics 365 CE suite, including:

* Customer Service
* Contact Center / Omnichannel
* Sales
* Customer Insights – Journeys
* Field Service
* Project Operations


- Hands\-on experience with the Microsoft Power Platform, including:

* Power Automate
* Power Pages
* Copilot Studio
* Power BI
* Power Apps
* Proven solution design and architecture experience across CE, integrations, and surrounding Microsoft cloud services
* Strong business process mapping and requirements analysis skills across various Dynamics 365 CE apps
* Experience with environment and ALM management (solutions, pipelines, managed environments)
* Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior consultants and grow high\-performing teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong executive presence
* Experience working in global delivery models and collaborating with onshore/offshore stakeholders
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and consistently meet delivery commitments


**Certifications (Strongly Preferred)**
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification(s)
* Power Platform certification(s)
* Actively pursuing and maintaining Microsoft certifications is highly encouraged and supported


 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.

a72d62bf.title: Localization Program Manager
a72d62bf.description:
**About the Role**  

  

The Localization team is looking for an experienced Localization Program Manager to help scale Uber's global localization efforts. In this role, you will partner cross\-functionally with Product, Design, Content, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Regional Operations, and other teams to deliver high\-quality localized experiences that support global and regional product launches.  

  

You will own end\-to\-end localization programs, drive process improvements, and help shape the future of localization through automation and AI\-powered workflows.  

  

This is a hybrid role requiring employees to work from the office three days per week.  

  

**What You'll Do*** Manage end\-to\-end localization for Uber products and external\-facing content across all supported languages, including planning, stakeholder consultation, localization delivery, linguistic quality assurance (LQA), and localization bug management.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and other cross\-functional teams to review and influence product requirements (PRDs/RFCs), ensuring globalization and localization needs are considered early in the development lifecycle.
* Lead localization for a wide range of content, including product UI, customer support content, legal documentation, marketing campaigns, websites, surveys, contracts, dashboards, and other customer\-facing assets.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives to improve localization processes, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to enhance localization tools and workflows, partnering with Localization Technical Operations to implement improvements.
* Collaborate closely with external localization vendors and language service providers, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and on\-time execution across regional time zones.
* Monitor localization quality, timelines, budgets, and program health while identifying trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of localization project or program management experience within the technology industry, preferably on the client side.
* Strong understanding of localization, internationalization (i18n), and globalization (g11n) best practices.
* Experience leveraging modern localization technologies, including Machine Translation (MT), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI within localization workflows.
* Experience working with localization vendors supporting Fortune 100 companies or enterprise\-scale localization programs.
* Experience managing localization budgets and analyzing program metrics and trends.
* Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and drive complex programs across multiple stakeholders and regions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable solutions.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a strong focus on quality and execution.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and align cross\-functional stakeholders across varying levels of the organization.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new tools, systems, and technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience using Computer\-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools such as WorldServer, Phrase, Trados, or similar localization platforms.
* Experience managing localization across multiple content types, including product UI, Help Center/support content, marketing materials, and legal documentation.
* Experience designing or implementing GenAI\-enabled localization workflows, including AI quality evaluation and human\-in\-the\-loop review processes.

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Azure Data, the Microsoft Fabric platform team builds and maintains the operating system and provides customers a unified data stack to run an entire data estate. The platform provides a unified experience, unified governance, enables a unified business model and a unified architecture.
   

  

 We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to strengthen how Fabric Quality measures, reports, and acts on service health — a top organizational focus and a critical effort for the business. This role builds trusted reporting, automates the manual workflows behind the quality rhythm, and standardizes service\-health telemetry and metrics, so "healthy" means the same thing across teams and raw signal becomes insight leaders and engineering teams act on. The team moves quickly, and the role calls for comfort working in an agile, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 The work is hands\-on and cross\-team: identifying gaps across scenarios, defining the success criteria and metrics that matter, and ensuring the telemetry behind them is complete and trustworthy. It suits a TPM who executes reliably across multiple workstreams, cares about data correctness and consistency, and is proficient with telemetry, reporting, and automation — Power BI / DAX, Kusto, and scripting to remove manual toil. Working through ambiguity, developing hypotheses and solutions, and coordinating across engineering and data teams to land defined problems end\-to\-end — with a bias toward repeatable, AI\- and automation\-assisted workflows — rounds out the profile.
   

  

 We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end\-to\-end quality for Fabric scenarios, covering both performance (latency, regressions) and reliability (success rates, failures, and timeouts).
* Partner with engineering and data teams to onboard scenarios with complete, accurate telemetry, clear ownership, and measurable targets — and to refine the data pipelines, reporting models, and sampling strategies that keep signals consistent and accurate across environments.
* Identify monitoring gaps across key customer journeys, improving signal quality and ensuring issues are detected early with minimal noise.
* Support LiveSite by helping define alerting thresholds and partner with teams during incidents to investigate performance regressions and reliability issues, identify root causes, and drive follow\-up actions.
* Maintain and evolve the dashboards and reporting used in regular reviews — connecting performance and reliability signals into actionable insight tied to team commitments and end\-to\-end customer impact.
* Drive cross\-team coordination to unblock dependencies and align priorities, and create simple, repeatable documentation and onboarding paths so teams can adopt monitoring and alerting with minimal friction.


 Embody our culture and values

* Create and maintain scorecards to track project performance.
* Accountable for on time project delivery, product quality, cost, and operations.


**Qualifications**

7cc1c65d.title: Solution Architect - VP
7cc1c65d.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect \- VP, Liquidity Management at Barclays, where you will set the strategic direction and architectural vision for our Liquidity Management platform. You will spearhead the evolution of enterprise‑critical financial systems, driving platform modernization, regulatory robustness, and engineering excellence across the organization.You will harness modern architectural paradigms and cloud‑native technologies to design and govern highly resilient, scalable, and auditable solutions, ensuring accurate interest computation, regulatory compliance, and seamless integration across core banking, payments, finance and treasury ecosystems. You will act as a senior technology leader, influencing strategy, mentoring architects, and partnering closely with business, risk, and regulatory stakeholders.
   

  

 To be successful as a Solution Architect \-VP, Liquidity Management, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Deep liquidity management and interest calculation, including cash flow forecasting, intraday liquidity, Single \& Multi\-Currency Pooling and regulatory drivers.
* Enterprise‑scale solution architecture leadership, defining target architectures, design standards, and architectural governance for complex banking platforms.
* Complex integration and data architecture, integrating core banking, payments, APIs, and event‑driven platforms while managing high‑volume, mission‑critical transactional data.
* Cloud and platform transformation, leading large‑scale implementations on Azure, AWS, or GCP with strong focus on resilience, security, performance, and regulatory compliance.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Experience with financial instruments and balance‑sheet products impacting liquidity and interest, including deposits, loans, and derivatives.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory‑driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross‑functional alignment.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts.
* Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management.
* Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up\-to\-date and accurate.
* Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively.
* Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy\-in, and potential risks.
* Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
* Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations.
* Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

33fe7bd4.description:
**About Zuora**
 At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
   

  

 We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Partner Solution Architect is a key member of the Partner Delivery Success organization, responsible for helping partners successfully architect, plan, and deliver Zuora solutions. This role is the technical lead and trusted advisor to partners during partner\-led implementations, improving delivery quality, partner readiness, and technical adoption across the ecosystem.
   

  

 This person will work closely with Partners, Global Services, Sales, Customer, Product, and Support to guide solution design, validate technical approaches, mitigate delivery risk, and strengthen partner capability. The role is centered on the technical aspects of partner delivery and implementation success rather than account management.
   

  

**What You’ll Achieve**
* Enable partners to design and deliver scalable, high\-quality Zuora implementations.
* Improve partner implementation health, go\-live outcomes, and overall delivery quality.
* Increase partner technical capability through certification, enablement, and ongoing architecture guidance.
* Support technical governance across partner\-led projects by identifying risks early, guiding mitigation plans, and ensuring alignment to Zuora best practices.


**In This Role, You Will**
**Partner Solution Architecture \& Technical Guidance**
* Provide technical leadership to partners during scoping, discovery, solution design, and implementation planning.
* Design and validate solution architectures that meet stated and implied business requirements while aligning to Zuora best practices.
* Review partner technical deliverables to ensure compliance with architecture standards, integration patterns, and delivery guidelines.
* Produce and review architecture artifacts such as ecosystem and integration diagrams, process flows, swim lanes, ERDs, and related design documentation.


**Partner Implementation Oversight**
* Serve as a key technical point of contact for partner\-led implementations — supporting partner requirements, internal GS coordination, escalations, product and support alignment, and hypercare activities as needed.
* Help identify technical delivery risks and issues early, and work with partners and internal teams to define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Support Areas of Complexity assessment and validation to ensure the right level of technical oversight is applied throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Provide technical guidance across design, build, test, deployment, UAT, and handoff stages of delivery.


**Partner Enablement \& Practice Development**
* Drive partner technical enablement by identifying capability gaps and supporting technical training, certification, and readiness programs.
* Conduct architecture reviews, office hours, and technical guidance sessions to support partner success on active and upcoming projects.
* Help partners strengthen their Zuora delivery practice through repeatable methods, best practices, and ongoing knowledge sharing.
* Share field feedback from partners and implementations with relevant Zuora teams to improve product adoption and delivery effectiveness.


**Opportunity \& Cross\-Functional Support**
* Partner with Sales, Partner Account Managers, and Global Services to assess partner fit for opportunities and support the right technical delivery model.
* Contribute technical insight during pre\-sales or early project phases to align partner capability with solution complexity and customer expectations.
* Support co\-delivery strategies that balance partner value, delivery quality, and successful customer outcomes.


**About You**
 You may be a great fit if you:
   

  

* Have enterprise\-level experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Technical Consultant, or Business Consultant in a professional services, partner delivery, or product\-led consulting environment.
* Have demonstrated experience delivering moderate to complex ERP, billing, revenue, procurement, CRM, or adjacent enterprise transformation solutions.
* Are strong in requirements gathering, business analysis, systems design, integration, implementation, and technical solution documentation.
* Have experience with data migration, interfaces, reporting, testing, and support across end\-to\-end implementations.
* Can simplify complex technical concepts and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Bring strong executive presence, with the ability to influence partners and internal stakeholders from project teams through senior leadership.
* Are comfortable working across distributed teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Are comfortable working with Finance and business stakeholders, translating business goals into scalable technical solutions.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with System Integrators, consulting partners, or partner\-led delivery models.
* Familiarity with partner enablement, technical certification programs, or practice development.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Experience presenting architecture recommendations, trade\-offs, and implementation approaches to internal and external audiences.


**About The Team**
*Draft below — please review and edit, Sujith; I wrote this from context in the role details but you know the team's day\-to\-day best.*
 The Partner Delivery Success team sits within Global Services and is responsible for ensuring Zuora’s partner ecosystem can consistently plan, architect, and deliver high\-quality implementations. The team partners closely with Global Services, Sales, Product, Support, and Customer teams to guide solution design, reduce delivery risk, and raise partner technical capability across the ecosystem.
   

  

 Team members work across a distributed, global partner base, balancing hands\-on architecture guidance with enablement and governance. This role offers opportunities to expand technical scope, deepen partner relationships, and gain cross\-functional exposure with Product, Engineering, and senior Global Services leadership.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
   

  

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance\-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company\-wide year\-end break
* Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
* Learning \& development stipend to support ongoing growth
* Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
* Mental wellbeing resources and support
* Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process


**\#ZEOLife at Zuora**
 ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
   

  

* Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
* Learn constantly and iterate often
* Build an inclusive, high\-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued


**Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace**
*Think, be and do you.*
 At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.
   

  

 Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

**Description**
 UKG Ready (UKGR) is an exciting division of Ultimate Kronos Group which continues to experience incredible growth! If you are interested in taking your career to the next level by utilizing and enhancing your software implementation and consulting skills, then this is the job for you! We are seeking talented software implementation professionals who are interested in being part of our dynamic, fast\-paced environment and are eager to develop their career and make a difference for UKG.
   

  

 You will be joining the Professional Services Consulting (PSC) job family under the workgroup of Global Delivery Services (GDS) for the new customer deployments of UKGR product and work with UKG customers in multiple geographies.
   

  

 The PSC projects’ scope has multiple roles including Solution Consultants, Integration consultants, Business Analysts and Quality analysts interacting with onsite teams and customers on a regular basis.
   

  

 We hire people having knowledge in Human Capital Management domain for projects like ADP, Oracle HCM, PeopleSoft, Ramco, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday
   

  

 As a Senior Solution Consultant within our UKG Ready implementation team, you will do the following:
   

  

 Engage with our clients directly or indirectly to understand their business needs regarding the implementation of various modules of UKG Ready product.
   

  

 Leverage your knowledge and experience to consult on best practices and assist clients (directly or through some onsite person) in designing and building a solution that meets their needs
   

  

 Utilize your technical aptitude to re\-configure our software solution and solve moderately complex issues
   

  

 Use knowledge of a variety of alternatives and their impact on the team to develop an approach to solutions
   

  

 Stay up\-to\-date on the latest product features and functionality
   

  

 Work independently receiving minimal guidance
   

  

 Work cross\-functionally and amongst a team on new client implementation, upgrade, and change order projects
   

  

 Drive consistency into UKG Ready delivery practices by leveraging their implementation experience to define processes and best practices for the services organization
   

  

 Understand \& explain clearly difficult \&/or sensitive information, and work collaboratively to build consensus
   

  

 Contribute to team objectives that may have impact on the area/group
   

  

 Be ready to become key point\-of\-contact to UKG customers
   

  

 Ability to work in a business required shift (06:00 AM to 03:00 PM)
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Individuals looking to be a part of our talented team should possess the following:
   

  

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or related field.
   

  

 5 to 8 years of industry experience with experience in Global implementations.
   

  

 Extensive domain experience in implementing HCM or WFM software.
   

  

 Proven knowledge of SDLC \& AGILE methodologies.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced team environment.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and changing environments.

 AtkinsRéalis is one of the world’s leading engineering design and programme management consultancies operating at the forefront of the infrastructure, transportation, and construction industry sectors. We’re recruiting for an experienced proposal lead, to be responsible for managing different phases of the company’s proposal process and oversee all required activities to develop RFP\-compliant, competitive, and quality marketing materials, proposals, statements of qualification, and presentations.
 



 You will be working closely with regional win work/technical leads and business development \& the engagement team across AtkinsRéalis and the wider organisation to produce compelling bids. As a member of the central Bid Management team, you will also be responsible for contributing to the continuous improvement of the win\-work capability (people, processes, tools, information, and governance).
 



  





 Your role
 



  




* Lead the development and application of proposal/bid themes. Develop organization chart with the pursuit team. Coordinate communication between SMEs and proposal writers. Lead teams through strategic reviews as per internal schedule.
* Exercise considerable initiative and independent judgment about content, wording, completeness, correctness, and appropriateness of proposal contents and graphics materials, making recommendations directly to pursuit team. Makes sound decisions.
* Supervise marketing assistants and/or less experienced proposal coordinators. Give work directions to graphic artists and marketing assistants involved in proposal production.
* Have experience leading pursuit responses – the larger and complex ones. Experience managing teams to deliver by established deadlines.
* Understanding of Architectural\-Engineering and project and construction management industry standards and disciplines. Can translate abstract ideas or narrative text into graphical concepts to illustrate concepts more effectively. Works independently yet functions effectively as a member of a team.
* Ensuring that the proposal is run in accordance with best practice and the win work capture plan and pursuit process, and in compliance with the Service Delivery Process.
* Provide client service, commitment, communication, innovation \& continuous improvement, professionalism, quality and teamwork. (Note that "Clients" may be internal managers and staff.)
* Added advantage if you have experience in capture planning
* Implement and facilitate capture planning process
* Facilitate kick off workshops and Go/No Go call
* Facilitate win theme sessions and supporting strategies
* Initiate and drive Go No Go calls and risk cat tool
* Portal Management (CRM tools) and Review procurement documents and attachments.
* Create and maintain a Proposal Management Plan.
* Develop compliance matrix, Storyboard templates and allocate bid deliverables.
* Review / approve response for standard prequalification questions.
* Check PQQ responses from JV partners (if applicable).
* Graphics co\-ordination, (colour schemes; word templates; document covers and dividers; images / photos; graphics / charts / graphs (where applicable) and Graphics approval in accordance with company’s Branding Guidelines.
* Work involves knowledgeable application of quality control as well as standard procedures and criteria to the coordination of proposals which are of critical importance to the firm.
* Assist in the development of preparation for Stage\-gate reviews – and facilitate bid go/no\-go decision.
* Support development of CVs.
* Work with the Business Development team to schedule \& co\-ordinate communications activities necessary to identify customer issues, hot buttons and the associated win themes and win strategy statements. Occasionally contact upper management for required signatures.
* Support the production of case studies / evidence scenarios.
* Coordinate with support services (legal, accounting, HR) on administrative sections of the pursuits (e.g., forms, statistics).
* Take constructive feedback and apply it to enhance the delivery.



  





*Submission* 




  




* Final quality review of documents, post\-formatting and after Bid Coordinator proofread / sense check.
* Final proofread / compliance check of tender documents.
* Close\-out actions with JV partners (if required).
* Client Presentation, Negotiate \& Contract, Feedback, Handover
* Lead, review, approve and disseminate Lessons Learnt feedback – Proposal Lead to lead the session with support from the Bid Co\-ordinator.
* Support response to Client Queries.
* Support preparation for client interviews / presentations.



  





 About you
 



  




* Promote and demonstrate team values and behaviours in line with the win work team practices
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Relationship building
* Ability to multi\-task and manage several projects at once
* Attention to detail
* Collaborative approach
* Time management skills
* Enthusiastic, initiative and the confidence to start things from scratch
* Confident using digital tools and learning new ones
* Promote the use of AtkinsRéalis work winning processes and tools
* In\-still a culture where others share knowledge, insights and learning



  





*Specific skills required* 




  




* A strong communicator with strong grammar, spelling, composition, and proofreading abilities.
* Able to evaluate, monitor and present ideas and data.
* Analytical with solid organisational skills, scheduling and prioritising activities.
* A flexible but methodical approach to supporting bids.
* Computer skills required and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM, and other software programmes including LLMs.
* Comfortable and effective when working across all levels of an organisation.
* Makes sound decisions, but also works with other stakeholders (e.g., sales lead, capture lead, PM) to gain buy\-in.



  





 Rewards \& benefits
 



  





 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
 



 This includes:
 



 • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
 



 • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
 



 • Generous annual leave balance.
 



 • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
 



 • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
 



 • Company gratuity scheme.
 



 • Discretionary bonus program.
 



 • Relocation assistance.
 



 • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
 



 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
 



  





 About AtkinsRéalis
 



  





 We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
 



 Find out more.

3c803473.description:
**Job Description – Senior Pre\-Sales Consultant (Individual Contributor)** 




  





**Role:** 
 Senior Pre\-Sales Consultant (IC Role) 
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram 
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office (5 Days) 
 



**Experience:** 
 12–15 Years 
 



**Industry:** 
 SaaS / Software Product 
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**About the Role** 




**We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Senior Pre\-Sales Consultant** 
 who can independently drive complex enterprise pre\-sales engagements from requirement discovery to solution design, demonstrations, proposal creation, and deal closure support.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on Individual Contributor role** 
 , ideal for professionals who enjoy solving customer challenges, creating compelling solution narratives, and partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to win strategic business opportunities.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong business consulting capabilities along with deep technical understanding of SaaS products, enterprise architecture, APIs, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Enterprise Solution Consulting** 



* Lead discovery workshops with CXOs, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Analyze business challenges and translate them into scalable product\-based solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures aligned with customer business objectives.
* Recommend best practices, implementation approaches, and solution roadmaps.



**Pre\-Sales Execution** 



* Independently own enterprise RFP, RFI, and RFQ responses.
* Prepare high\-quality proposals, technical documentation, solution blueprints, and commercial support documents.
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations, proof of concepts (POCs), and customized solution walkthroughs.
* Create tailored demo environments based on customer use cases.
* Manage multiple strategic pursuits simultaneously while meeting aggressive deadlines.



**Customer Engagement** 



* Act as a trusted solution advisor during customer meetings.
* Conduct technical presentations for business and technology leadership teams.
* Address functional and technical queries throughout the sales lifecycle.
* Support Sales teams during negotiations, solution discussions, and deal closures.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams for product enhancements and technical clarifications.
* Work with Delivery teams to ensure smooth knowledge transfer after project closure.
* Contribute to pricing strategy, effort estimation, and implementation planning.



**Knowledge Management** 



* Build reusable proposal templates, solution accelerators, case studies, and demo assets.
* Mentor junior pre\-sales consultants on proposal writing, demonstrations, and customer engagement.
* Continuously enhance competitive intelligence and industry knowledge.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Mandatory Skills** 



* 12–15 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Engineering.
* Strong experience working with SaaS or Enterprise Software Products.
* Proven expertise in enterprise solutioning and customer consulting.
* Extensive experience in independently handling enterprise RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs.
* Strong experience conducting executive\-level product demonstrations and POCs.
* Experience in solution architecture, enterprise integrations, and API\-based solutions.
* Excellent proposal writing and presentation development skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business audiences.
* Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams.



  





**Technical Knowledge** 




**Preferred exposure to:** 




**SaaS Platforms** 




**Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP)** 




**REST APIs \& Web Services** 




**Enterprise Integrations** 




**Microservices Architecture** 




**Identity \& Access Management (SSO, OAuth, SAML)** 




**AI/ML\-enabled products (Good to Have)** 




**CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, etc.)** 




**Collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Office Suite)** 




  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience handling enterprise accounts across multiple industries.
* Exposure to Digital Transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting large strategic deals.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software procurement processes.
* Experience working with global customers.
* Ability to balance business consulting with technical solutioning.



**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* MBA (Marketing/IT/Operations) is an added advantage.

533d2e8a.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (Pre-sales SaaS)
533d2e8a.description:
**This role is for one of the Weekday's clients**
**Salary range: Rs 2200000 \- Rs 2500000 (ie INR 22 \- 25 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 4\+ years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 This is a hands\-on pre\-sales role for someone who opens the product and builds the thing rather than talking around it. You'll be the technical voice in the room on the most important deals—sitting across from CFOs, finance leaders, and engineering teams; understanding how a prospect's business actually works; and proving we solve problems most vendors can't crack. You'll write SQL, poke at REST APIs, map data flows, and configure real customer scenarios to own the technical win alongside the AE.
   

  

**Requirements**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Understand customer billing models and configure contracts, pricing, metering, and invoicing accurately
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, structured product workflows and setups for B2B SaaS products, focused on outcomes rather than features
* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders — billing model, usage data, source systems, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses, building demos tied to the prospect's real scenario: metered plans, usage ingestion, rated invoices, and revenue recognition
* Design the integration — map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into the platform, flagging idempotency, late\-arriving events, and reconciliation risks before they become implementation problems
* Own the technical win: qualify the deal, separate champion from economic buyer, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing falls apart post\-sale
* Prepare business case documents and fill RFPs, tying capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed
* Create customer\-specific solution documentation and clean handoff references when transitioning deals
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years total experience with meaningful time in a hands\-on technical role — solutions or sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, data engineering, or backend and integrations work. Actual building, not support tickets
* Comfortable writing real SQL (group by, window functions, date logic) and building or debugging REST API integrations; knows the difference between an API and a webhook without thinking about it
* Vendor\-side B2B SaaS product experience, ideally billing, payments, fintech, ERP, or data\-infrastructure adjacent
* Client\-facing in a technical capacity: discovery, PoCs, demos, or implementation calls with real customers
* Comfortable supporting enterprise\-grade deal cycles and multi\-stakeholder buying processes with US or international customers
* Can hold a credible conversation with a CFO and with an engineer on the same day
* CS or engineering degree, or demonstrable equivalent shipped work
* Willing to work US\-overlap hours, roughly 6:00 PM \- 2:00 AM IST on weekdays
* Bonus: Experience at a small company (under 100 people, seed to Series A)
* Bonus: A sense of humor and the ability to not take yourself too seriously


**Required Skills**
 SQL, REST API integrations, Webhooks, Usage\-based billing, Metering \& rating, Revenue recognition, Solution design, Technical discovery, Demo building, RFP responses, Data pipeline mapping, Enterprise sales cycles, Stakeholder management, Business case development, Technical documentation
   

  

**Benefits \& Perks**
* Own the technical win on the company's most important enterprise deals
* Meaningful ESOPs in a fast\-growing startup
* Hands\-on ownership — configure and build in the product, not just present slides
* Direct exposure to CFOs and senior finance leaders at US and international companies
* Direct line into Product and Engineering as the voice of the customer
* Hybrid setup with only 2 fixed office days per week

**Description**

The role demands strong hands\-on technical experience, architectural thinking, analytical skills, and excellent communication in English and Hindi.

* 8\+ Years

**Location:**
* Trivandrum

 Technical \& Architecture Skills:
   

  

* Strong understanding of enterprise IT concepts, including:
* DBMS (RDBMS and NoSQL)
* Web Servers and Application Servers
* Hands\-on development experience in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, .NET or equivalent)

 Communication \& Stakeholder Skills:
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT (or equivalent).
* 9\+ years of overall IT experience.
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in solution architecture and/or pre\-sales roles.
* Prior hands\-on development experience is mandatory.
* Experience in RFP\-based bidding and proposal preparation is highly desirable.
* Exposure to government or large enterprise IT projects is an added advantage.


 Preferred / Added Advantages:
   

  

* Experience in proposal estimations and costing models.
* Knowledge of compliance standards, security frameworks, or government IT guidelines.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to mentor junior architects or business analysts in pre\-sales activities

fc0789ae.title: Solutions Engineer
fc0789ae.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Solution Engineer, you will serve as the customer\-facing advocate for Razorpay suite of products, supporting prospects with technical implementation for large enterprises. This role reports to the Head of Integrations within the Business Engineering team at Razorpay. The individual will play a key role in ensuring the successful integration of Curlec’s platform with merchants, enabling seamless payment solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* This Individual should have a deep understanding of the entire product suite.
* Should be up\-to\-date in the technical knowledge and in\-depth understanding of any coding language is a must.
* Responsible to represent Razorpay from platform integration perspective with prospective merchants.
* Accountable to ensure successful implementation of platform integration between Curlec by Razorpay and merchants.
* Support the reactive queries and requests being raised by Merchants within an agreed turnaround time and quality standards.
* Read and respond to integration and platform documents shared by prospective customers.
* The individual will act as a key feedback channel for customer's product requirements/ expectations and will close the loop with the Product team on the same.
* In the case of product customisation requests from the clients, he/she would help validate the requirements.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of experience in product\-based payments or SaaS platform integrations, implementation, or solutions in a customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, .NET, PHP, Python, and JavaScript.
* Strong expertise in REST APIs.
* Strong ability to understand technical requirements and ensure seamless platform integration for enterprise clients.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation abilities.
* Preferably from a Fintech background.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter

**Job Summary:**




  





 As an AWS Solution Architect, your primary responsibility will be to design and deploy secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud\-based solutions for clients. You will work closely with clients, understanding their business requirements, and architecting cost\-effective and efficient solutions that align with their goals. You will also collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, engineers, and project managers, to ensure successful implementation and delivery of AWS solutions.
 



  





**Responsibilities:**




  





 · Design and architect AWS cloud\-based solutions that meet client requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
 



 · Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solution designs.
 



 · Assess existing infrastructure and systems, identify opportunities for migration or adoption of AWS services, and create migration plans.

 · Create technical documentation including solution architecture diagrams, design documents, and deployment guides.
